14.32.m: Then Gaurī gave him a vessel of food filled with sweetmeats; / out of affection for his mother, having received it, he then danced joyfully.

14.32.s:
tasya bhakṣyasya gandhena niṣkrānto mūṣako bilāt ..
bhakṣaṇāccāmaro jātastasya vāhyo vyajāyata .. 21 ..
14.32.d:
तस्य भक्ष्यस्य गन्धेन निष्क्रान्तो मूषको बिलात् ..
भक्षणाच्चामरो जातस्तस्य वाह्यो व्यजायत .. 21 ..
14.32.m: Drawn by the scent of that sweetmeat, a mouse came out from its hole; / and from eating it, he became immortal and became his vehicle.

14.32.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
mahāvināyako hyevaṃ tatra jāto mahī pate ..
tasmindṛṣṭe ca yatpuṇyaṃ tattvamekamanāḥ śṛṇu .. 22 ..
14.32.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
महाविनायको ह्येवं तत्र जातो मही पते ..
तस्मिन्दृष्टे च यत्पुण्यं तत्त्वमेकमनाः शृणु .. 22 ..
14.32.m: Pulastya said: / Thus indeed Mahāvināyaka was born there, O lord of the earth. / Hear with a single mind the merit obtained upon seeing him:

14.32.s:
bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi yat ..
karoti mānavo rājaṃstasmātpāpātpramucyate .. 23 ..
14.32.d:
बाल्ये वयसि यत्पापं वार्द्धके यौवनेऽपि यत् ..
करोति मानवो राजंस्तस्मात्पापात्प्रमुच्यते .. 23 ..
14.32.m: Whatever sin a man commits in childhood, / in old age, or in youth, O king, he is freed from that sin.

14.32.s:
māghamāse site pakṣe caturthyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ ..
yastaṃ paśyati vāggmī sa sarvajñaśca prajāyate ..
tasyāgre sumahatkuṇḍaṃ svacchodakapūritam .. 24 ..
14.32.d:
माघमासे सिते पक्षे चतुर्थ्यां समुपोषितः ..
यस्तं पश्यति वाग्ग्मी स सर्वज्ञश्च प्रजायते ..
तस्याग्रे सुमहत्कुण्डं स्वच्छोदकपूरितम् .. 24 ..
14.32.m: Fasting on the fourth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Māgha, / he who sees him becomes eloquent and omniscient. / In front of him is a very large pool filled with clear water;

14.32.s:
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā yaḥ paśyati vināyakam..
tasyānvaye'pi sarvajñā jāyante mānavā nṛpa ..25..
14.32.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या यः पश्यति विनायकम्..
तस्यान्वयेऽपि सर्वज्ञा जायन्ते मानवा नृप ..25..
14.32.m: having bathed there, the man who gazes upon Vināyaka with devotion— / in his lineage too, O king, men are born omniscient.

14.32.s:
gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa kṛtvā vai triḥ pradakṣiṇam..
yastaṃ paśyati rājendra duritaṃ na sa paśyati .. 26 ..
14.32.d:
गणानां त्वेति मंत्रेण कृत्वा वै त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम्..
यस्तं पश्यति राजेन्द्र दुरितं न स पश्यति .. 26 ..
14.32.m: Having made three circumambulations with the mantra beginning “gaṇānāṃ tvā...”, / he who sees him, O king of kings, sees no misfortune.

14.32.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena taṃ prapaśyedvināyakam ..
ya icchetsakalānkāmāniha loke paratra ca .. 27 ..
14.32.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तं प्रपश्येद्विनायकम् ..
य इच्छेत्सकलान्कामानिह लोके परत्र च .. 27 ..
14.32.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should behold that Vināyaka, / if one desires all objects of desire in this world and the next.

14.32.s:
gṛhastho'pi ca yo bhaktyā smaretkārya upasthite ..
avighnaṃ tasya tatsarvaṃ saṃsiddhimupagacchati .. 28 ..
14.32.d:
गृहस्थोऽपि च यो भक्त्या स्मरेत्कार्य उपस्थिते ..
अविघ्नं तस्य तत्सर्वं संसिद्धिमुपगच्छति .. 28 ..
14.32.m: Even a householder who remembers him with devotion when a task is at hand— / all that [task] goes to fulfillment without obstacles.

14.32.s:
prātarutthāya yo martyaḥ smareddevaṃ vināyakam ..
tasya taddinajātāni siddhiṃ kṛtyāni yāṃti hi .. 29 ..
14.32.d:
प्रातरुत्थाय यो मर्त्यः स्मरेद्देवं विनायकम् ..
तस्य तद्दिनजातानि सिद्धिं कृत्यानि यांति हि .. 29 ..
14.32.m: The mortal who, rising in the morning, remembers the god Vināyaka— / the deeds born of that day indeed reach success for him.

14.32.s:
vivāhe kalahe yuddhe prasthāne kṛṣikarmaṇi ..
praveśe ca smaredyastu bhaktipūrvaṃ vināyakam ..
tasya tadvāṃchitaṃ sarvaṃ prasādāttasya siddhyati .. 7.3.32.30 ..
14.32.d:
विवाहे कलहे युद्धे प्रस्थाने कृषिकर्मणि ..
प्रवेशे च स्मरेद्यस्तु भक्तिपूर्वं विनायकम् ..
तस्य तद्वांछितं सर्वं प्रसादात्तस्य सिद्ध्यति .. 7.3.32.30 ..
14.32.m: In marriage, dispute, battle, setting forth, agricultural work, / and entering [a new house], he who remembers Vināyaka with devotion / attains all that he desires through his grace.

14.32.s:
mahāvināyakīṃ śāṃtiṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ ..
na taṃ pretā grahā rogāḥ pīḍayaṃti vināyakāḥ ..31..
14.32.d:
महाविनायकीं शांतिं यः करोति समाहितः ..
न तं प्रेता ग्रहा रोगाः पीडयंति विनायकाः ..31..
14.32.m: He who performs the pacification rite of Mahāvināyaka with a concentrated mind / is not afflicted by ghosts, planetary spirits, diseases, or obstructing spirits.

14.32.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
mahāvaināyikīṃ śāṃtiṃ vada me munisattama ..
ke maṃtrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 32 ..
14.32.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
महावैनायिकीं शांतिं वद मे मुनिसत्तम ..
के मंत्राः किं विधानं च परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 32 ..
14.32.m: Yayāti said: / Tell me, O best of sages, about the pacification rite of Mahāvināyaka: / what are the mantras, and what is the procedure? For my curiosity is great.

14.32.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śuklapakṣe śubhe vāre nakṣatre doṣavarjite ..
śreṣṭhacaṃdrabale śāṃtiṃ gaṇeśasya samācaret .. 33 ..
14.32.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
शुक्लपक्षे शुभे वारे नक्षत्रे दोषवर्जिते ..
श्रेष्ठचंद्रबले शांतिं गणेशस्य समाचरेत् .. 33 ..
14.32.m: Pulastya said: / In the bright fortnight, on an auspicious weekday, under a lunar mansion free of defects, / when the power of the moon is supreme, one should perform the pacification rite of Gaṇeśa.

14.32.s:
pūrvottare same deśe kṛtvā vediṃ ca maṃḍapam ..
madhye cāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ gṛhyasūtraṃ prayojayet ..34..
14.32.d:
पूर्वोत्तरे समे देशे कृत्वा वेदिं च मंडपम् ..
मध्ये चाष्टदलं पद्मं गृह्यसूत्रं प्रयोजयेत् ..34..
14.32.m: Having made an altar and a pavilion on level ground in the northeast, / and in the center an eight-petaled lotus, one should apply the domestic ritual manual;

14.32.s:
indrādilokapālāṃśca dikṣu sarvāsu bhūpate ..
gaṇeśapūrvikāścāpi mātaraśca viśeṣataḥ .. 35 ..
14.32.d:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालांश्च दिक्षु सर्वासु भूपते ..
गणेशपूर्विकाश्चापि मातरश्च विशेषतः .. 35 ..
14.32.m: and the world-guardians, Indra and the others, in all directions, O king, / as well as the Mothers, especially with Gaṇeśa at their head,

14.32.s:
gaṃdhapuṣpopahāraiśca yathoktairbalivistaraiḥ ..
śvetavastrayugacchannaṃ kalaśaṃ jalapūritam .. 36 ..
14.32.d:
गंधपुष्पोपहारैश्च यथोक्तैर्बलिविस्तरैः ..
श्वेतवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं कलशं जलपूरितम् .. 36 ..
14.32.m: with scents, flowers, offerings, and extensive oblations as prescribed, / [and] a water-filled pot covered with a pair of white cloths,

14.32.s:
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge sahiraṇyaṃ phalānvitam .. 37 ..
gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa sahasraṃ cāṣṭasaṃyutam ..
japettatra tathā cārūnpaṃcāṃgānnṛpasattama .. 35 ..
14.32.d:
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे सहिरण्यं फलान्वितम् .. 37 ..
गणानां त्वेति मंत्रेण सहस्रं चाष्टसंयुतम् ..
जपेत्तत्र तथा चारून्पंचांगान्नृपसत्तम .. 35 ..
14.32.m:
in the eastern quarter of that very [altar], accompanied by gold and fruit.
With the mantra beginning 'gaṇānāṃ tvā' one should recite [it] eight thousand times, / and likewise, O best of kings, the beautiful five limbs [of the mantra]. .. 35 ..

14.32.s:
vināyakaṃ samuddiśya puraḥ kuṇḍe karātmake ..
caturasre yoniyute mekhalābhirvibhūṣite .. 39 ..
14.32.d:
विनायकं समुद्दिश्य पुरः कुण्डे करात्मके ..
चतुरस्रे योनियुते मेखलाभिर्विभूषिते .. 39 ..
14.32.m: Dedicaing it to Vināyaka, in a fire-pit in front measuring one cubit, / four-cornered, furnished with a vulva-shaped hearth, and adorned with rims, .. 39 ..

14.32.s:
madhudūrvākṣataihomairgrahahomādanaṃtaram ..
gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa daśasāhasrikastathā .. 7.3.32.40 ..
14.32.d:
मधुदूर्वाक्षतैहोमैर्ग्रहहोमादनंतरम् ..
गणानां त्वेति मंत्रेण दशसाहस्रिकस्तथा .. 7.3.32.40 ..
14.32.m: with oblations of honey, dūrvā grass, and unbroken rice, after the oblation to the planets, / likewise a rite of ten thousand [oblations] with the mantra beginning 'gaṇānāṃ tvā' .. 7.3.32.40 ..

14.32.s:
kāryo vai pārthivaśreṣṭha kāryaścodaṅmukhairdvijaiḥ ..
caturbhiścaturai rājanpītavastrānulepanaiḥ .. 41 ..
14.32.d:
कार्यो वै पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ कार्यश्चोदङ्मुखैर्द्विजैः ..
चतुर्भिश्चतुरै राजन्पीतवस्त्रानुलेपनैः .. 41 ..
14.32.m: must indeed be performed, O best of rulers, and performed by twice-born ones facing north, / four skillful [brahmins], O king, wearing yellow garments and yellow ointments, .. 41 ..

14.32.s:
pītāṃbaradharaiścaiva dhṛtahemāṃgulīyakaiḥ ..
tato homāvasāne tu yajamānaṃ nṛpottama .. 42 ..
14.32.d:
पीतांबरधरैश्चैव धृतहेमांगुलीयकैः ..
ततो होमावसाने तु यजमानं नृपोत्तम .. 42 ..
14.32.m: clad in yellow robes and wearing gold rings on their fingers. / Then, at the end of the oblation, O best of kings, the patron of the sacrifice, .. 42 ..

14.32.s:
mṛgacarmoparisthaṃ ca maṃtrairebhirvidhānataḥ ..
snāpayetprāṅmukhaṃ śāṃtaṃ śuklavastrāvaguṃṭhitam .. 43 ..
14.32.d:
मृगचर्मोपरिस्थं च मंत्रैरेभिर्विधानतः ..
स्नापयेत्प्राङ्मुखं शांतं शुक्लवस्त्रावगुंठितम् .. 43 ..
14.32.m: seated upon a deer skin, according to the rule with these mantras, / calm, veiled in white cloth, facing east, one should bathe. .. 43 ..

14.32.s:
imaṃ me gaṃge yamune paṃcanadyaḥ supuṣkare ..
śrīsūktasahitaṃ viṣṇoḥ pāvamānaṃ vṛṣākapim .. 44 ..
14.32.d:
इमं मे गंगे यमुने पंचनद्यः सुपुष्करे ..
श्रीसूक्तसहितं विष्णोः पावमानं वृषाकपिम् .. 44 ..
14.32.m: [Reciting] 'imaṃ me gaṅge yamune', the Five Rivers, the Supuṣkara hymn, / the Pāvamāna hymn of Viṣṇu accompanied by the Śrīsūkta, and the Vṛṣākapi hymn, .. 44 ..

14.32.s:
samyaguccārya vighnānāṃ tato nāśaṃ prapadyate ..
grahāḥ saumyatvamāyāṃti bhūtā naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt ..45..
14.32.d:
सम्यगुच्चार्य विघ्नानां ततो नाशं प्रपद्यते ..
ग्रहाः सौम्यत्वमायांति भूता नश्यंति तत्क्षणात् ..45..
14.32.m: properly reciting [them], one attains the destruction of obstacles. / The planets become benevolent, and ghosts perish in that very moment. ..45..

14.32.s:
ādhayo vyādhayo raudrā duṣṭarogā jvarādayaḥ ..
praṇaśyaṃti drutaṃ sarve tathotpātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ .. 46 ..
14.32.d:
आधयो व्याधयो रौद्रा दुष्टरोगा ज्वरादयः ..
प्रणश्यंति द्रुतं सर्वे तथोत्पाताः सुदारुणाः .. 46 ..
14.32.m: Mental agonies, physical ailments, dreadful and malignant diseases such as fevers / quickly all perish, as do very dire portents. .. 46 ..

14.32.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..
vināyakasya māhātmyaṃ mahattvaṃ śāṃtikaṃ tathā ..47..
14.32.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..
विनायकस्य माहात्म्यं महत्त्वं शांतिकं तथा ..47..
14.32.m: All this has been told to you that you asked of me: / the greatness of Vināyaka, his majesty, and the pacifying rite. ..47..

14.32.s:
yaśca kīrttayate samyakcaturthyāṃ susamāhitaḥ ..
śṛṇoti vā nṛpaśreṣṭha tasyā'vighnaṃ sadā bhavet .. 48 ..
14.32.d:
यश्च कीर्त्तयते सम्यक्चतुर्थ्यां सुसमाहितः ..
शृणोति वा नृपश्रेष्ठ तस्याऽविघ्नं सदा भवेत् .. 48 ..
14.32.m: And whoever, deeply concentrated, properly recites or hears [this] / on the fourth lunar day, O best of kings, for him there shall always be freedom from obstacles. .. 48 ..

14.32.s:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyanyajeccedaṃ samāhitaḥ ..
tattadāpnoti nūnaṃ ca gaṇanāthaprasādataḥ .. 49 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vināyakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 32 .. ..
14.32.d:
यंयं काममभिध्यायन्यजेच्चेदं समाहितः ..
तत्तदाप्नोति नूनं च गणनाथप्रसादतः .. 49 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे विनायकमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 32 .. ..
14.32.m:
Whatever desire one contemplates when one performs this sacrifice with concentration, / that very desire one surely attains through the grace of the Lord of Gaṇas. .. 49 ..
Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the Greatness of Vināyaka', in the Arbuda Section of the third part, within the seventh book, the Prabhāsa Section, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. .. 32 .. ..

14.33.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ pārtheśvaraṃ gacchedevaṃ pātakanāśanam ..
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyaṅmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 1 ..
14.33.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततः पार्थेश्वरं गच्छेदेवं पातकनाशनम् ..
यं दृष्ट्वा मानवः सम्यङ्मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 1 ..
14.33.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Pārtheśvara, which destroys sins in this way, / seeing which a human being is completely freed from all sins. .. 1 ..

14.33.s:
pārthānāmnyabhavatsādhvī devalasya priyā satī ..
tayā pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ tatra sthāne mahīpate .. 2 ..
14.33.d:
पार्थानाम्न्यभवत्साध्वी देवलस्य प्रिया सती ..
तया पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं तत्र स्थाने महीपते .. 2 ..
14.33.m: A virtuous wife named Pārthā was the beloved, faithful wife of Devala. / Formerly, austerity was practiced by her at that place, O protector of the earth. .. 2 ..

14.33.s:
sā pūrvamabhavadvaṃdhyā ṛṣipatnī yaśasvinī ..
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā tataścaivārbudaṃ gatā .. 3 ..
14.33.d:
सा पूर्वमभवद्वंध्या ऋषिपत्नी यशस्विनी ..
वैराग्यं परमं गत्वा ततश्चैवार्बुदं गता .. 3 ..
14.33.m: Formerly she, the illustrious wife of the seer, was barren. / Having attained supreme detachment, she then went to Arbuda. .. 3 ..

14.33.s:
vāyubhakṣā nirāhārā samacittā''sane sthitā ..
tato varṣasahasrāṃte bhaktyā tasyā mahīpate .. .. 4 ..
14.33.d:
वायुभक्षा निराहारा समचित्ता'ऽसने स्थिता ..
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते भक्त्या तस्या महीपते .. .. 4 ..
14.33.m: Feeding on air, taking no food, remaining on her seat with an even mind, / then, at the end of a thousand years, through her devotion, O protector of the earth, .. 4 ..

14.33.s:
udbhidya dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ sahasā liṃgamutthitam ..
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī .. 5 ..
14.33.d:
उद्भिद्य धरणीपृष्ठं सहसा लिंगमुत्थितम् ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी .. 5 ..
14.33.m: bursting through the surface of the earth, a liṅga suddenly arose. / At that very time, a bodiless voice spoke: .. 5 ..

14.33.s:
pūjayaitanmahābhāge śivaliṃgaṃ supāvanam ..
tvadbhaktyā dharaṇīpṛṣṭhānniḥsṛtaṃ kāmadaṃ mahat .. 6 ..
14.33.d:
पूजयैतन्महाभागे शिवलिंगं सुपावनम् ..
त्वद्भक्त्या धरणीपृष्ठान्निःसृतं कामदं महत् .. 6 ..
14.33.m: "Worship this very purifying Śiva-liṅga, O highly fortunate lady! / Through your devotion, it has issued forth from the surface of the earth, great and granting desires. .. 6 ..

14.33.s:
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyanpūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ ..
anyopi tadabhipretaṃ prāpsyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. .. 7 ..
14.33.d:
यो यं काममभिध्यायन्पूजयिष्यति मानवः ..
अन्योपि तदभिप्रेतं प्राप्स्यते नात्र संशयः .. .. 7 ..
14.33.m: Whatever desire any human being contemplates when worshipping [it], / he too will obtain what is desired; there is no doubt about this. .. 7 ..

14.33.s:
pārtheśvarākhyametaddhi loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ..
evamuktvā tato vāṇī virarāma mahīpate ..8..
14.33.d:
पार्थेश्वराख्यमेतद्धि लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यति ..
एवमुक्त्वा ततो वाणी विरराम महीपते ..8..
14.33.m: Indeed, this shall attain renown in the world under the name Pārtheśvara." / Having spoken thus, the voice then ceased, O protector of the earth. ..8..

14.33.s:
tataḥ sā vismayāviṣṭā pūjayāmāsa tattadā ..
tataḥ putraśataṃ prāptaṃ divyaṃ vaṃśadharaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
14.33.d:
ततः सा विस्मयाविष्टा पूजयामास तत्तदा ..
ततः पुत्रशतं प्राप्तं दिव्यं वंशधरं तथा .. 9 ..
14.33.m: Then, filled with wonder, she worshipped it at that time; / thereafter, she obtained a hundred divine sons who carried on the lineage. .. 9 ..

14.33.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti talliṃgaṃ vikhyātaṃ dharaṇītale ..
tatrāsti nirmalaṃ toyaṃ girigahvaraniḥsṛtam .. 7.3.33.10 ..
14.33.d:
ततः प्रभृति तल्लिंगं विख्यातं धरणीतले ..
तत्रास्ति निर्मलं तोयं गिरिगह्वरनिःसृतम् .. 7.3.33.10 ..
14.33.m: From that time forward, that liṅga became renowned on the surface of the earth. / There is pure water there, issuing from a mountain cave. .. 7.3.33.10 ..

14.33.s:
tatra snātvā naraḥ samyagyastaṃ paśyati bhāvataḥ ..
na sa paśyati saṃsāre duḥkhaṃ saṃtānasaṃbhavam .. 11 ..
14.33.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरः सम्यग्यस्तं पश्यति भावतः ..
न स पश्यति संसारे दुःखं संतानसंभवम् .. 11 ..
14.33.m: Having bathed there, the person who beholds it properly with devotion / does not experience sorrow arising from offspring in worldly existence. .. 11 ..

14.33.s:
śuklapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ jāgaraṃ tasya cāgrataḥ ..
yaḥ karoti nirāhāraḥ sa putraṃ labhate dhuvam .. 12 ..
14.33.d:
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्द्दश्यां जागरं तस्य चाग्रतः ..
यः करोति निराहारः स पुत्रं लभते धुवम् .. 12 ..
14.33.m: Whoever, fasting, keeps a vigil in front of it / on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, he certainly obtains a son. .. 12 ..

14.33.s:
piṃḍanirvāpaṇaṃ tatra yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ ..
tasya putratvamāyāti pitarastatprasādataḥ .. .. 13 ..
14.33.d:
पिंडनिर्वापणं तत्र यः करोति समाहितः ..
तस्य पुत्रत्वमायाति पितरस्तत्प्रसादतः .. .. 13 ..
14.33.m: Whoever performs the offering of ancestral rice-balls there with concentration, / through its grace, his ancestors attain the state of sonship [for him]. .. 13 ..

14.33.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe pārtheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 33 ..
14.33.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे पार्थेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 33 ..
14.33.m: Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, titled 'Description of the Greatness of Pārtheśvara', in the Arbuda Section of the third part, within the seventh book, the Prabhāsa Section, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. .. 33 ..

14.34.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ tato gacchetkṛṣṇasya dayitaṃ sadā ..
yatra sannihito nityaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇurmahīpate .. ..
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ kathaṃ tatra jātaṃ brāhmaṇasattama ..
kasminkāle mune brūhi sarvaṃ vistarato mama .. .... 2 ..
14.34.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
कृष्णतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्कृष्णस्य दयितं सदा ..
यत्र सन्निहितो नित्यं स्वयं विष्णुर्महीपते .. ..
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
कृष्णतीर्थं कथं तत्र जातं ब्राह्मणसत्तम ..
कस्मिन्काले मुने ब्रूहि सर्वं विस्तरतो मम .. .... 2 ..
14.34.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Kṛṣṇatīrtha, always beloved of Kṛṣṇa, / where Viṣṇu himself is eternally present, O protector of the earth. / Yayāti said: / How did Kṛṣṇatīrtha arise there, O best of brahmins? / At what time, O sage? Tell me everything in detail. .... 2 ..

14.34.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame ..
caṃdrārkapavane naṣṭe jyotiṣi pralayaṃ gate .. 3 ..
14.34.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजंगमे ..
चंद्रार्कपवने नष्टे ज्योतिषि प्रलयं गते .. 3 ..
14.34.m:
Pulastya said:
In that dreadful solitary ocean, when the stationary and moving [beings] had perished, / when the moon, sun, and wind had vanished, and the luminaries had dissolved into destruction,

14.34.s:
tato yugasahasrāṃte vibuddhaḥ kamalāsanaḥ ..
ekākī ciṃtayāmāsa kathaṃ sṛṣṭirbhavediti .. 4 ..
14.34.d:
ततो युगसहस्रांते विबुद्धः कमलासनः ..
एकाकी चिंतयामास कथं सृष्टिर्भवेदिति .. 4 ..
14.34.m: then, at the end of a thousand yugas, the lotus-seated [Brahmā] awoke. / Being alone, he pondered: “How may creation come to be?”

14.34.s:
bhramaṃścāpi caturvaktro yāvatpaśyati dūrataḥ ..
caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ puruṣaṃ purataḥ sthitam .. 5 ..
14.34.d:
भ्रमंश्चापि चतुर्वक्त्रो यावत्पश्यति दूरतः ..
चतुर्भुजं विशालाक्षं पुरुषं पुरतः स्थितम् .. 5 ..
14.34.m: And while wandering, the four-faced [god] saw from afar / a four-armed, large-eyed male standing before him.

14.34.s:
taṃ covāca caturvaktraḥ kastvaṃ kena vinirmitaḥ ..
kimarthamiha saṃprāptaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 6 ..
14.34.d:
तं चोवाच चतुर्वक्त्रः कस्त्वं केन विनिर्मितः ..
किमर्थमिह संप्राप्तः सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 6 ..
14.34.m: And the four-faced [god] said to him: “Who are you? By whom were you created? / For what purpose have you arrived here? Tell me everything in full.”

14.34.s: tamuvācātha goviṃdaḥ prahasañchlakṣṇayā girā .. 7 ..
14.34.d: तमुवाचाथ गोविंदः प्रहसञ्छ्लक्ष्णया गिरा .. 7 ..
14.34.m: Govinda then said to him, laughing with a smooth voice:

14.34.s:
ahamādyaḥ pumāneko mayā sṛṣṭo bhavānapi ..
sraṣṭumicchāmi bhūyo'pi bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham .. 8..
14.34.d:
अहमाद्यः पुमानेको मया सृष्टो भवानपि ..
स्रष्टुमिच्छामि भूयोऽपि भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम् .. 8..
14.34.m: “I am the one primal male; you too were created by me. / I desire to create once again the fourfold aggregate of beings.”

14.34.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kruddho devaḥ pitāmahaḥ ..
abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ bhartsayaṃśca punaḥpunaḥ .. 9 ..
14.34.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो देवः पितामहः ..
अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं भर्त्सयंश्च पुनःपुनः .. 9 ..
14.34.m:
Pulastya said:
Hearing that statement of his, the grandfather god was enraged, / and reproaching him repeatedly, he spoke harsh words:

14.34.s:
sṛṣṭastvaṃ hi mayā mūḍha prathamo'hamasaṃśayam ..
tvādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi kariṣye'hamasaṃśayam .. 7.3.34.10 ..
14.34.d:
सृष्टस्त्वं हि मया मूढ प्रथमोऽहमसंशयम् ..
त्वादृशानां सहस्राणि करिष्येऽहमसंशयम् .. 7.3.34.10 ..
14.34.m: “Indeed, you were created by me, fool! I am the first, without a doubt. / I shall make thousands of beings like you, without a doubt!”

14.34.s:
evaṃ vivadamānau tau mitho rājanmahādyutī ..
spardhayā roṣatāmrākṣau yuyudhāte parasparam.. 11 ..
14.34.d:
एवं विवदमानौ तौ मिथो राजन्महाद्युती ..
स्पर्धया रोषताम्राक्षौ युयुधाते परस्परम्.. 11 ..
14.34.m: Thus disputing with each other, O king, those two of great splendour, / their eyes red with wrath through rivalry, fought each other.

14.34.s:
muṣṭibhirbāhubhiścaiva nakhairdaṃtairvikarṣaṇaiḥ ..
evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tayoryuddhamavarttata .. 12 ..
14.34.d:
मुष्टिभिर्बाहुभिश्चैव नखैर्दंतैर्विकर्षणैः ..
एवं वर्षसहस्रं तु तयोर्युद्धमवर्त्तत .. 12 ..
14.34.m: With fists, with arms, with nails, teeth, and grappling, / their battle continued thus for a thousand years.

14.34.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tayormadhye nṛpottama ..
prādurbhūtaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ divyaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham .. 13 ..
14.34.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते तयोर्मध्ये नृपोत्तम ..
प्रादुर्भूतं महालिंगं दिव्यं तेजोमयं शुभम् .. 13 ..
14.34.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, O best of kings, between the two of them / there appeared a great liṅga, divine, full of fiery radiance, and auspicious.

14.34.s:
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
yuddhādbrahmannivartasva tvaṃ ca viṣṇo mamājñayā .. 14 ..
14.34.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
युद्धाद्ब्रह्मन्निवर्तस्व त्वं च विष्णो ममाज्ञया .. 14 ..
14.34.m: At that very moment, a bodiless voice spoke: / “Desist from battle, O Brahmā, and you too, O Viṣṇu, at my command!

14.34.s:
etanmāheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yo'sya cāṃte gamiṣyati ..
sa jyeṣṭhaḥ sa vibhuḥ karttā yuvayornātra saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
14.34.d:
एतन्माहेश्वरं लिंगं योऽस्य चांते गमिष्यति ..
स ज्येष्ठः स विभुः कर्त्ता युवयोर्नात्र संशयः .. 15 ..
14.34.m: This is a liṅga of Maheśvara. Whoever reaches its end, / he shall be the elder, he the all-pervading lord and creator of you two; of this there is no doubt.”

14.34.s:
adhobhāgaṃ vrajatveka ekaścorddhvaṃ mamājñayā ..
tacchrutvā satvaro brahmā vyomamārgaṃ samāśritaḥ .. 16 ..
14.34.d:
अधोभागं व्रजत्वेक एकश्चोर्द्ध्वं ममाज्ञया ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सत्वरो ब्रह्मा व्योममार्गं समाश्रितः .. 16 ..
14.34.m:
"Let one go to the lower region and one go upward by my command."
Hearing that, Brahmā quickly set out along the path of the sky.

14.34.s:
vidārya vasudhāṃ kṛṣṇo'pyadhastātsatvaraṃ gataḥ ..
sa bhittvā saptapātālānadho yāvatprayāti ca ..
tāvatkālāgnirudrastu dṛṣṭastena mahātmanā .. 17 ..
14.34.d:
विदार्य वसुधां कृष्णोऽप्यधस्तात्सत्वरं गतः ..
स भित्त्वा सप्तपातालानधो यावत्प्रयाति च ..
तावत्कालाग्निरुद्रस्तु दृष्टस्तेन महात्मना .. 17 ..
14.34.m:
Tearing through the earth, Kṛṣṇa too went swiftly downward.
Piercing the seven netherworlds, as far down as he went,
just so far was Kālāgnirudra seen by that great-souled one.

14.34.s:
gaṃtumicchaṃstato'dhastādyāvadvegaṃ karoti saḥ ..
tāvattasyārcibhirdagdhaḥ kṛṣṇatvaṃ samapadyata .. 18 ..
14.34.d:
गंतुमिच्छंस्ततोऽधस्ताद्यावद्वेगं करोति सः ..
तावत्तस्यार्चिभिर्दग्धः कृष्णत्वं समपद्यत .. 18 ..
14.34.m:
Wishing to go below him, as much speed as he exerted,
just so much was he scorched by his flames and turned black.

14.34.s:
tato mūrchābhisaṃtapto dahyamāno'dbhutāgninā ..
nivartya sahasā viṣṇurvailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 19 ..
14.34.d:
ततो मूर्छाभिसंतप्तो दह्यमानोऽद्भुताग्निना ..
निवर्त्य सहसा विष्णुर्वैलक्ष्यं परमं गतः .. 19 ..
14.34.m:
Then, distressed by fainting, being burned by the marvelous fire,
Viṣṇu hastily turned back, having fallen into the deepest embarrassment.

14.34.s:
tathā liṃgaṃ samāsādya bhaktyā pūjā kṛtā tataḥ ..
vedoktaiḥ paramaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ stutiṃ cakre mahīpate .. 7.3.34.20 ..
14.34.d:
तथा लिंगं समासाद्य भक्त्या पूजा कृता ततः ..
वेदोक्तैः परमैः सूक्ष्मैः स्तुतिं चक्रे महीपते .. 7.3.34.20 ..
14.34.m:
Then, approaching the liṅga, he performed worship with devotion;
he uttered praise, O king, with supreme and subtle [hymns] prescribed in the Vedas.

14.34.s:
brahmā'pi vyomamārgeṇa gato haṃsavimānataḥ ..
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tasyāṃtaṃ nābhyapadyata .. 21 ..
14.34.d:
ब्रह्माऽपि व्योममार्गेण गतो हंसविमानतः ..
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु तस्यांतं नाभ्यपद्यत .. 21 ..
14.34.m:
Brahmā also went along the path of the sky on his swan-vimāna;
for a thousand divine years, he did not reach its end.

14.34.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte ketakīṃ so'pyapaśyata ..
āyāṃtīṃ vyomamārgeṇa tayā pṛṣṭaścaturmukhaḥ .. 22 ..
14.34.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते केतकीं सोऽप्यपश्यत ..
आयांतीं व्योममार्गेण तया पृष्टश्चतुर्मुखः .. 22 ..
14.34.m:
Then, at the end of a thousand years, he saw a ketakī [flower]
coming along the path of the sky; and the Four-faced One was asked by her:

14.34.s:
kva tvayā gamyate brahmannirālaṃbe mahāpathi ..
śūnye tattvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 23 ..
14.34.d:
क्व त्वया गम्यते ब्रह्मन्निरालंबे महापथि ..
शून्ये तत्त्वं समाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 23 ..
14.34.m:
"Where are you going, O Brahmā, on this great path devoid of support,
in the void? Tell me the truth, for my curiosity is indeed great."

14.34.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
mama spardhā samutpannā viṣṇunā saha śobhane ..
liṃgasyāsya hi paryaṃtaṃ yo labhiṣyati cāvayoḥ .. 24 ..
14.34.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मम स्पर्धा समुत्पन्ना विष्णुना सह शोभने ..
लिंगस्यास्य हि पर्यंतं यो लभिष्यति चावयोः .. 24 ..
14.34.m:
Brahmā said:
"A rivalry has arisen between me and Viṣṇu, O fair one:
whoever among the two of us finds the end of this liṅga,

14.34.s:
sa jyāyānitaro hīno hyetaduktaṃ pinākinā ..
prasthito'haṃ tataścorddhvamadhomārgaṃ gato hariḥ .. 25 ..
14.34.d:
स ज्यायानितरो हीनो ह्येतदुक्तं पिनाकिना ..
प्रस्थितोऽहं ततश्चोर्द्ध्वमधोमार्गं गतो हरिः .. 25 ..
14.34.m:
he will be the elder, the other inferior—thus it was spoken by the bearer of the Pināka.
Then I departed upward, and Hari went along the downward path.

14.34.s:
labdhvā liṃgasya paryaṃtaṃ yāsyāmi kṣitimaṃḍale ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tatpuṣpamabhyabhāṣata .. 26 ..
14.34.d:
लब्ध्वा लिंगस्य पर्यंतं यास्यामि क्षितिमंडले ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तत्पुष्पमभ्यभाषत .. 26 ..
14.34.m:
Having found the end of the liṅga, I will go back to the circle of the earth."
Hearing those words of his, that flower said:

14.34.s:
vyarthaśramo'si lokeśa nāṃto liṃgasya vidyate ..
caturyugasahasrāṇāṃ koṭirekā pitāmaha .. 27 ..
14.34.d:
व्यर्थश्रमोऽसि लोकेश नांतो लिंगस्य विद्यते ..
चतुर्युगसहस्राणां कोटिरेका पितामह .. 27 ..
14.34.m:
"Your effort is in vain, O lord of the world! There is no end to the liṅga.
One crore of thousands of four-age cycles [has passed], O Grandfather,

14.34.s:
liṃgamūrdhnaḥ pataṃtyā me kālo jāto mahādyute ..
tathāpi kṣiti pṛṣṭhaṃ tu na prāptāsmi kathaṃcana .. 28 ..
14.34.d:
लिंगमूर्ध्नः पतंत्या मे कालो जातो महाद्युते ..
तथापि क्षिति पृष्ठं तु न प्राप्तास्मि कथंचन .. 28 ..
14.34.m:
since the time I have been falling from the top of the liṅga, O you of great splendor;
even so, I have not reached the surface of the earth by any means!

14.34.s:
yāvatkālena haṃsaste yojanaṃ saṃpragacchati ..
tāvatkālena gacchāmi yojanānāmahaṃ śatam .. 29 ..
14.34.d:
यावत्कालेन हंसस्ते योजनं संप्रगच्छति ..
तावत्कालेन गच्छामि योजनानामहं शतम् .. 29 ..
14.34.m:
In the time that your swan travels a single yojana,
in that same time I travel a hundred yojanas.

14.34.s:
tasmānnivartanaṃ yuktaṃ mama vākyena te vibho ..
darśayitvā ca māṃ viṣṇorjyeṣṭhatvaṃ vraja sāṃpratam .. 7.3.34.30 ..
14.34.d:
तस्मान्निवर्तनं युक्तं मम वाक्येन ते विभो ..
दर्शयित्वा च मां विष्णोर्ज्येष्ठत्वं व्रज सांप्रतम् .. 7.3.34.30 ..
14.34.m:
Therefore, turning back is proper for you on my advice, O lord;
and having shown me to Viṣṇu, attain the status of the elder now."

14.34.s:
tato hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā gṛhītvā tāṃ caturmukhaḥ ..
punarvarṣasahasrāṃte bhūmipṛṣṭhamupāgataḥ ..
darśayāmāsa tāṃ viṣṇoreṣā liṃgasya mūrdhataḥ .. 31 ..
14.34.d:
ततो हृष्टमना भूत्वा गृहीत्वा तां चतुर्मुखः ..
पुनर्वर्षसहस्रांते भूमिपृष्ठमुपागतः ..
दर्शयामास तां विष्णोरेषा लिंगस्य मूर्धतः .. 31 ..
14.34.m:
Then, becoming delighted in mind and taking her, the Four-faced One
arrived back at the surface of the earth at the end of another thousand years.
He showed her to Viṣṇu, [saying,] "From the top of the liṅga

14.34.s:
mayā''nītā śubhā mālā labdhaścāṃtaṃ caturbhuja ..
tvayā labdho na cāsatyaṃ vada me puruṣottama .. 32 ..
14.34.d:
मया'ऽनीता शुभा माला लब्धश्चांतं चतुर्भुज ..
त्वया लब्धो न चासत्यं वद मे पुरुषोत्तम .. 32 ..
14.34.m:
this auspicious garland was brought by me, and the end was found, O four-armed one!
Did you find it, or not? Speak the truth to me, O Puruṣottama."

14.34.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
anaṃtasyāprameyasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ ..
nāhaṃ śaktaḥ paraṃ pāraṃ gaṃtuṃ brahmankathaṃcana .. 33 ..
14.34.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
अनंतस्याप्रमेयस्य देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ..
नाहं शक्तः परं पारं गंतुं ब्रह्मन्कथंचन .. 33 ..
14.34.m:
Viṣṇu said:
"To the endless, immeasurable god of gods, the bearer of the trident,
I was not able to reach the supreme end by any means, O Brahmā.

14.34.s:
yadi tvayā'sya paryaṃto labdho brahmankathaṃcana ..
tatte tuṣṭiṃ gato nūnaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 34 ..
14.34.d:
यदि त्वयाऽस्य पर्यंतो लब्धो ब्रह्मन्कथंचन ..
तत्ते तुष्टिं गतो नूनं देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 34 ..
14.34.m:
If its end has been found by you somehow, O Brahmā,
then the god of gods, Maheśvara, has truly become pleased with you.

14.34.s:
nānyathā cāsya paryaṃto dṛśyate kena citkvacit ..
tasmājjyeṣṭho bhavāñchreṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭho'hamasaṃśayam .. 35 ..
14.34.d:
नान्यथा चास्य पर्यंतो दृश्यते केन चित्क्वचित् ..
तस्माज्ज्येष्ठो भवाञ्छ्रेष्ठः कनिष्ठोऽहमसंशयम् .. 35 ..
14.34.m:
Otherwise, its end is not seen by anyone anywhere;
therefore, you are the elder and the superior; I am the younger, without doubt."

14.34.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
kopaṃ cakre mahārāja brahmāṇaṃ prati tatkṣaṇāt .. 36 ..
14.34.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
कोपं चक्रे महाराज ब्रह्माणं प्रति तत्क्षणात् .. 36 ..
14.34.m:
Pulastya said:
At that very moment, the Blessed One who bears the bull upon his banner
instantly showed anger toward Brahmā, O great king.

14.34.s:
athāha darśanaṃ gatvā dhigdhigvyarthaprajalpaka ..
mithyā prajalpamānena kimidaṃ sāhasaṃ kṛtam .. .. 37 ..
14.34.d:
अथाह दर्शनं गत्वा धिग्धिग्व्यर्थप्रजल्पक ..
मिथ्या प्रजल्पमानेन किमिदं साहसं कृतम् .. .. 37 ..
14.34.m:
Then, coming into sight, he said: "Fie! Fie, you babbler of useless things!
While speaking falsely, what is this rash act that has been done?

14.34.s:
yasmāttvayā mṛṣā proktaṃ mama paryaṃtadarśanam ..
tasmāttvaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ pūjārho na bhaviṣyasi .. 38 ..
14.34.d:
यस्मात्त्वया मृषा प्रोक्तं मम पर्यंतदर्शनम् ..
तस्मात्त्वं सर्ववर्णानां पूजार्हो न भविष्यसि .. 38 ..
14.34.m:
Because you have falsely spoken of seeing my end,
therefore you shall not be worthy of worship by all castes.

14.34.s:
ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavā moha saṃyutāḥ ..
te kṛcchraṃ paramaṃ prāpya nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 39 ..
14.34.d:
ये च त्वां पूजयिष्यंति मानवा मोह संयुताः ..
ते कृच्छ्रं परमं प्राप्य नाशं यास्यंति कृत्स्नशः .. 39 ..
14.34.m:
And whatever human beings, overcome with delusion, shall worship you,
they, meeting with the greatest distress, shall meet with utter destruction.

14.34.s:
ketakyā ca tathā proktaṃ yasmāttasmātsuduṣṭayā ..
asyā hi sparśanāllokaḥ śvapākatvaṃ prayāsyati .. 7.3.34.40 ..
14.34.d:
केतक्या च तथा प्रोक्तं यस्मात्तस्मात्सुदुष्टया ..
अस्या हि स्पर्शनाल्लोकः श्वपाकत्वं प्रयास्यति .. 7.3.34.40 ..
14.34.m:
And since [a false testimony] was likewise spoken by the ketakī, the extremely wicked one,
therefore, by touching her, a person shall attain the state of an outcaste."

14.34.s:
evaṃ śāpo tayordattvā devaḥ provāca keśavam ..
prasannavadano bhūtvā tadā tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 41 ..
14.34.d:
एवं शापो तयोर्दत्त्वा देवः प्रोवाच केशवम् ..
प्रसन्नवदनो भूत्वा तदा तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 41 ..
14.34.m:
Having thus given a curse to the two of them, the god spoke to Keśava;
having become bright-faced, Maheśvara was then pleased.

14.34.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
vāsudeva mahābāho tuṣṭaste'haṃ mahāmate..
satyasaṃbhāṣaṇādeva varaṃ varaya suvrata ..42..
14.34.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
वासुदेव महाबाहो तुष्टस्तेऽहं महामते..
सत्यसंभाषणादेव वरं वरय सुव्रत ..42..
14.34.m:
The Blessed One said:
"O Vāsudeva, mighty-armed one! I am pleased with you, O highly intelligent one!
Just because you spoke the truth, choose a boon, O one of good vows."

14.34.s:
.. śrīvāsudeva uvāca.. ..
eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yattvaṃ tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
na cāpuṇyavatāṃ deva tvaṃ tuṣṭimadhigacchasi ..
avaśyaṃ yadi me deyo varo deveśvara tvayā ..43..
14.34.d:
.. श्रीवासुदेव उवाच.. ..
एष एव वरः श्लाघ्यो यत्त्वं तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
न चापुण्यवतां देव त्वं तुष्टिमधिगच्छसि ..
अवश्यं यदि मे देयो वरो देवेश्वर त्वया ..43..
14.34.m:
Śrī Vāsudeva said:
"This alone is the praiseworthy boon, that you are pleased, O Maheśvara;
and toward the unmeritorious, O god, you do not attain pleasure.
If a boon must certainly be given to me by you, O lord of gods,

14.34.s:
liṃgametadanaṃtākhyaṃ laghutāṃ naya mā ciram..
yena sṛṣṭirbhavelloke vyāptaṃ viśvamanena tu .. 44 ..
14.34.d:
लिंगमेतदनंताख्यं लघुतां नय मा चिरम्..
येन सृष्टिर्भवेल्लोके व्याप्तं विश्वमनेन तु .. 44 ..
14.34.m:
bring this liṅga, called endless, to smallness without delay,
so that there may be creation in the world, for by this the universe is pervaded."

14.34.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ saṃkṣipya talliṃgaṃ laghu kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ ..
abravītkeśavaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vākyamidaṃ hare .. 45 ..
14.34.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततः संक्षिप्य तल्लिंगं लघु कृत्वा महेश्वरः ..
अब्रवीत्केशवं भूयः शृणु वाक्यमिदं हरे .. 45 ..
14.34.m:
Pulastya said:
Then, having compressed that liṅga and made it small, Maheśvara
said to Keśava once more: "Listen to these words, O Hari:

14.34.s:
etanmedhyatame deśe liṃgaṃ sthāpaya me hare ..
pūjaya tvaṃ vidhānena paraṃ śreyaḥ prapatsyase .. 46 ..
14.34.d:
एतन्मेध्यतमे देशे लिंगं स्थापय मे हरे ..
पूजय त्वं विधानेन परं श्रेयः प्रपत्स्यसे .. 46 ..
14.34.m:
'Establish this liṅga of mine in the purest region, O Hari!
Worship it according to the rule; you shall attain supreme welfare.'

14.34.s:
mama tejovinirdagdhaḥ kṛṣṇatvaṃ hi yato gataḥ ..
kṛṣṇa eva tato nāma loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. 47 ..
14.34.d:
मम तेजोविनिर्दग्धः कृष्णत्वं हि यतो गतः ..
कृष्ण एव ततो नाम लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. 47 ..
14.34.m:
"Since, completely scorched by my radiance, you became black,
therefore the name 'Kṛṣṇa' ('the Black One') shall indeed become famous in the world.

14.34.s:
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti te nāma prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ..
kīrtayiṣyati yo bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ..48..
14.34.d:
कृष्णकृष्णेति ते नाम प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ..
कीर्तयिष्यति यो भक्त्या स याति परमां गतिम् ..48..
14.34.m:
Rising in the morning, which human being with devotion
shall recite your name as 'Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa', he goes to the supreme state."

14.34.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā tamīśānastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
vāsudevo'pi talliṃgaṃ gṛhītvā'rbudaparvate ..
nirjhare sthāpayāmāsa supuṇye vimalodake .. 49 ..
14.34.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा तमीशानस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
वासुदेवोऽपि तल्लिंगं गृहीत्वाऽर्बुदपर्वते ..
निर्झरे स्थापयामास सुपुण्ये विमलोदके .. 49 ..
14.34.m:
Pulastya said:
Having spoken thus to him, Īśāna disappeared right there.
Vāsudeva too, having taken that liṅga on Mount Arbuda,
installed it in a waterfall that was very holy and had pure water.

14.34.s:
kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ tato jātaṃ nāmnā hi dharaṇītale ..
śṛṇu pārthivaśārdūla tatra snātasya yatphalam .. 7.3.34.50 ..
14.34.d:
कृष्णतीर्थं ततो जातं नाम्ना हि धरणीतले ..
शृणु पार्थिवशार्दूल तत्र स्नातस्य यत्फलम् .. 7.3.34.50 ..
14.34.m:
From that, it became known indeed on the earth's surface by the name Kṛṣṇatīrtha.
Listen, O tiger among kings, to the fruit of one who has bathed there:

14.34.s:
snātvā kṛṣṇahrade puṇye talliṃgaṃ paśyate tu yaḥ ..
sarvatīrthodbhavaṃ śreyaḥ sa marttyo labhate'khilam .. 51 ..
14.34.d:
स्नात्वा कृष्णह्रदे पुण्ये तल्लिंगं पश्यते तु यः ..
सर्वतीर्थोद्भवं श्रेयः स मर्त्त्यो लभतेऽखिलम् .. 51 ..
14.34.m:
Having bathed in the holy pool of Kṛṣṇa, whoever sees that liṅga,
that mortal attains all the welfare arising from all sacred fords.

14.34.s:
tathā ca sarvadānānāṃ niṣkāmaḥ prāpnuyātphalam ..
sakāmo'pi phalaṃ ceṣṭaṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham .. 52 ..
14.34.d:
तथा च सर्वदानानां निष्कामः प्राप्नुयात्फलम् ..
सकामोऽपि फलं चेष्टं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम् .. 52 ..
14.34.m:
And likewise, without desire, he would obtain the fruit of all gifts;
and even with desire, [he would obtain] the desired fruit, even if it were very hard to attain.

14.34.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
ya icchecchāśvataṃ śreyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 53 ..
14.34.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
य इच्छेच्छाश्वतं श्रेयो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 53 ..
14.34.m:
Therefore, one should take a bath there with all effort;
whoever desires eternal welfare, here no doubt should be made.

14.34.s:
ekādaśyāṃ mahārāja nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ ..
yastatra jāgaraṃ kṛtvā liṃgasyāgre subhaktitaḥ .. 54 ..
14.34.d:
एकादश्यां महाराज निराहारो जितेन्द्रियः ..
यस्तत्र जागरं कृत्वा लिंगस्याग्रे सुभक्तितः .. 54 ..
14.34.m:
On the eleventh day [of the lunar fortnight], O great king, fasting, with senses subdued,
whoever, having kept a vigil there before the liṅga with great devotion,

14.34.s:
prabhāte kurute śrāddhaṃ yastu śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
pitṛnsaṃtārayetsarvānpūrvajaiḥ saha dharmavit .. 55 ..
14.34.d:
प्रभाते कुरुते श्राद्धं यस्तु श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
पितृन्संतारयेत्सर्वान्पूर्वजैः सह धर्मवित् .. 55 ..
14.34.m:
performs a śrāddha at dawn, endowed with faith,
that knower of dharma delivers all ancestors together with their forebears.

14.34.s:
tilānkṛṣṇānnarastatra brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ ..
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ sa marttyo mucyate dhruvam .. .. 56 ..
14.34.d:
तिलान्कृष्णान्नरस्तत्र ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददाति यः ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः पापैः स मर्त्त्यो मुच्यते ध्रुवम् .. .. 56 ..
14.34.m: The man who gives black sesame seeds to brahmins there, / that mortal is surely freed from sins such as killing a brahmin.

14.34.s:
darśanādeva rājendra kṛṣṇatīrthasya mānavaḥ ..
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 57 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe kṛṣṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 34 ..
14.34.d:
दर्शनादेव राजेन्द्र कृष्णतीर्थस्य मानवः ..
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 57 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे कृष्णतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 34 ..
14.34.m:
O king of kings, simply by the darśana of Kṛṣṇatīrtha, / a human being is freed from all sins; there should be no doubt about this.
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Kṛṣṇatīrtha,' in the third Arbuda section of the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the Mahāpurāṇa composed by Skanda containing eighty-one thousand verses.

14.35.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
māmuhradamiti khyātaṃ tasminparvatarodhasi .. 1 ..
14.35.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
मामुह्रदमिति ख्यातं तस्मिन्पर्वतरोधसि .. 1 ..
14.35.m: Pulastya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the sin-destroying sacred ford / known as Māmuhrada, on that mountain slope.

14.35.s:
tatra snāto naraḥ samyakchraddhāvānsusamāhitaḥ ..
mucyate pātakairghoraiḥ pūrvajanmakṛtairapi .. 2 ..
14.35.d:
तत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यक्छ्रद्धावान्सुसमाहितः ..
मुच्यते पातकैर्घोरैः पूर्वजन्मकृतैरपि .. 2 ..
14.35.m: A man who bathes there properly, full of faith and well concentrated, / is freed from dreadful sins, even those committed in a previous life.

14.35.s:
tasya paścimadigbhāge liṃgamasti mahīpate ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sthāpitaṃ mudgalena tu .. 3 ..
14.35.d:
तस्य पश्चिमदिग्भागे लिंगमस्ति महीपते ..
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां स्थापितं मुद्गलेन तु .. 3 ..
14.35.m: To the west of it, O lord of the earth, there is a liṅga / that grants all desires to mortals, installed by Mudgala.

14.35.s:
snātvā māmuhrade puṇye yastalliṃgaṃ ca paśyati ..
śuklapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ phālgune māsi mānavaḥ ..
sa prāpnoti paraṃ śreyaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu durlabham .. 4 ..
14.35.d:
स्नात्वा मामुह्रदे पुण्ये यस्तल्लिंगं च पश्यति ..
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्द्दश्यां फाल्गुने मासि मानवः ..
स प्राप्नोति परं श्रेयः सर्वतीर्थेषु दुर्लभम् .. 4 ..
14.35.m: A man who bathes in the holy Māmuhrada and sees that liṅga / on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Phālguna, / attains the highest good, hard to obtain in any sacred ford.

14.35.s:
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ mūrtimāśritaḥ ..
pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam.. 5 ..
14.35.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं दक्षिणां मूर्तिमाश्रितः ..
पितरस्तस्य तृप्यंति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्.. 5 ..
14.35.m: One who performs a śrāddha there, resorting to the southern form, / his ancestors are satisfied until the dissolution of all beings.

14.35.s:
tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti nīvārāṇāṃ maharṣayaḥ ..
śākamūlādibhiḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭidaṃ nṛpa .. 6 ..
14.35.d:
तत्र दानं प्रशंसंति नीवाराणां महर्षयः ..
शाकमूलादिभिः श्राद्धं पितॄणां तुष्टिदं नृप .. 6 ..
14.35.m: There the great seers praise the gift of wild rice; / a śrāddha with herbs, roots, and the like brings satisfaction to the ancestors, O king.

14.35.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
māmuhradamiti vibho kathaṃ nāmā'bhavatpurā ..
mudgalasyāśramaṃ brūhi mama sarvaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 7 .. ..
14.35.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
मामुह्रदमिति विभो कथं नामाऽभवत्पुरा ..
मुद्गलस्याश्रमं ब्रूहि मम सर्वं विधानतः .. 7 .. ..
14.35.m: Yayāti said: / O lord, how did it come to be named Māmuhrada in the past? / Tell me all according to rule about Mudgala's hermitage.

14.35.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tatrasthasya purā rājanmudgalasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vimānaṃ varamādāya devadūtaḥ samāgataḥ .. 8 ..
14.35.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तत्रस्थस्य पुरा राजन्मुद्गलस्य महात्मनः ..
विमानं वरमादाय देवदूतः समागतः .. 8 ..
14.35.m: Pulastya said: / In the past, O king, while the great-souled Mudgala resided there, / a messenger of the gods arrived, bringing an excellent aerial chariot.

14.35.s:
so'bravīddevarājñāhaṃ preṣito munisattama ..
tavārthāyā''ruhainaṃ tvaṃ vimānaṃ gamyatāṃ divi.. 9 ..
14.35.d:
सोऽब्रवीद्देवराज्ञाहं प्रेषितो मुनिसत्तम ..
तवार्थाया'ऽरुहैनं त्वं विमानं गम्यतां दिवि.. 9 ..
14.35.m: He said: 'O best of sages, I have been sent by the king of the gods / for your sake. Mount this aerial chariot; go to heaven!'

14.35.s:
.. mudgala uvāca .. ..
svargasya ye guṇā dūta ye ca doṣā prakīrtitāḥ ...
tānme vada kariṣye'haṃ śrutvā vai yatkṣamaṃ bhavet.. 7.3.35.10 ..
14.35.d:
.. मुद्गल उवाच .. ..
स्वर्गस्य ये गुणा दूत ये च दोषा प्रकीर्तिताः ...
तान्मे वद करिष्येऽहं श्रुत्वा वै यत्क्षमं भवेत्.. 7.3.35.10 ..
14.35.m: Mudgala said: / 'O messenger, tell me the virtues of heaven and its faults that are proclaimed; / having heard them, I will do what is proper.'

14.35.s: brūhi tānsakalāndūta tvāgamiṣyāmyahaṃ tataḥ .. 11 ..
14.35.d: ब्रूहि तान्सकलान्दूत त्वागमिष्याम्यहं ततः .. 11 ..
14.35.m: 'Tell them all to me, O messenger; then I will go with you.'

14.35.s:
.. devadūta uvāca.. ..
alametena darpeṇa kriyatāṃ śakrajalpitam..
puṇyaiḥ svakairdvijaśreṣṭha samāgaccheridaṃ tataḥ .. 12 ..
14.35.d:
.. देवदूत उवाच.. ..
अलमेतेन दर्पेण क्रियतां शक्रजल्पितम्..
पुण्यैः स्वकैर्द्विजश्रेष्ठ समागच्छेरिदं ततः .. 12 ..
14.35.m: The messenger of the gods said: / 'Enough of this pride! Let Indra’s bidding be done. / Through your own merits, O best of the twice-born, you must then come here.'

14.35.s:
.. mudgala uvāca .. ..
aśrutaistairna gacche'hametanme hṛdi niścitam ..
kariṣye'haṃ tapo bhūri pūjayiṣye maheśvaram .. 13 ..
14.35.d:
.. मुद्गल उवाच .. ..
अश्रुतैस्तैर्न गच्छेऽहमेतन्मे हृदि निश्चितम् ..
करिष्येऽहं तपो भूरि पूजयिष्ये महेश्वरम् .. 13 ..
14.35.m: Mudgala said: / 'Without having heard them, I will not go; this is resolved in my heart. / I will perform vast austerity; I will worship Maheśvara.'

14.35.s:
.. dūta uvāca .. ..
na śaktaḥ svarguṇānvaktumapi varṣaśatairapi ..
saṃkṣepātkathayiṣyāmi yadi te niścayaḥ paraḥ .. 14 ..
14.35.d:
.. दूत उवाच .. ..
न शक्तः स्वर्गुणान्वक्तुमपि वर्षशतैरपि ..
संक्षेपात्कथयिष्यामि यदि ते निश्चयः परः .. 14 ..
14.35.m: The messenger said: / 'Even in hundreds of years I am not able to speak of heaven's virtues. / I will tell you in brief, if your resolve is firm.

14.35.s:
naṃdanādīni ramyāṇi tatra devavanāni ca ..
ananyasadṛśā bhogāḥ sadā tṛptirdvijottama ..45...
bubhukṣā naiva tṛṣṇā ca nidrālasye na ca prabho ..
raṃbhādyapsaraso mukhyā gaṃdharvāstuṃbarādayaḥ ..
ramayaṃti naraṃ tatra gītairnṛtyairanekaśaḥ .. 16 ..
evaṃ ca vasate tatra janaḥ svarge tapodhana ..
yāvatpuṇyakṣayastāvatpaścātpātamavāpnuyāt ..17..
eka eva mune doṣaḥ svarloke pratibhāti me ..
sa eva patanākhyastu svargiṇāṃ ca bhayāvahaḥ .. 18 ..
na puṇyaṃ labhate tatra kartuṃ vipra kathaṃcana ..
karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahmanbhogabhūmistu sā smṛtā .. 19 ..
yadatra kriyate karma śubhaṃ tatropa bhujyate ..
tathā dṛṣṭvā vimānasthānbhūridharmādisaṃyutān..7.3.35.20..
bahutejonvitānsvarge hyalpapuṇyo dvijottama ..
paścāttāpajaduḥkhena svargastho duḥkhitaḥ sadā .. 21 ..
14.35.d:
नंदनादीनि रम्याणि तत्र देववनानि च ..
अनन्यसदृशा भोगाः सदा तृप्तिर्द्विजोत्तम ..45...
बुभुक्षा नैव तृष्णा च निद्रालस्ये न च प्रभो ..
रंभाद्यप्सरसो मुख्या गंधर्वास्तुंबरादयः ..
रमयंति नरं तत्र गीतैर्नृत्यैरनेकशः .. 16 ..
एवं च वसते तत्र जनः स्वर्गे तपोधन ..
यावत्पुण्यक्षयस्तावत्पश्चात्पातमवाप्नुयात् ..17..
एक एव मुने दोषः स्वर्लोके प्रतिभाति मे ..
स एव पतनाख्यस्तु स्वर्गिणां च भयावहः .. 18 ..
न पुण्यं लभते तत्र कर्तुं विप्र कथंचन ..
कर्मभूमिरियं ब्रह्मन्भोगभूमिस्तु सा स्मृता .. 19 ..
यदत्र क्रियते कर्म शुभं तत्रोप भुज्यते ..
तथा दृष्ट्वा विमानस्थान्भूरिधर्मादिसंयुतान्..7.3.35.20..
बहुतेजोन्वितान्स्वर्गे ह्यल्पपुण्यो द्विजोत्तम ..
पश्चात्तापजदुःखेन स्वर्गस्थो दुःखितः सदा .. 21 ..
14.35.m:
There are the delightful groves of the gods, Nandana and others, / matchless pleasures, and constant satisfaction, O best of the twice-born.
There is no hunger, nor thirst, nor sleep or lethargy, O master; / principal apsarases such as Rambhā, and gandharvas such as Tumbaru, / delight a man there in many ways with songs and dances.
And so, O rich in austerity, a person dwells in heaven / as long as his merit lasts; afterwards he meets with a fall.
Only one fault appears to me in the world of heaven, O sage; / it is called falling, and it brings terror to the dwellers of heaven.
There, O brahmin, one can in no way acquire merit; / this [earth] is the realm of action, O brahmin, but that is traditionally called the realm of enjoyment.
Whatever good action is performed here is enjoyed there. / Likewise, seeing those seated in aerial chariots, endowed with abundant righteousness and the like,
endowed with great brilliance in heaven, one of little merit, O best of the twice-born, / is always miserable while dwelling in heaven, afflicted by the pain born of remorse:

14.35.s:
na mayā sukṛtaṃ bhūri kṛtaṃ marttye kathaṃcana .. 22 ..
tathā ca patamānāṃśca dṛṣṭvā cānyānsahasraśaḥ ..
ātmanaśca mahadduḥkhaṃ jāyate ca tadadbhutam.. 23 ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ guṇadoṣasamudbhavam ..
svargasaṃceṣṭitaṃ brahmankuruṣva yadabhīpsitam .. 24 ..
.. mudgala uvāca .. ..
patanasya bhayaṃ yatra puṇyahānirna varddhanam..
tena svargeṇa me dūta naiva kāryaṃ kathaṃcana.. 25..
vācyastvayā mamādeśāddevarājaḥ sphuṭaṃ vacaḥ..
kṣamyatāmaparādho me na svargāya spṛhā mama.. 26..
tatkarmā'haṃ kariṣyāmi yena no patanādbhayam..
sādhayiṣyāmi tām̐llokānye sadā pātavarjitāḥ.. 27.. ..
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā nṛpaśreṣṭha mudgalaḥ svarganiḥspṛhaḥ ..
sthitastatraiva nirataḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
14.35.d:
न मया सुकृतं भूरि कृतं मर्त्त्ये कथंचन .. 22 ..
तथा च पतमानांश्च दृष्ट्वा चान्यान्सहस्रशः ..
आत्मनश्च महद्दुःखं जायते च तदद्भुतम्.. 23 ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं गुणदोषसमुद्भवम् ..
स्वर्गसंचेष्टितं ब्रह्मन्कुरुष्व यदभीप्सितम् .. 24 ..
.. मुद्गल उवाच .. ..
पतनस्य भयं यत्र पुण्यहानिर्न वर्द्धनम्..
तेन स्वर्गेण मे दूत नैव कार्यं कथंचन.. 25..
वाच्यस्त्वया ममादेशाद्देवराजः स्फुटं वचः..
क्षम्यतामपराधो मे न स्वर्गाय स्पृहा मम.. 26..
तत्कर्माऽहं करिष्यामि येन नो पतनाद्भयम्..
साधयिष्यामि ताम्̐ल्लोकान्ये सदा पातवर्जिताः.. 27.. ..
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा नृपश्रेष्ठ मुद्गलः स्वर्गनिःस्पृहः ..
स्थितस्तत्रैव निरतः शिवध्यानपरायणः .. 28 ..
14.35.m:
'By me, no great good deed was done in the mortal world!'
And likewise, seeing thousands of others falling, / a great and dreadful grief arises within oneself.
All this arising from merits and defects has been told to you, / the working of heaven, O brahmin; do whatever you desire.'
Mudgala said: / 'Where there is fear of falling, loss of merit and no increase, / I have no need of that heaven at all, O messenger.
By my command, you must speak plain words to the king of the gods: / "May my offense be forgiven; I have no longing for heaven.
I will perform that action by which there is no fear of falling; / I will attain those worlds that are forever free from falling."'
Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, O best of kings, Mudgala, indifferent to heaven, / remained right there, devoted and intent on meditation upon Śiva.

14.35.s:
śrutvā dūto'pi śakrasya tasya vākyaṃ savistaram..
kathayāmāsa śakrasya taṃ bhūyaḥ so'bhyabhāṣata .. 29 ..
devadūtāpramāṇaṃ ca vimānaṃ hi tvayā kṛtam ..
na kṛtaṃ kena citpūrvaṃ na kariṣyati kaścana .. 7.3.35.30 ..
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gatvā balādānaya taṃ munim ..
ānayasvānyathā śāpaṃ tava dāsyāmyasaṃśayam .. 31 . ..
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā devadūte bhayānvitaḥ ..
prasthitaḥ satvaraṃ tatra mudgalo yatra tiṣṭhati .. 32 ..
mudgalo'pi vimānasthaṃ punardṛṣṭvā samāgatam ..
māmuhrade praviśyātha vārayāmāsa taṃ tadā .. 33 ..
sa tasya vacanenaiva staṃbhito likhito yathā ..
calituṃ naiva śaknoti prabhāvāttasya sanmuneḥ .. 34 ..
cirakālagataṃ jñātvā dūtaṃ tu tridaśādhipaḥ ..
svayaṃ tatrāyayau kopādāruhyairāvaṇaṃ gajam .. 35 ...
14.35.d:
श्रुत्वा दूतोऽपि शक्रस्य तस्य वाक्यं सविस्तरम्..
कथयामास शक्रस्य तं भूयः सोऽभ्यभाषत .. 29 ..
देवदूताप्रमाणं च विमानं हि त्वया कृतम् ..
न कृतं केन चित्पूर्वं न करिष्यति कश्चन .. 7.3.35.30 ..
तस्मात्तत्र द्रुतं गत्वा बलादानय तं मुनिम् ..
आनयस्वान्यथा शापं तव दास्याम्यसंशयम् .. 31 . ..
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
शक्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदूते भयान्वितः ..
प्रस्थितः सत्वरं तत्र मुद्गलो यत्र तिष्ठति .. 32 ..
मुद्गलोऽपि विमानस्थं पुनर्दृष्ट्वा समागतम् ..
मामुह्रदे प्रविश्याथ वारयामास तं तदा .. 33 ..
स तस्य वचनेनैव स्तंभितो लिखितो यथा ..
चलितुं नैव शक्नोति प्रभावात्तस्य सन्मुनेः .. 34 ..
चिरकालगतं ज्ञात्वा दूतं तु त्रिदशाधिपः ..
स्वयं तत्राययौ कोपादारुह्यैरावणं गजम् .. 35 ...
14.35.m:
Having heard his words in detail, the messenger of Indra too / related them to Indra; he spoke to him once more:
'"You made the divine messenger and the aerial chariot disregarded; / this has never been done by anyone before, nor will anyone do it.
Therefore, go there quickly and bring that sage by force! / Bring him, otherwise I will curse you, without a doubt!"' / Pulastya said: / Having heard Indra's words, the messenger of the gods, filled with fear, / set out swiftly to where Mudgala was staying.
Seeing him arrived again, seated in the aerial chariot, / Mudgala then entered Māmuhrada and stopped him.
By his word alone, he was paralyzed like a painted figure; / he could not move at all, through the power of that noble sage.
Knowing that the messenger had been gone for a long time, the lord of the gods / came there himself in anger, riding on the elephant Airāvaṇa.

14.35.s:
atha dṛṣṭvā tadā dūtaṃ staṃbhitaṃ mudgalena tu ..
vadhārthaṃ tūdyatastasya sa vajraṃ bhrāmayaṃstadā .. 36 ..
etasminneva kāle tu utpātāstatra dāruṇāḥ ..
apasavyaṃ mṛgāścakruḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaśca ye ..
tāndṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa mudgalo vismayānvitaḥ .. 37 ..
atha dṛṣṭvāṃbaragataṃ vajrodyatakaraṃ harim ..
staṃbhayāmāsa taṃ sadyo dṛṣṭipātena mudgalaḥ .. 38 ..
tatra śakraḥ stutiṃ cakre bhagnotsāho nṛpottama ..
muñca māṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha yāsyāmi tridaśālayam .. 39 ..
svarge vā yadi vā marttye tiṣṭha tvaṃ svecchayā dvija ..
mayā kṛtaḥ samudyogo hitārthaṃ te mune hyayam .. 7.3.35.40 ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yo manasi sthitaḥ ..
taṃ te sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 41 ..
14.35.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वा तदा दूतं स्तंभितं मुद्गलेन तु ..
वधार्थं तूद्यतस्तस्य स वज्रं भ्रामयंस्तदा .. 36 ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु उत्पातास्तत्र दारुणाः ..
अपसव्यं मृगाश्चक्रुः पशवः पक्षिणश्च ये ..
तान्दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास मुद्गलो विस्मयान्वितः .. 37 ..
अथ दृष्ट्वांबरगतं वज्रोद्यतकरं हरिम् ..
स्तंभयामास तं सद्यो दृष्टिपातेन मुद्गलः .. 38 ..
तत्र शक्रः स्तुतिं चक्रे भग्नोत्साहो नृपोत्तम ..
मुञ्च मां ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ यास्यामि त्रिदशालयम् .. 39 ..
स्वर्गे वा यदि वा मर्त्त्ये तिष्ठ त्वं स्वेच्छया द्विज ..
मया कृतः समुद्योगो हितार्थं ते मुने ह्ययम् .. 7.3.35.40 ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते नित्यं यो मनसि स्थितः ..
तं ते सर्वं प्रदास्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 41 ..
14.35.m:
Then, seeing the messenger paralyzed by Mudgala, / he prepared to kill him, whirling his thunderbolt at that moment.
At that very time, dreadful portents occurred there; / deer, beasts, and birds moved to the left; / seeing them, Mudgala was filled with astonishment and reflected.
Then, seeing Hari in the sky with his thunderbolt raised in his hand, / Mudgala instantly paralyzed him with a mere cast of his glance.
There Śakra, his enthusiasm broken, uttered praise, O best of kings: / 'Release me, O best of brahmins! I will go to the abode of the gods.
Live at your own will, O twice-born, whether in heaven or on earth! / Indeed, this effort was made by me for your welfare, O sage.
Choose a boon—may it be well with you—whatever is constantly in your mind. / I will grant all of that to you, even if it be very difficult to attain.'

14.35.s:
.. mudgala uvāca .. ..
eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yattvaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sureśvara ..
darśanaṃ te sahasrākṣa svapneṣvapi sudurlabham .. 42 ..
avaśyaṃ yadi me deyo varo vṛtraniṣūdana ..
tvatprasādena me mokṣo jāyatāṃ śīghrameva hi .. 43 ..
mā mu hradaṃ samāgatya dūtaḥ prokto mayā yataḥ ..
tato māmuhradamiti khyātiṃ yātu dharātale .. 44 ..
tīrthametatsahasrākṣa sarva pāpapraṇāśanam ..
atra snātvā divaṃ yāṃtu tvatprasādātsureśvara .. 45 ..
14.35.d:
.. मुद्गल उवाच .. ..
एष एव वरः श्लाघ्यो यत्त्वं दृष्टः सुरेश्वर ..
दर्शनं ते सहस्राक्ष स्वप्नेष्वपि सुदुर्लभम् .. 42 ..
अवश्यं यदि मे देयो वरो वृत्रनिषूदन ..
त्वत्प्रसादेन मे मोक्षो जायतां शीघ्रमेव हि .. 43 ..
मा मु ह्रदं समागत्य दूतः प्रोक्तो मया यतः ..
ततो मामुह्रदमिति ख्यातिं यातु धरातले .. 44 ..
तीर्थमेतत्सहस्राक्ष सर्व पापप्रणाशनम् ..
अत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यांतु त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेश्वर .. 45 ..
14.35.m:
Mudgala said: / 'This alone is a praiseworthy boon, that you have been seen, O lord of the gods! / The darśana of you, O thousand-eyed one, is difficult to attain even in dreams.
If a boon must certainly be given to me, O slayer of Vṛtra, / then through your grace let liberation quickly arise for me!
Since the messenger was told by me, having arrived at this pool, "Do not [lead] me!", / therefore let it become known as "Māmuhrada" on the surface of the earth.
This sacred ford, O thousand-eyed one, destroys all sins. / Having bathed here, let [men] go to heaven through your grace, O lord of the gods!

14.35.s: piṇḍadānātparāṃ prītiṃ labhaṃtāṃ pitaro'tra hi .. 46 ..
14.35.d: पिण्डदानात्परां प्रीतिं लभंतां पितरोऽत्र हि .. 46 ..
14.35.m: And from the offering of the funeral ball here, let the ancestors attain supreme joy!'

14.35.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
māmuhradamiti khyātaṃ tīrthametadbhaviṣyati ..
variṣṭhaṃ nātra sandeho matprasādādvijottama .. 47 ..
14.35.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
मामुह्रदमिति ख्यातं तीर्थमेतद्भविष्यति ..
वरिष्ठं नात्र सन्देहो मत्प्रसादाद्विजोत्तम .. 47 ..
14.35.m: Indra said: / 'This sacred ford shall become renowned as Māmuhrada, / the most excellent—there is no doubt here—through my grace, O best of the twice-born!

14.35.s:
atra ye phālgune māsi paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitāḥ ..
kariṣyaṃti punaḥ snānaṃ te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim .. 48 ..
14.35.d:
अत्र ये फाल्गुने मासि पौर्णमास्यां समाहिताः ..
करिष्यंति पुनः स्नानं ते यास्यंति परां गतिम् .. 48 ..
14.35.m: Those who, being concentrated, will perform a ritual ablution here / on the full-moon day in the month of Phālguna, will go to the supreme state.

14.35.s:
piṇḍadānādgayātulyaṃ lapsyaṃte phalamuttamam ..
puṇyadānaphalaṃ cātra saṃkhyāhīnaṃ dvijottama .. 49 ..
14.35.d:
पिण्डदानाद्गयातुल्यं लप्स्यंते फलमुत्तमम् ..
पुण्यदानफलं चात्र संख्याहीनं द्विजोत्तम .. 49 ..
14.35.m: From the offering of a funeral ball they shall obtain the highest fruit, equal to Gayā, / and the fruit of giving gifts here is countless, O best of the twice-born.'

14.35.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā yayau svargaṃ dūtamādāya vajrabhṛt ..
mudgalo'pi paraṃ brahma ciṃtayanhyaniśaṃ tataḥ .. 7.3.35.50 ..
14.35.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ स्वर्गं दूतमादाय वज्रभृत् ..
मुद्गलोऽपि परं ब्रह्म चिंतयन्ह्यनिशं ततः .. 7.3.35.50 ..
14.35.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, the thunderbolt-bearer went to heaven, taking the messenger. / Mudgala too, unceasingly meditating on the supreme Brahman from then on,

14.35.s: śukladhyānaparo bhūtvā mokṣaṃ prāptastato'kṣayam .. 51 ..
14.35.d: शुक्लध्यानपरो भूत्वा मोक्षं प्राप्तस्ततोऽक्षयम् .. 51 ..
14.35.m: and devoted to pure meditation, attained imperishable liberation thereafter.

14.35.s:
atra gāthā purā gītā nāradena mahātmanā ..
bahuviprasamavāye parvatesminmahīpate .. 52 ..
14.35.d:
अत्र गाथा पुरा गीता नारदेन महात्मना ..
बहुविप्रसमवाये पर्वतेस्मिन्महीपते .. 52 ..
14.35.m: Here a verse was sung of old by the great-souled Nārada / in an assembly of many brahmins on this mountain, O lord of the earth:

14.35.s:
māmu hrade naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā taṃ mudgaleśvaram ..
iha bhuktvā'khilānkāmānante muktimavāpsyati ..
etasmātkāraṇādrājanmāmuhradamiti smṛtam .. 53 ..
14.35.d:
मामु ह्रदे नरः स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वा तं मुद्गलेश्वरम् ..
इह भुक्त्वाऽखिलान्कामानन्ते मुक्तिमवाप्स्यति ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्राजन्मामुह्रदमिति स्मृतम् .. 53 ..
14.35.m: 'A man, having bathed in Māmuhrada and seen that Mudgaleśvara, / will enjoy all desires in this world and at the end attain liberation.' / For this reason, O king, it is remembered as Māmuhrada.

14.35.s:
tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ lokaviśrutam ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret .. 54 ..
14.35.d:
तत्तीर्थं सर्वतीर्थानां प्रवरं लोकविश्रुतम् ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् .. 54 ..
14.35.m: That sacred ford is the best of all sacred fords, renowned in the world; / therefore one should perform a ritual ablution there with every effort.

14.35.s:
mokṣakāmo viśeṣeṇa ya icchetparamaṃ padam ..
caṇḍikāśramamāsādya kiṃ punaḥ paritapyate .. 55 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame'rbudakhaṇḍe māmuhradotpattivarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 35 ..
14.35.d:
मोक्षकामो विशेषेण य इच्छेत्परमं पदम् ..
चण्डिकाश्रममासाद्य किं पुनः परितप्यते .. 55 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमेऽर्बुदखण्डे मामुह्रदोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम पञ्चत्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 35 ..
14.35.m:
Especially one who desires liberation, who wishes for the supreme abode— / having reached the hermitage of Caṇḍikā, why would he suffer further?
Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of Māmuhrada', in the first Arbuda section of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.36.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
caṃḍikāyā dvijaśreṣṭha kathaṃ tatrāśramo'bhavat ..
kasminkāle phalaṃ tena kiṃ dṛṣṭena bhavennṛṇām .. 1 ..
14.36.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
चंडिकाया द्विजश्रेष्ठ कथं तत्राश्रमोऽभवत् ..
कस्मिन्काले फलं तेन किं दृष्टेन भवेन्नृणाम् .. 1 ..
14.36.m: Yayāti said: / 'O best of the twice-born, how did the hermitage of Caṇḍikā come to be there? / At what time, and what fruit would come to men when it is visited?'

14.36.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mānavaḥ samyaksarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 2 ..
14.36.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मानवः सम्यक्सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 2 ..
14.36.m: Pulastya said: / 'Listen, O king, I shall relate the sin-destroying story, / hearing which properly a mortal is freed from all sins.

14.36.s:
purā devayuge rājanmahiṣonāma dānavaḥ ..
pitāmahavarāddṛptaḥ sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ .. 3 ..
14.36.d:
पुरा देवयुगे राजन्महिषोनाम दानवः ..
पितामहवराद्दृप्तः सर्वदेवभयंकरः .. 3 ..
14.36.m: Long ago, in the age of the gods, O king, there was a Dānava named Mahiṣa, / arrogant due to a boon of the Grandfather, terrifying to all the gods.

14.36.s:
tena śakrādayo devā jitāḥ saṃkhye sahasraśaḥ ..
bhayāttasya divaṃ hitvā gatāste vai yathādiśam .. 4 ..
14.36.d:
तेन शक्रादयो देवा जिताः संख्ये सहस्रशः ..
भयात्तस्य दिवं हित्वा गतास्ते वै यथादिशम् .. 4 ..
14.36.m: By him the gods, Śakra and others, were conquered thousands of times in battle. / Out of fear of him, leaving heaven, they fled in all directions.

14.36.s: trailokyaṃ sa vaśe kṛtvā svayamindro babhūva ha .. 5 ..
14.36.d: त्रैलोक्यं स वशे कृत्वा स्वयमिन्द्रो बभूव ह .. 5 ..
14.36.m: Bringing the three worlds under his control, he himself became Indra.

14.36.s:
ādityā vasavo rudrā nāsatyau marutāṃ gaṇāḥ ..
kṛtāstena tathā daityā yathārhaṃ balavattarāḥ .. 6 ..
14.36.d:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा नासत्यौ मरुतां गणाः ..
कृतास्तेन तथा दैत्या यथार्हं बलवत्तराः .. 6 ..
14.36.m: The Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Nāsatyas, and the hosts of Maruts / were replaced appropriately by him with more powerful Daityas.

14.36.s:
vahnirbhayaṃ samāpannastyaktvā devagaṇāṃstadā ..
dānavebhyo havirbhāgaṃ devebhyo na prayacchati .. 7 ..
14.36.d:
वह्निर्भयं समापन्नस्त्यक्त्वा देवगणांस्तदा ..
दानवेभ्यो हविर्भागं देवेभ्यो न प्रयच्छति .. 7 ..
14.36.m: Agni, having become fearful and abandoning the hosts of gods, / then gave the sacrificial share to the Dānavas, not to the gods.

14.36.s:
uddyotaṃ kurute sūryo yādṛktasyābhisaṃmataḥ ..
yajñabhāgaṃ vinā'pyeṣa bhayātpārthivasattama .. 8 ..
14.36.d:
उद्द्योतं कुरुते सूर्यो यादृक्तस्याभिसंमतः ..
यज्ञभागं विनाऽप्येष भयात्पार्थिवसत्तम .. 8 ..
14.36.m: The sun made its illumination just as approved by him, / even without a share of the sacrifice, out of fear, O best of kings.

14.36.s:
lokapālāstathā sarve tasya karma pracakrire ..
dāsavatpārthivaśreṣṭha yajñabhāgaṃ vinākṛtāḥ .. .. 9 ..
14.36.d:
लोकपालास्तथा सर्वे तस्य कर्म प्रचक्रिरे ..
दासवत्पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ यज्ञभागं विनाकृताः .. .. 9 ..
14.36.m: Likewise, all the world-guardians carried out his work / like slaves, O best of kings, deprived of their sacrificial share.

14.36.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya sarve devāḥ sametya tu ..
papracchurvinayopetā vipraśreṣṭhaṃ bṛhaspatim .. 7.3.36.10 ..
14.36.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सर्वे देवाः समेत्य तु ..
पप्रच्छुर्विनयोपेता विप्रश्रेष्ठं बृहस्पतिम् .. 7.3.36.10 ..
14.36.m: Then, after some time, all the gods assembled / and humbly asked Bṛhaspati, the best of brahmins:

14.36.s:
bhagavānkiṃ vayaṃ kurmaḥ kutra yāmo nirāśrayāḥ ..
tasmādbrūhi kṣayopāyaṃ mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ .. 11 ..
14.36.d:
भगवान्किं वयं कुर्मः कुत्र यामो निराश्रयाः ..
तस्माद्ब्रूहि क्षयोपायं महिषस्य दुरात्मनः .. 11 ..
14.36.m: 'O Venerable One, what shall we do? Where shall we go, without a refuge? / Therefore tell us the means to destroy the evil-souled Mahiṣa.'

14.36.s:
evamukto gururddevairdhyātvā kālaṃ ciraṃ nṛpa ..
tatastāṃstridaśānprāha jīvayanniva bhūpateḥ .. 12 ..
14.36.d:
एवमुक्तो गुरुर्द्देवैर्ध्यात्वा कालं चिरं नृप ..
ततस्तांस्त्रिदशान्प्राह जीवयन्निव भूपतेः .. 12 ..
14.36.m: Thus addressed by the gods, the preceptor meditated for a long time, O king; / then, as if bringing them back to life, he spoke to those gods, O ruler of the earth.

14.36.s:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
brahmalabdhavaro daityaḥ pauruṣe ca vyavasthitaḥ ..
avadhyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ muktvekāṃ yoṣitaṃ surāḥ ..
vrajadhvaṃ sahitāstasmādarbudaṃ parvatottamam .. 13 ..
14.36.d:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मलब्धवरो दैत्यः पौरुषे च व्यवस्थितः ..
अवध्यः सर्वदेवानां मुक्त्वेकां योषितं सुराः ..
व्रजध्वं सहितास्तस्मादर्बुदं पर्वतोत्तमम् .. 13 ..
14.36.m: Bṛhaspati said: / 'The Daitya has obtained a boon from Brahmā and is steadfast in valor; / he is unslayable by all the gods, except by a single woman, O gods. / Therefore, go together to Arbuda, the best of mountains.

14.36.s:
tapo'rthaṃ tatra saṃsiddhirjāyatāmacirāddhi vaḥ ..
śaktirūpāṃ parāṃ devīṃ caṃḍikāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm..14..
14.36.d:
तपोऽर्थं तत्र संसिद्धिर्जायतामचिराद्धि वः ..
शक्तिरूपां परां देवीं चंडिकां कामरूपिणीम्..14..
14.36.m: For the sake of austerity, may accomplishment arise there for you without delay! / The supreme goddess in the form of Power, Caṇḍikā, who can take any form at will—

14.36.s:
ārādhayadhvamekāṃte yayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat ..
sā tuṣṭā vai vadhārthaṃ tu mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ .. 15 ..
14.36.d:
आराधयध्वमेकांते यया व्याप्तमिदं जगत् ..
सा तुष्टा वै वधार्थं तु महिषस्य दुरात्मनः .. 15 ..
14.36.m: worship her in solitude, by whom this universe is pervaded. / When she is pleased, for the slaying of the evil-minded Mahiṣa,

14.36.s:
kariṣyati samudyogamavatārasamudbhavam ..
tasyā hastena so'vaśyaṃ vadhaṃ prāpsyati durmatiḥ .. 16 ..
14.36.d:
करिष्यति समुद्योगमवतारसमुद्भवम् ..
तस्या हस्तेन सोऽवश्यं वधं प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः .. 16 ..
14.36.m: she will make an effort, arising through an incarnation; / by her hand that evil-minded one will surely meet destruction.

14.36.s:
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi śaktiyaṃ maṃtramuttamam ..
pūjāvidhānasaṃyuktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham .. 17 ... ..
14.36.d:
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि शक्तियं मंत्रमुत्तमम् ..
पूजाविधानसंयुक्तं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शुभम् .. 17 ... ..
14.36.m: I shall proclaim to you the supreme Śākta mantra, / combined with the ritual of worship, auspicious, conferring enjoyment and liberation.'

14.36.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve harṣeṇa mahatānvitāḥ ..
tenaiva sahitā rājangatāḥ parvatamarbudam .. 18 ..
14.36.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे हर्षेण महतान्विताः ..
तेनैव सहिता राजन्गताः पर्वतमर्बुदम् .. 18 ..
14.36.m: Pulastya said: / Thus addressed, all the gods, filled with great joy, / went along with him, O king, to Mount Arbuda.

14.36.s:
tatra snātāñchucīnsarvāndīkṣayāmāsa gīṣpatiḥ ..
śaktiyaiḥ paramairmaṃtraiḥ sadyaḥsiddhikarairnṛpa .. 19 ..
14.36.d:
तत्र स्नाताञ्छुचीन्सर्वान्दीक्षयामास गीष्पतिः ..
शक्तियैः परमैर्मंत्रैः सद्यःसिद्धिकरैर्नृप .. 19 ..
14.36.m: There the Lord of Speech initiated all of them, purified after bathing, / with supreme Śākta mantras that bestow immediate accomplishment, O king.

14.36.s:
sārdhayāmatrayaṃ tatra parivārasamanvitāḥ ..
balipūjopahāraiśca gaṃdhaṃ mālyānulepanaiḥ .. 7.3.36.20 ..
14.36.d:
सार्धयामत्रयं तत्र परिवारसमन्विताः ..
बलिपूजोपहारैश्च गंधं माल्यानुलेपनैः .. 7.3.36.20 ..
14.36.m: For three and a half watches there, accompanied by their attendants, / with offerings of sacrifices, worship, and presentations, with perfumes, garlands, and ointments,

14.36.s:
maṃtreṇa vividhenaiva cārustotreṇa bhaktitaḥ ..
prārthayaṃtastathā nityaṃ dīpajyotiḥ samāhitāḥ .. 21 ..
14.36.d:
मंत्रेण विविधेनैव चारुस्तोत्रेण भक्तितः ..
प्रार्थयंतस्तथा नित्यं दीपज्योतिः समाहिताः .. 21 ..
14.36.m: with diverse mantras and beautiful praises, in devotion / they constantly prayed, concentrated on the light of the lamp,

14.36.s:
nirmamā nirahaṃkārā gurubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ..
aṃganyāsasamāyuktāḥ samadarśitvamāgatāḥ ..22..
14.36.d:
निर्ममा निरहंकारा गुरुभक्तिपरायणाः ..
अंगन्याससमायुक्ताः समदर्शित्वमागताः ..22..
14.36.m: free from possessiveness, free from egotism, dedicated to devotion to their preceptor, / endowed with the assignment of mantras to bodily parts, having attained equanimity.

14.36.s:
evaṃ saṃtiṣṭhamānānāṃ teṣāṃ pārthivasattama ..
sapta māsā vyatikrāṃtāstatastuṣṭā sureśvarī .. 23 ..
14.36.d:
एवं संतिष्ठमानानां तेषां पार्थिवसत्तम ..
सप्त मासा व्यतिक्रांतास्ततस्तुष्टा सुरेश्वरी .. 23 ..
14.36.m: As they remained thus, O best of kings, / seven months passed; then the ruler of the gods became pleased.

14.36.s:
dīpajyotiḥsamāveśātteṣāṃ gātreṣu pārthiva ..
maṃtreṇa paripūtānāṃ paraṃ tejo vyavardhata .. 24 ..
14.36.d:
दीपज्योतिःसमावेशात्तेषां गात्रेषु पार्थिव ..
मंत्रेण परिपूतानां परं तेजो व्यवर्धत .. 24 ..
14.36.m: From the entry of the lamp's light into their bodies, O king, / their supreme splendor, fully purified by the mantra, grew.

14.36.s:
dvādaśārkaprabhā jātāḥ ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtareṇa te ..
atha tāṃstejasā yuktāñjñātvā jīvo mahīpate .. 25 ..
14.36.d:
द्वादशार्कप्रभा जाताः षण्मासाभ्यंतरेण ते ..
अथ तांस्तेजसा युक्ताञ्ज्ञात्वा जीवो महीपते .. 25 ..
14.36.m: Within six months they took on the radiance of twelve suns. / Then, O king, knowing them to be filled with fiery brilliance, Jīva

14.36.s:
maṃḍalaṃ racayāmāsa sarvasiddhipradāyakam ..
upaveśya tataḥ sarvānsamastāṃstridaśālayān .. 26 ..
14.36.d:
मंडलं रचयामास सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् ..
उपवेश्य ततः सर्वान्समस्तांस्त्रिदशालयान् .. 26 ..
14.36.m: drew a maṇḍala that bestows all perfections. / Then, having seated all the gods [there],

14.36.s:
teṣāṃ śarīragaṃ tejaḥ śaktiyairmaṃtrasattamaiḥ ..
ākṛṣya nyasayāmāsa maṃḍale tatra pārthiva .. 27 ..
14.36.d:
तेषां शरीरगं तेजः शक्तियैर्मंत्रसत्तमैः ..
आकृष्य न्यसयामास मंडले तत्र पार्थिव .. 27 ..
14.36.m: he drew forth the fiery splendour residing in their bodies / with supreme mantras of the goddess and placed it into that maṇḍala, O king.

14.36.s:
tatastejomayī kanyā tatra jātā svarūpiṇī ..
śaktirūpā mahākāyā divyalakṣaṇalakṣitā .. 28 ..
14.36.d:
ततस्तेजोमयी कन्या तत्र जाता स्वरूपिणी ..
शक्तिरूपा महाकाया दिव्यलक्षणलक्षिता .. 28 ..
14.36.m: Thereupon, a maiden composed of fiery energy appeared there in bodily form, / the embodiment of Śakti, huge of body and marked with divine characteristics.

14.36.s:
iṃdrastasyai dadau vajraṃ svapāśaṃ ca jaleśvaraḥ ..
śaktiṃ ca bhagavānagniḥ siṃhayānaṃ dhanādhipaḥ .. 29 ..
14.36.d:
इंद्रस्तस्यै ददौ वज्रं स्वपाशं च जलेश्वरः ..
शक्तिं च भगवानग्निः सिंहयानं धनाधिपः .. 29 ..
14.36.m: Indra gave her his thunderbolt, and the lord of waters his noose; / the divine Agni gave his spear, and the lord of wealth a lion for a mount.

14.36.s:
anye caiva gaṇāḥ sarve nijaśastrāṇi harṣitāḥ ..
tasyai dadurnṛpaśreṣṭha stutiṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ .. 7.3.36.30 ..
14.36.d:
अन्ये चैव गणाः सर्वे निजशस्त्राणि हर्षिताः ..
तस्यै ददुर्नृपश्रेष्ठ स्तुतिं चक्रुः समाहिताः .. 7.3.36.30 ..
14.36.m: And all the other hosts, full of joy, gave her their own weapons, / O best of kings, and with concentrated minds praised her:

14.36.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
namaste devadeveśi namaste kāṃcanaprabhe ..
namaste padmapatrākṣi namaste jagadambike .. 31 ..
14.36.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
नमस्ते देवदेवेशि नमस्ते कांचनप्रभे ..
नमस्ते पद्मपत्राक्षि नमस्ते जगदम्बिके .. 31 ..
14.36.m: The gods said: / 'Homage to you, goddess of the gods! Homage to you of golden radiance! / Homage to you with eyes like lotus petals! Homage to you, mother of the universe!

14.36.s:
namaste viśvarūpe ca namaste viśvasaṃstute ..
tvaṃ matistvaṃ dhṛtiḥ kāṃtistvaṃ sudhā tvaṃ vibhāvarī .. 32 ..
14.36.d:
नमस्ते विश्वरूपे च नमस्ते विश्वसंस्तुते ..
त्वं मतिस्त्वं धृतिः कांतिस्त्वं सुधा त्वं विभावरी .. 32 ..
14.36.m: Homage to you who are all-formed! Homage to you who are praised by all! / You are intellect, you are resolve, you are beauty, you are nectar, you are the night!

14.36.s:
kṣamā ṛddhiḥ prabhā svāhā sāvitrī kamalā satī ..
tvaṃ gaurī tvaṃ mahāmāyā cāmuṇḍā tvaṃ sarasvatī .. 33 ..
14.36.d:
क्षमा ऋद्धिः प्रभा स्वाहा सावित्री कमला सती ..
त्वं गौरी त्वं महामाया चामुण्डा त्वं सरस्वती .. 33 ..
14.36.m: Forbearance, prosperity, light, Svāhā, Sāvitrī, Kamalā, Satī; / you are Gaurī, you are Mahāmāyā, Cāmuṇḍā, and Sarasvatī!

14.36.s:
bhairavī bhīṣaṇākārā caṃḍamuṃḍāsidhāriṇī ..
bhūtapriyā mahākāyā ghaṭālī vikramotkaṭā .. 34 ..
14.36.d:
भैरवी भीषणाकारा चंडमुंडासिधारिणी ..
भूतप्रिया महाकाया घटाली विक्रमोत्कटा .. 34 ..
14.36.m: Bhairavī of terrifying form, bearer of the sword against Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa, / dear to spirits, huge of body, Ghaṭālī of mighty prowess!

14.36.s:
madyamāṃsapriyā nityaṃ bhaktatrāṇaparāyaṇā ..
tvayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 35 ..
14.36.d:
मद्यमांसप्रिया नित्यं भक्तत्राणपरायणा ..
त्वया व्याप्तमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 35 ..
14.36.m: Ever fond of wine and meat, devoted to protecting your worshippers; / by you this entire threefold world, moving and unmoving, is pervaded!'

14.36.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evaṃ stutā suraiḥ sarvaistato devī praharṣitā ..
tānabravīdvaraṃ sarvā gṛhṇaṃtu mama devatāḥ .. 36 ..
14.36.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवं स्तुता सुरैः सर्वैस्ततो देवी प्रहर्षिता ..
तानब्रवीद्वरं सर्वा गृह्णंतु मम देवताः .. 36 ..
14.36.m: Pulastya said: / Thus praised by all the gods, the goddess rejoiced / and said to them: 'Let all you gods receive a boon from me.'

14.36.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
dānavo mahiṣo nāma pitāmahavarānvitaḥ ..
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ devānāṃ ca tathā kṛtaḥ .. 37 ..
14.36.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
दानवो महिषो नाम पितामहवरान्वितः ..
अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां देवानां च तथा कृतः .. 37 ..
14.36.m: The gods said: / 'A dānava named Mahiṣa, possessed of a boon from the Grandfather, / has been made invincible to all beings and likewise to the gods,

14.36.s: muktvaikāṃ yoṣitaṃ devi tasmāttvaṃ vinipātaya .. 38 ..
14.36.d: मुक्त्वैकां योषितं देवि तस्मात्त्वं विनिपातय .. 38 ..
14.36.m: excepting only a woman, O goddess; therefore, slay him!'

14.36.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
gacchadhvaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve svāni sthānāni nirvṛtāḥ .. 39 ..
14.36.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
गच्छध्वं त्रिदशाः सर्वे स्वानि स्थानानि निर्वृताः .. 39 ..
14.36.m: The goddess said: / 'Go, all you gods, to your own abodes in peace.

14.36.s:
ahaṃ taṃ sūdayiṣyāmi samaye paryupasthite ..
evamuktā gatāḥ sarve devāḥ sthānāni harṣitāḥ .. 7.3.36.40 ..
14.36.d:
अहं तं सूदयिष्यामि समये पर्युपस्थिते ..
एवमुक्ता गताः सर्वे देवाः स्थानानि हर्षिताः .. 7.3.36.40 ..
14.36.m: I shall destroy him when the proper time arrives.' / Addressed in this way, all the gods returned rejoicing to their realms.

14.36.s:
devī tatraiva saṃhṛṣṭā sthitā parvatarodhasi ..
kasyacittvathakālasya nārado bhagavānmuniḥ .. 41 ..
14.36.d:
देवी तत्रैव संहृष्टा स्थिता पर्वतरोधसि ..
कस्यचित्त्वथकालस्य नारदो भगवान्मुनिः .. 41 ..
14.36.m: The goddess remained right there upon the mountain slope, full of joy. / Then, after some time, the divine sage Nārada,

14.36.s:
tatra devīṃ ca saṃdṛṣṭvā tīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ ..
triviṣṭapamanuprāpto mahiṣo yatra tiṣṭhati .. 42 ..
14.36.d:
तत्र देवीं च संदृष्ट्वा तीर्थयात्रापरायणः ..
त्रिविष्टपमनुप्राप्तो महिषो यत्र तिष्ठति .. 42 ..
14.36.m: having seen the goddess there while devoted to pilgrimage to holy fords, / arrived at heaven, where Mahiṣa was residing.

14.36.s:
tatra dṛṣṭvā muniṃ prāptaṃ praṇamya mahiṣāsuraḥ ..
vinayena samāyukto hyabhyutthānamathākarot ..43..
14.36.d:
तत्र दृष्ट्वा मुनिं प्राप्तं प्रणम्य महिषासुरः ..
विनयेन समायुक्तो ह्यभ्युत्थानमथाकरोत् ..43..
14.36.m: Seeing that the sage had arrived there, the asura Mahiṣa bowed / and, full of humble respect, rose up to greet him.

14.36.s:
tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsa madhuparkārghaviṣṭaraiḥ ..
sukhāsīnaṃ suviśrāṃtaṃ jñātvā vākyamuvāca ha .. 44 ..
14.36.d:
ततस्तं पूजयामास मधुपर्कार्घविष्टरैः ..
सुखासीनं सुविश्रांतं ज्ञात्वा वाक्यमुवाच ह .. 44 ..
14.36.m: He then worshipped him with the honey-offering, water for hospitality, and a seat; / and seeing him comfortably seated and well-rested, he spoke these words:

14.36.s:
kuto bhavānitaḥ prāptaḥ kimarthaṃ munisattama ..
amī putrāstathā rājyaṃ kalatrāṇi dhanāni ca .. 45 ..
14.36.d:
कुतो भवानितः प्राप्तः किमर्थं मुनिसत्तम ..
अमी पुत्रास्तथा राज्यं कलत्राणि धनानि च .. 45 ..
14.36.m: 'From where have you come here, O best of sages, and for what purpose? / These sons, as well as the kingdom, wives, and riches,

14.36.s:
ahaṃ bhṛtyasamāyuktaḥ kimanena dvijottama ..
sarvaṃ te'haṃ pradāsyāmi brūhi yena prayojanam.. 46 ..
14.36.d:
अहं भृत्यसमायुक्तः किमनेन द्विजोत्तम ..
सर्वं तेऽहं प्रदास्यामि ब्रूहि येन प्रयोजनम्.. 46 ..
14.36.m: and I together with my servants—what are these [to you], O best of brahmins? / I shall give you everything; speak of whatever you require.'

14.36.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
abhinaṃdāmi te sarvametattvayyupapadyate .
niḥspṛhā hi vayaṃ nityaṃ munidharmaṃ samāśritāḥ .. 47 ..
14.36.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
अभिनंदामि ते सर्वमेतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते .
निःस्पृहा हि वयं नित्यं मुनिधर्मं समाश्रिताः .. 47 ..
14.36.m: Nārada said: / 'I commend all this from you; it is well suited to you. / We, however, are ever free from desire, committed to the way of sages.

14.36.s:
kautūhalādiha prāptaścirātte darśanaṃ gataḥ ..
marttyalokātsamāyāto yāsyāmi brahmaṇaḥ padam .. 48 ..
14.36.d:
कौतूहलादिह प्राप्तश्चिरात्ते दर्शनं गतः ..
मर्त्त्यलोकात्समायातो यास्यामि ब्रह्मणः पदम् .. 48 ..
14.36.m: I came here out of curiosity, having come into your presence after a long time. / Having arrived from the mortal world, I shall go on to the realm of Brahmā.'

14.36.s:
.. mahiṣāsura uvāca .. ..
kvaciddṛṣṭaṃ tvayā kiñcidāścaryaṃ bhūtale mune ..
daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ vāpi dānavā laṃbhitā vibho .. 49 ..
14.36.d:
.. महिषासुर उवाच .. ..
क्वचिद्दृष्टं त्वया किञ्चिदाश्चर्यं भूतले मुने ..
दैवं वा मानुषं वापि दानवा लंभिता विभो .. 49 ..
14.36.m: Mahiṣāsura said: / 'Have you seen any wonder on the earth, O sage, / whether divine or human, that has reached the dānavas, O lord?'

14.36.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
atyāścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ dānavendra dharātale ..
yatra dṛṣṭaṃ kvacitpūrvaṃ trailokye sacarācare .. 7.3.36.50 ..
14.36.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
अत्याश्चर्यं मया दृष्टं दानवेन्द्र धरातले ..
यत्र दृष्टं क्वचित्पूर्वं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे .. 7.3.36.50 ..
14.36.m: Nārada said: / 'I saw a great wonder on the surface of the earth, O lord of dānavas, / such as was [never] before seen anywhere in the three worlds, moving and unmoving.

14.36.s:
astyarbuda iti khyātaḥ parvato dharaṇītale ..
sarvartupuṣpitairvṛkṣaiḥ śobhitaḥ svargasannibhaḥ .. 51 ..
14.36.d:
अस्त्यर्बुद इति ख्यातः पर्वतो धरणीतले ..
सर्वर्तुपुष्पितैर्वृक्षैः शोभितः स्वर्गसन्निभः .. 51 ..
14.36.m: There is a mountain on the surface of the earth known as Arbuda, / adorned with trees blossoming in all seasons, resembling heaven itself,

14.36.s:
bakulaiścaṃpakaiścāmrairaśokaiḥ karṇikārakaiḥ ..
śālaistālaiśca kharjūrairvaṭairbhallātakairdhavaiḥ .. 52 ..
14.36.d:
बकुलैश्चंपकैश्चाम्रैरशोकैः कर्णिकारकैः ..
शालैस्तालैश्च खर्जूरैर्वटैर्भल्लातकैर्धवैः .. 52 ..
14.36.m: with bakula, campaka, mango, aśoka, and karṇikāra trees; / with śāla, palmyra, date, banyan, bhallātaka, and dhava trees;

14.36.s:
saralaiḥ panasairvṛkṣaistiṃdukaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ ..
maṃdāraiḥ pārijātaiśca malayaiścaṃdanaistathā .. 53 ..
14.36.d:
सरलैः पनसैर्वृक्षैस्तिंदुकैः करवीरकैः ..
मंदारैः पारिजातैश्च मलयैश्चंदनैस्तथा .. 53 ..
14.36.m: with pine, jackfruit trees, tinduka, and karavīra bushes; / with mandāra, pārijāta, and Malabar sandalwood trees;

14.36.s:
puṣpajātiviśeṣaiśca sugaṃdhairapyanekakaiḥ ..
khādyaiḥ sarvestathā lehyaiścoṣyaiḥ phalavarairvṛtaḥ .. 54 ..
14.36.d:
पुष्पजातिविशेषैश्च सुगंधैरप्यनेककैः ..
खाद्यैः सर्वेस्तथा लेह्यैश्चोष्यैः फलवरैर्वृतः .. 54 ..
14.36.m: and with many distinct varieties of fragrant flowers, / surrounded by the finest fruits: all types to be chewed, licked, and sucked.

14.36.s:
na sa vṛkṣo na sā vallī nauṣadhī sā dharātale ..
na tatra yā'surajyeṣṭha parvate vīkṣitā mayā .. 55 ..
14.36.d:
न स वृक्षो न सा वल्ली नौषधी सा धरातले ..
न तत्र याऽसुरज्येष्ठ पर्वते वीक्षिता मया .. 55 ..
14.36.m: There is no tree, no vine, nor any medicinal plant on earth, / O foremost among asuras, that was not seen by me on that mountain.

14.36.s:
pakṣiṇo madhurārāvāścakoraśikhicātakāḥ ..
kokilā dhārtarāṣṭrāśca bhramarāḥ śvetapatrakāḥ .. 56 ..
14.36.d:
पक्षिणो मधुरारावाश्चकोरशिखिचातकाः ..
