कोकिला धार्तराष्ट्राश्च भ्रमराः श्वेतपत्रकाः .. 56 ..
14.36.m: There are sweet-sounding birds: cakoras, peacocks, cātakas, / cuckoos, white geese, and bees with pale wings.

14.36.s:
yeṣāṃ śabdaṃ samākarṇya munayo'pi samāhitāḥ ..
kṣobhaṃ yāṃti trikālajñāḥ kaṃdarpaśarapīḍitāḥ .. 57 ..
14.36.d:
येषां शब्दं समाकर्ण्य मुनयोऽपि समाहिताः ..
क्षोभं यांति त्रिकालज्ञाः कंदर्पशरपीडिताः .. 57 ..
14.36.m: Hearing their sound, even sages who are deeply absorbed, / knowers of past, present, and future, become agitated, tormented by the arrows of Kāma.

14.36.s:
nirjharāṇi suramyāṇi nadyaśca vimalodakāḥ ..
padminīkhaṃḍasaṃyuktā hradāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ .. 58 ..
14.36.d:
निर्झराणि सुरम्याणि नद्यश्च विमलोदकाः ..
पद्मिनीखंडसंयुक्ता ह्रदाः शतसहस्रशः .. 58 ..
14.36.m: There are delightful cascades, rivers of crystal-clear water, / and hundreds and thousands of lakes filled with clusters of lotus plants.

14.36.s:
padmapatraviśālākṣā madhyakṣāmāḥ śucismitāḥ ..
vivekino narāstatra śāstravratasamanvitāḥ .. 59 ..
14.36.d:
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षा मध्यक्षामाः शुचिस्मिताः ..
विवेकिनो नरास्तत्र शास्त्रव्रतसमन्विताः .. 59 ..
14.36.m: There are women with broad eyes like lotus petals, slender waists, and bright smiles; / and discerning men endowed with knowledge of the scriptures and vows.

14.36.s:
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena yatkiṃcittatra parvate ..
svedajāṃḍajasaṃjñeyā udbhijjāśca jarāyujāḥ ..
sarvalokottarāstatra dṛśyaṃte parvatottame .. 7.3.36.60 ..
14.36.d:
किं चात्र बहुनोक्तेन यत्किंचित्तत्र पर्वते ..
स्वेदजांडजसंज्ञेया उद्भिज्जाश्च जरायुजाः ..
सर्वलोकोत्तरास्तत्र दृश्यंते पर्वतोत्तमे .. 7.3.36.60 ..
14.36.m: What need is there to say much more? Whatever is on that mountain, / whether born of sweat, born of eggs, born of sprouts, or born from the womb, / all are seen to be transcendent on that best of mountains.

14.36.s:
daśayojanavistāro dvābhyāṃ saṃhitaparvataḥ ..
uccaiḥ paṃca ca sa śrīmānmartye svargo vyajāyata .. 61 ..
14.36.d:
दशयोजनविस्तारो द्वाभ्यां संहितपर्वतः ..
उच्चैः पंच च स श्रीमान्मर्त्ये स्वर्गो व्यजायत .. 61 ..
14.36.m: Ten yojanas in extent and combined with two [more], / and five [yojanas] high, that glorious mountain has become a heaven in the mortal realm.

14.36.s:
tatrā'haṃ kautukāviṣṭa itaścetaśca vīkṣayan ..
sarvāścaryamayīṃ nārīmapaśyaṃ lokasuṃdarīm .. 62 ..
14.36.d:
तत्राऽहं कौतुकाविष्ट इतश्चेतश्च वीक्षयन् ..
सर्वाश्चर्यमयीं नारीमपश्यं लोकसुंदरीम् .. 62 ..
14.36.m: There, filled with curiosity, as I gazed here and there, / I beheld a woman full of all wonders, the beauty of the world.

14.36.s:
na devī nāpi gaṃdharvī nāsurī na ca mānuṣī ..
tādṛgrūpā mayā dṛṣṭā na śrutā ca varāṃganā .. 63 ..
14.36.d:
न देवी नापि गंधर्वी नासुरी न च मानुषी ..
तादृग्रूपा मया दृष्टा न श्रुता च वरांगना .. 63 ..
14.36.m: Neither goddess, nor gandharva woman, nor asura woman, nor human female / of such beauty has ever been seen or heard of by me, an excellent lady!

14.36.s:
ratiḥ prītirumā lakṣmīḥ sāvitrī ca sarasvatī ..
tasyā rūpasya leśena naitāstulyāḥ striyo'khilāḥ .. 64 ..
14.36.d:
रतिः प्रीतिरुमा लक्ष्मीः सावित्री च सरस्वती ..
तस्या रूपस्य लेशेन नैतास्तुल्याः स्त्रियोऽखिलाः .. 64 ..
14.36.m: Rati, Prīti, Umā, Lakṣmī, Sāvitrī, and Sarasvatī: / all these women are not equal even to a fraction of her beauty.

14.36.s:
ahaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā rūpāṃ nārīṃ kāmena pīḍitaḥ ..
tadā dānavaśārdūla vaiklavyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 65 ..
14.36.d:
अहं दृष्ट्वा तथा रूपां नारीं कामेन पीडितः ..
तदा दानवशार्दूल वैक्लव्यं परमं गतः .. 65 ..
14.36.m: When I saw a woman of such form, afflicted with desire, / I fell into the deepest distress, O tiger among dānavas!

14.36.s:
tato dhairyamavaṣṭabhya mayā manasi ciṃtitam ..
na kariṣye samālāpaṃ tayā saha ca karhicit .. 66 ..
14.36.d:
ततो धैर्यमवष्टभ्य मया मनसि चिंतितम् ..
न करिष्ये समालापं तया सह च कर्हिचित् .. 66 ..
14.36.m: Then, having summoned my courage, I resolved in my mind: / 'I must never engage in conversation with her.

14.36.s:
yasyā darśanamātreṇa kāmo me hṛdi varddhitaḥ ..
tasyāḥ saṃbhāṣaṇeneva kiṃ bhaviṣyati me punaḥ .. 67 ..
14.36.d:
यस्या दर्शनमात्रेण कामो मे हृदि वर्द्धितः ..
तस्याः संभाषणेनेव किं भविष्यति मे पुनः .. 67 ..
14.36.m: If at the mere sight of her desire flared in my heart, / what would happen to me if I were actually to converse with her?'

14.36.s:
cirakālaṃ tapastaptaṃ brahmacaryeṇa vai mayā ..
nāśaṃ yāsyati tatsarvaṃ viṣayairnirjitasya ca ..
tasmādgacchāmi cānyatra yāvanna vikṛtirbhavet .. 68 ..
14.36.d:
चिरकालं तपस्तप्तं ब्रह्मचर्येण वै मया ..
नाशं यास्यति तत्सर्वं विषयैर्निर्जितस्य च ..
तस्माद्गच्छामि चान्यत्र यावन्न विकृतिर्भवेत् .. 68 ..
14.36.m: For a long time austerity was performed by me through celibacy indeed; / it will all go to destruction if I am conquered by sense-objects. / Therefore I shall go elsewhere, before an alteration of mind occurs. (68)

14.36.s:
nārīnāma tapovighnaṃ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ..
argalā svargamārgasya sopānaṃ narakasya ca .. 69 ..
14.36.d:
नारीनाम तपोविघ्नं पूर्वं सृष्टं स्वयंभुवा ..
अर्गला स्वर्गमार्गस्य सोपानं नरकस्य च .. 69 ..
14.36.m: An obstacle to austerity, named woman, was created of old by the self-manifest [Brahmā]; / a bolt across the path to heaven, and a staircase to hell. (69)

14.36.s:
tāvaddhairyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ tāvatsthairyaṃ kulatrapā ..
yāvatpaśyati no nārīmaikāṃte ca viśeṣataḥ .. 7.3.36.70 ..
14.36.d:
तावद्धैर्यं तपः सत्यं तावत्स्थैर्यं कुलत्रपा ..
यावत्पश्यति नो नारीमैकांते च विशेषतः .. 7.3.36.70 ..
14.36.m: So long does patience last, austerity, truth; so long does firmness and modesty of family endure, / only until one sees a woman, especially in solitude. (70)

14.36.s:
etatsaṃciṃtya bahudhā nimīlya nayane tataḥ ..
aprajalpya varārohāṃ tāmahaṃ cātra saṃsthitaḥ .. 71 ..
14.36.d:
एतत्संचिंत्य बहुधा निमील्य नयने ततः ..
अप्रजल्प्य वरारोहां तामहं चात्र संस्थितः .. 71 ..
14.36.m: Reflecting much on this, closing both eyes then, / without speaking to that lovely-hipped lady, I departed from there. (71)

14.36.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā mahiṣaḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ ..
śravaṇādapi rājeṃdra punaḥ papraccha taṃ munim .. 72 ..
14.36.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा महिषः कामपीडितः ..
श्रवणादपि राजेंद्र पुनः पप्रच्छ तं मुनिम् .. 72 ..
14.36.m: Pulastya said: / Having heard the words of Nārada, Mahiṣa, tormented by desire, / simply from hearing, O king of kings, asked that sage again: (72)

14.36.s:
.. mahiṣāsura uvāca .. ..
kā'sau brāhmaṇaśārdūla tādṛgrūpā varāṃganā ..
yasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva bhavāneva smarānvitaḥ .. 73 ..
14.36.d:
.. महिषासुर उवाच .. ..
काऽसौ ब्राह्मणशार्दूल तादृग्रूपा वरांगना ..
यस्याः संदर्शनादेव भवानेव स्मरान्वितः .. 73 ..
14.36.m: Mahiṣāsura said: / Who is she, O tiger among brahmins, that fair lady of such beauty, / by whose very sight you yourself were seized by love? (73)

14.36.s:
devī vā mānuṣī vāpi yakṣiṇī pannagī mune ..
kumārī vā sakāṃtā vā brūhi sarvaṃ savistaram .. 74 ..
14.36.d:
देवी वा मानुषी वापि यक्षिणी पन्नगी मुने ..
कुमारी वा सकांता वा ब्रूहि सर्वं सविस्तरम् .. 74 ..
14.36.m: Is she a goddess, a mortal woman, a yakṣiṇī, or a serpent-maiden, O sage? / An unmarried girl, or one with a husband? Tell me all in full! (74)

14.36.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
na sā pṛṣṭā mayā kiṃcinna jānāmi tadanvayam ..
etanme varttate vitte sā kumārī yaśasvinī .. 76 ..
akṣamālādharā bālā kamaṃḍalusamanvitā ..
tapastepe girau tatra hetunā kenacicchubhā .. 76 ..
14.36.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
न सा पृष्टा मया किंचिन्न जानामि तदन्वयम् ..
एतन्मे वर्त्तते वित्ते सा कुमारी यशस्विनी .. 76 ..
अक्षमालाधरा बाला कमंडलुसमन्विता ..
तपस्तेपे गिरौ तत्र हेतुना केनचिच्छुभा .. 76 ..
14.36.m:
Nārada said: / She was not asked anything by me; I do not know her lineage. / This exists in my awareness: she is a renowned maiden; (75)
a girl holding a rosary, equipped with a water-pot; / the auspicious one performed austerity on that mountain for some reason. (76)

14.36.s:
so'haṃ yāsyāmi daityeśa brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ..
notsahe tatkathāṃ kartuṃ kāmabāṇabhayāturaḥ .. .. 77 ..
14.36.d:
सोऽहं यास्यामि दैत्येश ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ..
नोत्सहे तत्कथां कर्तुं कामबाणभयातुरः .. .. 77 ..
14.36.m: As for me, O lord of Daityas, I am going to the eternal world of Brahmā; / afflicted by the fear of the arrows of desire, I do not dare to talk of her. (77)

14.36.s:
evamuktvā tato rājanbrahmalokaṃ gato muniḥ ..
mahiṣo'pi smarāviṣṭaścaraṃ tasyāḥ samādiśat .. 78 ..
14.36.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्ब्रह्मलोकं गतो मुनिः ..
महिषोऽपि स्मराविष्टश्चरं तस्याः समादिशत् .. 78 ..
14.36.m: Having spoken thus, O king, the sage went to the world of Brahmā. / And Mahiṣa, seized by desire, dispatched a spy after her, [saying]: (78)

14.36.s:
gatvā bhavāndrutaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ca varāṃganām..
kimarthaṃ sā tapastepe ko vai tasyāḥ parigrahaḥ .. 79 ..
14.36.d:
गत्वा भवान्द्रुतं तत्र दृष्ट्वा तां च वरांगनाम्..
किमर्थं सा तपस्तेपे को वै तस्याः परिग्रहः .. 79 ..
14.36.m: Going swiftly there and seeing that fair woman, / [find out] why she performed austerity, and who indeed is her guardian. (79)

14.36.s:
athā'sau mahiṣādeśāddūto gatvārbudācalam ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ padmagarbhābhāṃ jñātvā sarva viceṣṭitam .. 7.3.36.80 ..
14.36.d:
अथाऽसौ महिषादेशाद्दूतो गत्वार्बुदाचलम् ..
दृष्ट्वा तां पद्मगर्भाभां ज्ञात्वा सर्व विचेष्टितम् .. 7.3.36.80 ..
14.36.m: Then that messenger, going to Mount Arbuda by order of Mahiṣa, / having seen her who shines like the interior of a lotus, and having learned all her actions, (80)

14.36.s:
tasmai nivedayāmāsa mahiṣāya savismayaḥ ..
dṛṣṭā daityavara strī ca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā .. 81 ..
14.36.d:
तस्मै निवेदयामास महिषाय सविस्मयः ..
दृष्टा दैत्यवर स्त्री च सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता .. 81 ..
14.36.m: reported to that Mahiṣa with wonder: / O best of Daityas, a woman marked with all auspicious marks was seen. (81)

14.36.s:
devatejobhavā kanyā sā'dyāpi varavarṇinī ..
tvadvadhārthaṃ tapastepe kaumāravratamāśritā .. 82 ..
14.36.d:
देवतेजोभवा कन्या साऽद्यापि वरवर्णिनी ..
त्वद्वधार्थं तपस्तेपे कौमारव्रतमाश्रिता .. 82 ..
14.36.m: A maiden born from the splendor of the gods, that lady of excellent complexion, even today, / having undertaken the vow of maidenhood, performed austerity for the sake of slaying you. (82)

14.36.s:
evaṃ tatra bhavaṃtī sma pṛṣṭāḥ sarve tapasvinaḥ ..
satyametanmahābhāga kuruṣva yadanaṃtaram .. 83 ..
14.36.d:
एवं तत्र भवंती स्म पृष्टाः सर्वे तपस्विनः ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभाग कुरुष्व यदनंतरम् .. 83 ..
14.36.m: Thus all the ascetics residing there were questioned [by me]. / This is the truth, O noble one; do what comes next! (83)

14.36.s:
tasyā rūpaṃ vayaḥ kāṃtirvarṇituṃ naiva śakyate ..
nālāpaṃ kurute bālā sā kenāpi samaṃ vibhau .. 84 ..
14.36.d:
तस्या रूपं वयः कांतिर्वर्णितुं नैव शक्यते ..
नालापं कुरुते बाला सा केनापि समं विभौ .. 84 ..
14.36.m: Her beauty, youth, and radiance cannot at all be described. / That girl does not speak with anyone, O lord! (84)

14.36.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā mahiṣo vākyaṃ bhūyaḥ kāmanipīḍitaḥ ..
dūtaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa dānavaṃ ca vicakṣaṇam ..85 ..
14.36.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा महिषो वाक्यं भूयः कामनिपीडितः ..
दूतं संप्रेषयामास दानवं च विचक्षणम् ..85 ..
14.36.m: Pulastya said: / Having heard that speech, Mahiṣa, further tormented by desire, / sent an envoy, the Dānava named Vicakṣaṇa: (85)

14.36.s:
vicakṣaṇa drutaṃ gatvā madarthe tāṃ tapasvinīm ..
sāmabhedapradānena daṃḍenāpi samānaya .. 86 ..
14.36.d:
विचक्षण द्रुतं गत्वा मदर्थे तां तपस्विनीम् ..
सामभेदप्रदानेन दंडेनापि समानय .. 86 ..
14.36.m: Vicakṣaṇa, go swiftly for my sake and bring that ascetic woman / by conciliation, division, gifts, or even force! (86)

14.36.s:
athā'sau prayayau śīghraṃ praṇipatya vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
arbude parvataśreṣṭhe yatra sā parameśvarī ..
praṇamya vinayopeto vākyametaduvāca tām..87..
14.36.d:
अथाऽसौ प्रययौ शीघ्रं प्रणिपत्य विचक्षणः ..
अर्बुदे पर्वतश्रेष्ठे यत्र सा परमेश्वरी ..
प्रणम्य विनयोपेतो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ताम्..87..
14.36.m: Then that Vicakṣaṇa, having bowed down, departed swiftly / to Arbuda, the best of mountains, where that Supreme Goddess was. / Having bowed with humility, he spoke these words to her: (87)

14.36.s:
mahiṣo nāma vikhyātastrailokyādhipatirbalī..
danuvaṃśasamudbhūtaḥ kāmarūpasamanvitaḥ..88..
14.36.d:
महिषो नाम विख्यातस्त्रैलोक्याधिपतिर्बली..
दनुवंशसमुद्भूतः कामरूपसमन्वितः..88..
14.36.m: The mighty one known by name as Mahiṣa, the ruler of the three worlds, / born in the lineage of Danu, endowed with the power of shape-shifting— (88)

14.36.s:
sa tvāṃ vāṃchati kalyāṇi dharmapatnīṃ svadharmataḥ ..
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te sarvakāmapradaṃ patim .. 89 ..
14.36.d:
स त्वां वांछति कल्याणि धर्मपत्नीं स्वधर्मतः ..
तस्माद्वरय भद्रं ते सर्वकामप्रदं पतिम् .. 89 ..
14.36.m: he desires you, O blessed lady, as his lawful wife according to his own law. / Therefore choose him as your husband, who grants all desires—blessing be upon you! (89)

14.36.s:
yadi syāttava kāṃto'sau tvaṃ ca tasya tathā priyā..
tatkṛtārthaṃ dvayoreva yauvanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7.3.36.90 ..
14.36.d:
यदि स्यात्तव कांतोऽसौ त्वं च तस्य तथा प्रिया..
तत्कृतार्थं द्वयोरेव यौवनं नात्र संशयः .. 7.3.36.90 ..
14.36.m: If he were to be your beloved and you likewise his darling, / then the youth of both would indeed be fulfilled; there is no doubt about this. (90)

14.36.s:
evamuktā tatastena devī vacanamabravīt ..
kiñcitkopasamāyuktā muhuḥ prasphuritādharā .. 91 ..
14.36.d:
एवमुक्ता ततस्तेन देवी वचनमब्रवीत् ..
किञ्चित्कोपसमायुक्ता मुहुः प्रस्फुरिताधरा .. 91 ..
14.36.m: Thus addressed by him, the goddess then spoke a word, / joined with a little wrath, her lower lip repeatedly quivering. (91)

14.36.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ...
avadhyaḥ sarvathā dūtaḥ sarvatra parikīrtitaḥ ..
avasthāsu tato na tvaṃ sahasā bhasmasātkṛtaḥ ..92..
14.36.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ...
अवध्यः सर्वथा दूतः सर्वत्र परिकीर्तितः ..
अवस्थासु ततो न त्वं सहसा भस्मसात्कृतः ..92..
14.36.m: The goddess said: / A messenger is said everywhere to be inviolable in every way; / because of that circumstance, you have not been suddenly reduced to ashes. (92)

14.36.s:
gatvā brūhi durācāraṃ mahiṣaṃ dānavādhamam ..
nāhaṃ śakyā tvayā pāpa labdhuṃ nānyena kenacit .. 93 ..
14.36.d:
गत्वा ब्रूहि दुराचारं महिषं दानवाधमम् ..
नाहं शक्या त्वया पाप लब्धुं नान्येन केनचित् .. 93 ..
14.36.m: Go and speak to Mahiṣa of evil conduct, lowest of Dānavas: / I cannot be obtained by you, O wicked one, nor by anyone else! (93)

14.36.s:
vadhārthaṃ te samudyoga eṣa sarvo mayā kṛtaḥ ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā mahiṣaṃ sa punaryayau .. 94 ..
14.36.d:
वधार्थं ते समुद्योग एष सर्वो मया कृतः ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महिषं स पुनर्ययौ .. 94 ..
14.36.m: All this preparation has been made by me for your slaying! / Having heard that speech of hers, he returned to Mahiṣa. (94)

14.36.s:
bhayena mahatāviṣṭastasyā rūpeṇa vismitaḥ ..
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa mahiṣāya viceṣṭitam ..
tasyāścaiva tathā''lāpānaspṛhatvaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 95 ..
14.36.d:
भयेन महताविष्टस्तस्या रूपेण विस्मितः ..
सर्वं निवेदयामास महिषाय विचेष्टितम् ..
तस्याश्चैव तथा'ऽलापानस्पृहत्वं च कृत्स्नशः .. 95 ..
14.36.m: Seized by great fear, astonished by her beauty, / he reported all her conduct to Mahiṣa, / and also her words and her utter lack of desire. (95)

14.36.s:
tacchutvā mahiṣo rājankāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ..
senāpatiṃ samāhūya vākyametaduvāca ha ..96..
14.36.d:
तच्छुत्वा महिषो राजन्कामबाणप्रपीडितः ..
सेनापतिं समाहूय वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..96..
14.36.m: Hearing that, O king, Mahiṣa, tormented by the arrows of desire, / summoned his general and spoke these words: (96)

14.36.s:
arbude parvate senāṃ kalpayasva sudurdharām ..
hastyaśvakalpitāṃ bhīmāṃ rathapattisamākulām .. 97 ..
14.36.d:
अर्बुदे पर्वते सेनां कल्पयस्व सुदुर्धराम् ..
हस्त्यश्वकल्पितां भीमां रथपत्तिसमाकुलाम् .. 97 ..
14.36.m: Arrange an army that is exceedingly hard to resist on Mount Arbuda, / composed of elephants and horses, terrible, filled with chariots and foot-soldiers! (97)

14.36.s:
tato'sau kalpayāmāsa caturaṃgāṃ varūthinīm ..
patākācchatraśabalāṃ vāditrārāvabhūṣitām .. 98 ..
14.36.d:
ततोऽसौ कल्पयामास चतुरंगां वरूथिनीम् ..
पताकाच्छत्रशबलां वादित्रारावभूषिताम् .. 98 ..
14.36.m: Then he prepared a fourfold army, / variegated with banners and parasols, adorned with the sounds of musical instruments. (98)

14.36.s:
tato dvipāśca saṃnaddhā dṛśyaṃte'dhiṣṭhitā bhaṭaiḥ ..
itaścetaśca dhāvantaḥ sapakṣāḥ parvatā iva .. 99 ..
14.36.d:
ततो द्विपाश्च संनद्धा दृश्यंतेऽधिष्ठिता भटैः ..
इतश्चेतश्च धावन्तः सपक्षाः पर्वता इव .. 99 ..
14.36.m: Then armored elephants, mounted by warriors, were seen, / running hither and thither like mountains with wings. (99)

14.36.s:
aśvāścaivāpyakalmāṣā vāyuvegāḥ suvarcasaḥ ..
aṃgatrāṇasamāyuktāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 7.3.36.100 ..
14.36.d:
अश्वाश्चैवाप्यकल्माषा वायुवेगाः सुवर्चसः ..
अंगत्राणसमायुक्ताः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 7.3.36.100 ..
14.36.m: And horses spotless, swift as the wind, of splendid radiance, / equipped with body armor, by hundreds and thousands; (100)

14.36.s:
vimānapratimākārā rathāstena prakalpitāḥ ..
kiṃkiṇījālasadghaṃṭāpatākābhiralaṃkṛtāḥ .. 101 ..
14.36.d:
विमानप्रतिमाकारा रथास्तेन प्रकल्पिताः ..
किंकिणीजालसद्घंटापताकाभिरलंकृताः .. 101 ..
14.36.m: chariots shaped like aerial chariots were prepared by him, / adorned with clusters of tinkling bells, fine bells, and banners; (101)

14.36.s:
pattayaśca mahākāyā maheṣvāsā mahābalāḥ ..
asicarmadharāścānye prāsapaṭṭiśapāṇayaḥ .. 102 ..
14.36.d:
पत्तयश्च महाकाया महेष्वासा महाबलाः ..
असिचर्मधराश्चान्ये प्रासपट्टिशपाणयः .. 102 ..
14.36.m: and foot-soldiers of huge bodies, great archers of great might, / others bearing swords and shields, and holding spears and battle-axes in their hands. (102)

14.36.s:
lakṣamekaṃ mataṃgānāṃ rathānāṃ triguṇaṃ tataḥ ..
aśvā daśaguṇā rājannasaṃkhyātāḥ padātayaḥ .. 103 ..
14.36.d:
लक्षमेकं मतंगानां रथानां त्रिगुणं ततः ..
अश्वा दशगुणा राजन्नसंख्याताः पदातयः .. 103 ..
14.36.m: One hundred thousand elephants, thrice that number of chariots, / horses ten times as many, O king, and innumerable foot-soldiers. (103)

14.36.s:
tataścārbudamāsādya veṣṭayitvā sa dūrataḥ ..
saṃmitaiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ tadaṃtikamupādravat .. 104 ..
14.36.d:
ततश्चार्बुदमासाद्य वेष्टयित्वा स दूरतः ..
संमितैः सचिवैः सार्धं तदंतिकमुपाद्रवत् .. 104 ..
14.36.m: Then reaching Arbuda and encircling it from afar, / he rushed near to her along with chosen ministers. (104)

14.36.s:
dhyānasthāṃ vīkṣya tāṃ devīṃ kandarpaśarapīḍitaḥ ..
tato'bravītsa tāṃ vākyaṃ vinayena samanvitaḥ .. 105 ..
14.36.d:
ध्यानस्थां वीक्ष्य तां देवीं कन्दर्पशरपीडितः ..
ततोऽब्रवीत्स तां वाक्यं विनयेन समन्वितः .. 105 ..
14.36.m: Seeing that goddess engaged in meditation, tormented by the arrows of Kandarpa, / he then spoke these words to her, filled with humility: (105)

14.36.s:
śrutvā tavedṛśaṃ rūpamahaṃ prāpto varānane ..
gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena tasmādvaraya māṃ drutam .. 106 ..
14.36.d:
श्रुत्वा तवेदृशं रूपमहं प्राप्तो वरानने ..
गांधर्वेण विवाहेन तस्माद्वरय मां द्रुतम् .. 106 ..
14.36.m: Having heard of your beauty such as this, I have arrived, O fair-faced lady; / therefore choose me swiftly through a gandharva marriage! (106)

14.36.s:
ṣaṣṭibhāryāsahasrāṇi mama saṃti śucismite ..
kṛtvā māṃ darpitaṃ kāṃtaṃ tāsāṃ tvaṃ svāminī bhava .. .. 107 ..
14.36.d:
षष्टिभार्यासहस्राणि मम संति शुचिस्मिते ..
कृत्वा मां दर्पितं कांतं तासां त्वं स्वामिनी भव .. .. 107 ..
14.36.m: I have sixty thousand wives, O woman of radiant smiles; / making me your proud beloved, become their mistress! (107)

14.36.s:
anarhaṃ te tapo bāle bhuṃkṣva bhogānyathepsitān ..
trailokyasvāminī bhūtvā mayā sārdhamaharniśam ..108..
14.36.d:
अनर्हं ते तपो बाले भुंक्ष्व भोगान्यथेप्सितान् ..
त्रैलोक्यस्वामिनी भूत्वा मया सार्धमहर्निशम् ..108..
14.36.m: Austerity is unfitting for you, O girl; enjoy desired pleasures, / having become the mistress of the three worlds together with me day and night! (108)

14.36.s:
evamuktā'pi sā tena nottaraṃ pratyabhāṣata ..
tataḥ kāmasamāviṣṭastadaṃtikamupāyayau ..109..
14.36.d:
एवमुक्ताऽपि सा तेन नोत्तरं प्रत्यभाषत ..
ततः कामसमाविष्टस्तदंतिकमुपाययौ ..109..
14.36.m: Although spoken to thus by him, she did not speak an answer in return. / Then, possessed by desire, he approached her presence. (109)

14.36.s:
tatastaṃ lolupaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā devī kopasaṃyutā ..
asmaradvāhanaṃ siṃhaṃ samāyātaḥ sa sā''ruhat .. 7.3.36.110 ..
14.36.d:
ततस्तं लोलुपं दृष्ट्वा सा देवी कोपसंयुता ..
अस्मरद्वाहनं सिंहं समायातः स सा'ऽरुहत् .. 7.3.36.110 ..
14.36.m: Then, seeing him lustful, that goddess was filled with anger; / she remembered her lion mount, and when it arrived, she mounted it.

14.36.s:
abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ gacchagaccheti cāsakṛt ..
no cettvāṃ ca vadhiṣyāmi sthāne'smindānavādhama .. 111 ..
14.36.d:
अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं गच्छगच्छेति चासकृत् ..
नो चेत्त्वां च वधिष्यामि स्थानेऽस्मिन्दानवाधम .. 111 ..
14.36.m: She spoke harsh words, repeatedly saying, “Go away, go away! / Otherwise I will kill you in this place, lowest of Dānavas!”

14.36.s:
athā'sau sacivaiḥ sārddhaṃ samaṃtātparyaveṣṭayat ..
pragrahārthaṃ tu tāṃ devīṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ .. 112 ..
14.36.d:
अथाऽसौ सचिवैः सार्द्धं समंतात्पर्यवेष्टयत् ..
प्रग्रहार्थं तु तां देवीं कामबाणप्रपीडितः .. 112 ..
14.36.m: Then, afflicted by the arrows of love, he, together with his ministers, / surrounded that goddess on all sides in order to seize her.

14.36.s:
tato jahāsa sā devī saśabdaṃ parameśvarī ..
tasmādaharniśaṃ sārddhaṃ niṣkrāṃtā puruṣā ghanāḥ .. 113 ..
14.36.d:
ततो जहास सा देवी सशब्दं परमेश्वरी ..
तस्मादहर्निशं सार्द्धं निष्क्रांता पुरुषा घनाः .. 113 ..
14.36.m: Then that goddess, the supreme sovereign, laughed aloud. / From that [laugh], day and night together, dense hordes of men came forth,

14.36.s:
susannaddhāḥ saśastrāśca roṣeṇa mahatā'nvitāḥ ..
tatastānabravīddevī pāpo'yaṃ vadhyatāmiti .. 114 ..
14.36.d:
सुसन्नद्धाः सशस्त्राश्च रोषेण महताऽन्विताः ..
ततस्तानब्रवीद्देवी पापोऽयं वध्यतामिति .. 114 ..
14.36.m: well-armoured, bearing weapons, and endowed with great fury. / Then the goddess said to them: “Let this wicked one be killed!”

14.36.s:
tataste sahitāḥ sarve mahiṣaṃ samupādravan..
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti jalpanto muṃcanto'straṇi bhūriśaḥ .. 115 ..
14.36.d:
ततस्ते सहिताः सर्वे महिषं समुपाद्रवन्..
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति जल्पन्तो मुंचन्तोऽस्त्रणि भूरिशः .. 115 ..
14.36.m: Then all of them together rushed against Mahiṣa, / shouting, “Halt, halt!” and releasing weapons in abundance.

14.36.s:
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ gaṇānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ..
tataste sacivāḥ sarve vaivasvatagṛhaṃ gatāḥ .. 116 ..
14.36.d:
ततः समभवद्युद्धं गणानां दानवैः सह ..
ततस्ते सचिवाः सर्वे वैवस्वतगृहं गताः .. 116 ..
14.36.m: Then a battle ensued between the Gaṇas and the Dānavas; / thereupon all those ministers went to the abode of Vaivasvata.

14.36.s:
athā'sau mahiṣo ruṣṭaḥ sacivairviṃnipātitaiḥ ..
svasainyamānayāmāsa tasminparvatarodhasi .. 117 ..
14.36.d:
अथाऽसौ महिषो रुष्टः सचिवैर्विंनिपातितैः ..
स्वसैन्यमानयामास तस्मिन्पर्वतरोधसि .. 117 ..
14.36.m: Now that Mahiṣa, enraged because his ministers had been struck down, / brought his army to that mountain slope.

14.36.s:
rathapravaramāruhya sārathiṃ samabhāṣata ..
naya māṃ sārathe tūrṇaṃ yatra sā''ste vyavasthitā .. 118 ..
14.36.d:
रथप्रवरमारुह्य सारथिं समभाषत ..
नय मां सारथे तूर्णं यत्र सा'ऽस्ते व्यवस्थिता .. 118 ..
14.36.m: Mounting his excellent chariot, he addressed his charioteer: / “Charioteer, lead me swiftly to where she remains stationed.

14.36.s:
hatvaināmadya yāsyāmi pāraṃ roṣasya dustaram ..
evamuktastato rājanprerayāmāsa sārathiḥ .. 119 ..
14.36.d:
हत्वैनामद्य यास्यामि पारं रोषस्य दुस्तरम् ..
एवमुक्तस्ततो राजन्प्रेरयामास सारथिः .. 119 ..
14.36.m: Having slain her today, I shall reach the far side of my insurmountable anger!” / Addressed thus, O king, the charioteer urged on

14.36.s:
rathaṃ tenaiva mārgeṇa yatra sā tiṣṭhate dhruvam ..
etasminneva kāle tu tatrotpātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ .. 7.3.36.120 ..
14.36.d:
रथं तेनैव मार्गेण यत्र सा तिष्ठते ध्रुवम् ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तत्रोत्पाताः सुदारुणाः .. 7.3.36.120 ..
14.36.m: the chariot by that very path where she firmly stood. / At that very time, terrible portents occurred there,

14.36.s:
bahavastena mārgeṇa yenāsau prasthito nṛpa ..
sammukhaḥ pravavau vāto rūkṣaḥ karkarasaṃyutaḥ .. 121 ..
14.36.d:
बहवस्तेन मार्गेण येनासौ प्रस्थितो नृप ..
सम्मुखः प्रववौ वातो रूक्षः कर्करसंयुतः .. 121 ..
14.36.m: many [of them] along that road by which he had set out, O king: / a harsh wind, filled with gravel, blew straight against his face;

14.36.s:
papāta mahatī colkā nihatya ravimaṃḍalam ..
apasavyaṃ mṛgāścakrustasya mārge nṛpottama .. 122 ..
14.36.d:
पपात महती चोल्का निहत्य रविमंडलम् ..
अपसव्यं मृगाश्चक्रुस्तस्य मार्गे नृपोत्तम .. 122 ..
14.36.m: a great meteor fell, striking the disk of the sun; / wild animals kept him on their right as he went on the path, O best of kings;

14.36.s:
upaviṣṭāstathā vāṃtā bahumūtraṃ prasusruvuḥ ..
rathadhvaje samāviṣṭo gṛdhraḥ śabdamathākarot .. 123 ..
14.36.d:
उपविष्टास्तथा वांता बहुमूत्रं प्रसुस्रुवुः ..
रथध्वजे समाविष्टो गृध्रः शब्दमथाकरोत् .. 123 ..
14.36.m: crouching, they vomited and discharged abundant urine; / a vulture settled upon the flagstaff of his chariot and let out a cry.

14.36.s:
sa tānsarvānanādṛtya mahotpātānsudāruṇān ..
prayayau sammukhastasyā devyāḥ kopaparāyaṇaḥ .. 124 ..
14.36.d:
स तान्सर्वाननादृत्य महोत्पातान्सुदारुणान् ..
प्रययौ सम्मुखस्तस्या देव्याः कोपपरायणः .. 124 ..
14.36.m: Disregarding all those very dreadful, great portents, / dedicated to wrath, he advanced directly toward that goddess,

14.36.s:
vimuṃcaṃśca śarānnādāṃstiṣṭhatiṣṭheti ca bruvan ..
na kaściddṛśyate tatra teṣāṃ madhye nṛpottama .. 125 ..
14.36.d:
विमुंचंश्च शरान्नादांस्तिष्ठतिष्ठेति च ब्रुवन् ..
न कश्चिद्दृश्यते तत्र तेषां मध्ये नृपोत्तम .. 125 ..
14.36.m: discharging arrows and shouts, and crying out, “Halt, halt!” / None was seen there in the midst of them, O best of kings,

14.36.s:
mahiṣaṃ roṣasaṃyuktaṃ yo vārayati saṃgare ..
tena hatvā gaṇagaṇānkṛtaṃ rudhirakardamam ... .. 126 ..
14.36.d:
महिषं रोषसंयुक्तं यो वारयति संगरे ..
तेन हत्वा गणगणान्कृतं रुधिरकर्दमम् ... .. 126 ..
14.36.m: who could hold back Mahiṣa when he was filled with fury in battle. / By him, slaying the hosts of Gaṇas, a mire of blood was made.

14.36.s:
tato devī samāsādya proktā garveṇa pārthiva ..
na tvayā saṃgaro bhīru nūnaṃ kartuṃ mamocitaḥ .. 127 ..
14.36.d:
ततो देवी समासाद्य प्रोक्ता गर्वेण पार्थिव ..
न त्वया संगरो भीरु नूनं कर्तुं ममोचितः .. 127 ..
14.36.m: Then, having approached the goddess, he said with arrogance, O king: / “Truly, timid woman, it is not fitting for you to fight with me.

14.36.s:
na ca bāliśi me vīryaṃ na saubhāgyaṃ na vā dhanam ..
na karoṣi hi tena tvaṃ mama vākyaṃ kathañcana .. 128 ..
14.36.d:
न च बालिशि मे वीर्यं न सौभाग्यं न वा धनम् ..
न करोषि हि तेन त्वं मम वाक्यं कथञ्चन .. 128 ..
14.36.m: Foolish woman, you do not know my valor, nor my beauty, nor my wealth; / for that reason, you do not heed my word in any way.

14.36.s:
nūnaṃ tattvena jānāmi avaliptāsi bhāmini..
kuruṣvādyāpi me vākyaṃ bhāryā bhava mama priyā .. 129 ..
14.36.d:
नूनं तत्त्वेन जानामि अवलिप्तासि भामिनि..
कुरुष्वाद्यापि मे वाक्यं भार्या भव मम प्रिया .. 129 ..
14.36.m: Indeed, I truly know you are haughty, beautiful woman; / yet even now heed my word: become my beloved wife!

14.36.s:
striyaṃ tvāṃ notsahe haṃtuṃ pauruṣe ca vyavasthitaḥ ..
asakṛnnirjitaḥ saṃkhye mayā śakraḥ suraiḥ saha .. 7.3.36.130 ..
14.36.d:
स्त्रियं त्वां नोत्सहे हंतुं पौरुषे च व्यवस्थितः ..
असकृन्निर्जितः संख्ये मया शक्रः सुरैः सह .. 7.3.36.130 ..
14.36.m: I, steadfast in my manhood, am not eager to slay you, a woman; / repeatedly in battle Śakra along with the gods has been conquered by me.

14.36.s:
trailokye nāsti mattulyaḥ pumānkaścicca bāliśi..
evamuktā tato devī kopena mahatā'nvitā .. 131 ..
14.36.d:
त्रैलोक्ये नास्ति मत्तुल्यः पुमान्कश्चिच्च बालिशि..
एवमुक्ता ततो देवी कोपेन महताऽन्विता .. 131 ..
14.36.m: In the three worlds, foolish woman, there is no man equal to me.” / Thus addressed, the goddess, filled with great anger,

14.36.s:
pragṛhya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha ..
nālāpo yujyate pāpa kartuṃ saha mama tvayā .. 132 ..
14.36.d:
प्रगृह्य सशरं चापं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
नालापो युज्यते पाप कर्तुं सह मम त्वया .. 132 ..
14.36.m: grasped her bow along with an arrow and spoke this speech: / “O wicked one, it is not proper for you to converse with me,

14.36.s:
kumāryāḥ kāmayuktena tathāpi śṛṇu me vacaḥ ..
na tvayā nirjitaḥ śakraḥ svavīryeṇa raṇājire .. 133 ..
14.36.d:
कुमार्याः कामयुक्तेन तथापि शृणु मे वचः ..
न त्वया निर्जितः शक्रः स्ववीर्येण रणाजिरे .. 133 ..
14.36.m: a maiden, while you are filled with lust. Even so, hear my word! / Śakra was not conquered by you on the battlefield through your own valor.

14.36.s:
pitāmaha varaṃ devā manyaṃte dānavādhama ..
gauravāttasya tena tvamātmānaṃ manyase'dhikam .. 134 ..
14.36.d:
पितामह वरं देवा मन्यंते दानवाधम ..
गौरवात्तस्य तेन त्वमात्मानं मन्यसेऽधिकम् .. 134 ..
14.36.m: The gods respect the boon of the Grandfather, lowest of Dānavas; / out of deference to him, you deem yourself superior.

14.36.s:
muktvaikāṃ kāminīṃ pāpa tvaṃ kṛtaḥ padmayoninā ..
avadhyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ puṃsaḥ jātau dharātale .. 135 ..
14.36.d:
मुक्त्वैकां कामिनीं पाप त्वं कृतः पद्मयोनिना ..
अवध्यः सर्वसत्त्वानां पुंसः जातौ धरातले .. 135 ..
14.36.m: Excepting a single woman, O wicked one, you were made by the lotus-born [Brahmā] / invulnerable to all living beings born male on the earth.

14.36.s:
pitāmahavaraḥ so'tra jayaśīlo'si dānava ..
yadi te pauruṣaṃ cāsti tacchīghraṃ saṃpradarśaya .. 136 ..
14.36.d:
पितामहवरः सोऽत्र जयशीलोऽसि दानव ..
यदि ते पौरुषं चास्ति तच्छीघ्रं संप्रदर्शय .. 136 ..
14.36.m: Because of that boon of the Grandfather, you are victorious here, O Dānava. / If you possess manhood, display it quickly!

14.36.s:
eṣā tvāmiṣubhistīkṣṇairnayāmi yamasādanam ..
evamuktvā tato devī śarānaṣṭau mumoca ha .. 137 ..
14.36.d:
एषा त्वामिषुभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामि यमसादनम् ..
एवमुक्त्वा ततो देवी शरानष्टौ मुमोच ह .. 137 ..
14.36.m: With sharp arrows, I am about to dispatch you to the realm of Yama.” / Having spoken thus, the goddess then released eight arrows.

14.36.s:
caturbhiścaturo vāhānanayadyamasādanam ..
sāratheśca śiraḥ kāyācchareṇaikena cākṣipat .. 138 ..
14.36.d:
चतुर्भिश्चतुरो वाहाननयद्यमसादनम् ..
सारथेश्च शिरः कायाच्छरेणैकेन चाक्षिपत् .. 138 ..
14.36.m: With four she sent the four steeds to the realm of Yama, / and with a single arrow she struck off the charioteer's head from his body.

14.36.s:
dhvajaṃ ciccheda caikena tato'nyena hṛdi kṣataḥ ..
sa gātraviddho vyathito dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samāśritaḥ .. .. 139 ..
14.36.d:
ध्वजं चिच्छेद चैकेन ततोऽन्येन हृदि क्षतः ..
स गात्रविद्धो व्यथितो ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रितः .. .. 139 ..
14.36.m: With one she cut down his standard, and then with another he was wounded in the chest; / pierced in his body and afflicted, he clung to the flagstaff,

14.36.s:
mūrchayā sahito rājankiṃcitkālamadhomukhaḥ ..
tataḥ sa cetano bhūtvā mumoca niśitāñcharān .. 7.3.36.140 ..
14.36.d:
मूर्छया सहितो राजन्किंचित्कालमधोमुखः ..
ततः स चेतनो भूत्वा मुमोच निशिताञ्छरान् .. 7.3.36.140 ..
14.36.m: overcome by swoon, O king, his head lowered for a brief time. / Then, regaining consciousness, he released sharp arrows.

14.36.s:
devī sakhīsamāyuktā sarvadeśeṣvatāḍayat ..
tataḥ kṣuraprabāṇena dhanustasya dvidhā'karot .. 141 ..
14.36.d:
देवी सखीसमायुक्ता सर्वदेशेष्वताडयत् ..
ततः क्षुरप्रबाणेन धनुस्तस्य द्विधाऽकरोत् .. 141 ..
14.36.m: He struck the goddess together with her companions on every part. / Then, with a razor-headed arrow, she cut his bow in two.

14.36.s:
chinnadhanvā tato daityaścarmakhaṅgasamanvitaḥ ..
vidrāvya sahasā devīṃ tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt.. 142 ..
14.36.d:
छिन्नधन्वा ततो दैत्यश्चर्मखङ्गसमन्वितः ..
विद्राव्य सहसा देवीं तिष्ठतिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्.. 142 ..
14.36.m: His bow broken, the Daitya, equipped with shield and sword, / rushed violently toward the goddess, shouting, “Halt, halt!”

14.36.s:
tasya cāpatatastūrṇaṃ khaḍgaṃ dvābhyāṃ hyakṛntayat ..
śarābhyāmardhabāṇena prahasya prāsameva ca .. 143 ..
14.36.d:
तस्य चापततस्तूर्णं खड्गं द्वाभ्यां ह्यकृन्तयत् ..
शराभ्यामर्धबाणेन प्रहस्य प्रासमेव च .. 143 ..
14.36.m: As he charged swiftly, laughing, she cut off his sword with two / arrows, and his spear with a crescent-headed arrow.

14.36.s:
viśastro viratho rājansa tadā dānavādhamaḥ ..
tato'smaraccharānbhūpa śastrāṇi vividhāni ca .. 144 ..
14.36.d:
विशस्त्रो विरथो राजन्स तदा दानवाधमः ..
ततोऽस्मरच्छरान्भूप शस्त्राणि विविधानि च .. 144 ..
14.36.m: Disarmed and chariotless, O king, that lowest of Dānavas / then remembered arrows, O king, and diverse kinds of weapons.

14.36.s:
brahmāstraṃ manasi dhyāyaṃstṛṇaṃ tasyai mumoca saḥ ..
muktenāstreṇa tasmiṃstu dhūmavartirvyajāyata .. 145 ..
14.36.d:
ब्रह्मास्त्रं मनसि ध्यायंस्तृणं तस्यै मुमोच सः ..
मुक्तेनास्त्रेण तस्मिंस्तु धूमवर्तिर्व्यजायत .. 145 ..
14.36.m: Meditating in his mind on the Brahmāstra, he discharged a blade of grass at her; / and as that weapon was hurled, a column of smoke arose.

14.36.s:
etasminneva kāle tu sa brahmāste divaukasaḥ ..
paraṃ bhayamanuprāptā dṛṣṭvā tasya parākramam .. 146 ..
14.36.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु स ब्रह्मास्ते दिवौकसः ..
परं भयमनुप्राप्ता दृष्ट्वा तस्य पराक्रमम् .. 146 ..
14.36.m: At that very time, the sky-dwellers along with Brahmā, / seeing his valor, became filled with extreme fear.

14.36.s:
tato devī kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā tadastraṃ pārthivottama ..
brahmāstreṇāhanattūrṇaṃ tato vyarthaṃ vyajāyata .. 147 ..
14.36.d:
ततो देवी क्षणं ध्यात्वा तदस्त्रं पार्थिवोत्तम ..
ब्रह्मास्त्रेणाहनत्तूर्णं ततो व्यर्थं व्यजायत .. 147 ..
14.36.m: Then, meditating for a moment, O best of kings, the goddess swiftly struck / that weapon down with a Brahmāstra; thereupon it became useless.

14.36.s:
brahmāstre viphale jāte hyāgneyaṃ dānavottamaḥ ..
preṣayāmāsa tāṃ kruddho hyahanadvāruṇena sā.. 148 ..
14.36.d:
ब्रह्मास्त्रे विफले जाते ह्याग्नेयं दानवोत्तमः ..
प्रेषयामास तां क्रुद्धो ह्यहनद्वारुणेन सा.. 148 ..
14.36.m: When the Brahmāstra became futile, the foremost of Dānavas in fury / sent the fire-weapon against her, but she struck it down with the water-weapon.

14.36.s:
evaṃ nānāprakārāṇi tena muktāni sā tadā ..
astrāṇi viphalānyeva cakre devī sahasraśaḥ .. 149 ..
14.36.d:
एवं नानाप्रकाराणि तेन मुक्तानि सा तदा ..
अस्त्राणि विफलान्येव चक्रे देवी सहस्रशः .. 149 ..
14.36.m: In this way, the various kinds of weapons released by him / in their thousands were rendered entirely futile by the goddess.

14.36.s:
evaṃ niḥśeṣitāstro'sau dānavo balavattaraḥ..
cakāra paramāṃ māyāṃ divyairastraiḥ sureśvarī.. 7.3.36.150..
14.36.d:
एवं निःशेषितास्त्रोऽसौ दानवो बलवत्तरः..
चकार परमां मायां दिव्यैरस्त्रैः सुरेश्वरी.. 7.3.36.150..
14.36.m: When his weapons were completely exhausted, that exceedingly powerful Dānava / employed supreme illusion. With divine weapons the ruler of the gods

14.36.s:
vyakṣipacca mahākāyaṃ mahiṣaṃ parvatākṛtim..
dīrghatīkṣṇaviṣāṇābhyāṃ yuktamaṃjanasaṃnibham.. 151..
14.36.d:
व्यक्षिपच्च महाकायं महिषं पर्वताकृतिम्..
दीर्घतीक्ष्णविषाणाभ्यां युक्तमंजनसंनिभम्.. 151..
14.36.m: repelled that huge-bodied buffalo, shaped like a mountain, / equipped with long, sharp horns and resembling collyrium.

14.36.s:
siṃhaskaṃdhaṃ ca sā devī tatastamadhyarohata..
khaḍgena tīkṣṇena śiro devī tasya nyakṛṃtata.. 152.
14.36.d:
सिंहस्कंधं च सा देवी ततस्तमध्यरोहत..
खड्गेन तीक्ष्णेन शिरो देवी तस्य न्यकृंतत.. 152.
14.36.m: Then that goddess mounted upon the shoulders of her lion; / with a sharp sword the goddess severed his head.

14.36.s:
śūlena bhedayāmāsa pṛṣṭhadeśe sureśvarī ..
tataḥ kalevarāttasmānniścakrāma mahānpumān .. 153 ..
14.36.d:
शूलेन भेदयामास पृष्ठदेशे सुरेश्वरी ..
ततः कलेवरात्तस्मान्निश्चक्राम महान्पुमान् .. 153 ..
14.36.m: The ruler of the gods pierced him in the back with her trident; / then from that body a great man emerged.

14.36.s:
carmakhaḍgadharo raudrastiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt ..
tamapyevaṃ gṛhītvā tatkeśapāśe sureśvarī .. 154 ..
14.36.d:
चर्मखड्गधरो रौद्रस्तिष्ठतिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ..
तमप्येवं गृहीत्वा तत्केशपाशे सुरेश्वरी .. 154 ..
14.36.m:
Bearing a shield and sword, furious, he cried: "Halt, halt!"
Seizing him too by his mass of hair, the queen of gods

14.36.s:
nistriṃśenāhanatproccaiḥ sa ca prāṇairvyayujyata ..
dānavaḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha pārśve siṃhavidārite .. 155 ..
14.36.d:
निस्त्रिंशेनाहनत्प्रोच्चैः स च प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत ..
दानवः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ पार्श्वे सिंहविदारिते .. 155 ..
14.36.m:
Struck [him] mightily with her sword, and his life was severed,
O best of kings, as the demon's flank was torn open by the lion.

14.36.s:
tato jaghāna bhūyo'pi dānavānsā ruṣānvitā ..
hataśeṣāśca ye daityā nirbhidya dharaṇītalam .. 156 ..
14.36.d:
ततो जघान भूयोऽपि दानवान्सा रुषान्विता ..
हतशेषाश्च ये दैत्या निर्भिद्य धरणीतलम् .. 156 ..
14.36.m:
Then, filled with wrath, she slew the demons once more.
And those Daityas who survived the slaughter, splitting the earth's surface,

14.36.s:
praviṣṭā bhayasaṃtrastāḥ pātālaṃ jīvitaiṣiṇaḥ ..
tato deva gaṇāḥ sarve vasavo maruto'śvinau ..157..
14.36.d:
प्रविष्टा भयसंत्रस्ताः पातालं जीवितैषिणः ..
ततो देव गणाः सर्वे वसवो मरुतोऽश्विनौ ..157..
14.36.m:
Entered Pātāla, terrified with fear, seeking their lives.
Then all the hosts of gods—the Vasus, Maruts, and Aśvins,

14.36.s:
viśvedevāstathā sādhyā rudrā guhyakakinnarāḥ ..
ādityāḥ śakrasaṃyuktāḥ sametya parameśvarīm .. 158 ..
14.36.d:
विश्वेदेवास्तथा साध्या रुद्रा गुह्यककिन्नराः ..
आदित्याः शक्रसंयुक्ताः समेत्य परमेश्वरीम् .. 158 ..
14.36.m:
The Viśvedevas, Sādhyas, Rudras, Guhyakas, and Kinnaras,
And the Ādityas together with Śakra—approached the supreme goddess.

14.36.s:
samaṃtāddivyapuṣpaiśca tāṃ devīṃ samavākiran ..
stuvaṃto vividhaiḥ stotrairnamaṃto bhaktitatparāḥ .. 159 ..
14.36.d:
समंताद्दिव्यपुष्पैश्च तां देवीं समवाकिरन् ..
स्तुवंतो विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्नमंतो भक्तितत्पराः .. 159 ..
14.36.m:
From all sides they showered that goddess with divine flowers,
Praising her with diverse hymns, bowing down, intent on devotion:

14.36.s:
yuktaṃ kṛtaṃ maheśāni yaddhataḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ ..
trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ dhvastaṃ pāpenānena suṃdari .. 7.3.36.160 ..
14.36.d:
युक्तं कृतं महेशानि यद्धतः पापकृत्तमः ..
त्रैलोक्यं सकलं ध्वस्तं पापेनानेन सुंदरि .. 7.3.36.160 ..
14.36.m:
"A fitting deed has been done, O Maheśānī, in that the greatest wrongdoer has been slain!
The entire triple world had been ruined by this sinner, O beautiful one!

14.36.s:
tvayā dattaṃ punā rājyaṃ vāsavasya triviṣṭape ..
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ yanmanasīpsitam ..
sarve devāḥ prasannāste pradāsyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 161 ..
14.36.d:
त्वया दत्तं पुना राज्यं वासवस्य त्रिविष्टपे ..
तस्माद्वरय भद्रं ते वरं यन्मनसीप्सितम् ..
सर्वे देवाः प्रसन्नास्ते प्रदास्यंति न संशयः .. 161 ..
14.36.m:
By you, kingship in heaven has again been given to Vāsava.
Therefore choose a boon, may it be well with you, whatever your heart desires!
All the gods are pleased with you and will grant it without a doubt."

14.36.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yadi devāḥ prasannā me yadi deyo varo mama ..
āśramo'traiva me puṇyo jāyatāṃ khyātisaṃyutaḥ.. 162..
14.36.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यदि देवाः प्रसन्ना मे यदि देयो वरो मम ..
आश्रमोऽत्रैव मे पुण्यो जायतां ख्यातिसंयुतः.. 162..
14.36.m:
The Goddess said:
"If the gods are pleased with me, if a boon is to be given to me,
let my holy hermitage, full of renown, come to be right here.

14.36.s: asmiṃścāhaṃ sadā devāḥ sthāsyāmi varaparvate.. 163..
14.36.d: अस्मिंश्चाहं सदा देवाः स्थास्यामि वरपर्वते.. 163..
14.36.m: And on this excellent mountain, O gods, I shall abide forever."

14.36.s:
rūpeṇānena deveśi ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti mānavāḥ..
āśrame'tra mahāpuṇye te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim..164..
14.36.d:
रूपेणानेन देवेशि ये त्वां द्रक्ष्यंति मानवाः..
आश्रमेऽत्र महापुण्ये ते यास्यंति परां गतिम्..164..
14.36.m:
"O queen of gods, those men who shall behold you in this form
in this greatly holy hermitage will attain the supreme goal.

14.36.s: brahmajñānasamāyuktāste bhaviṣyaṃti mānavāḥ.. 165..
14.36.d: ब्रह्मज्ञानसमायुक्तास्ते भविष्यंति मानवाः.. 165..
14.36.m: Those men will become endowed with knowledge of Brahman.

14.36.s:
yasmāccaṃḍaṃ kṛtaṃ karma tvayā dānavasūdanāt..
tasmāttvaṃ caṃḍikānāma loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi.. 166..
14.36.d:
यस्माच्चंडं कृतं कर्म त्वया दानवसूदनात्..
तस्मात्त्वं चंडिकानाम लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यसि.. 166..
14.36.m:
Because a fierce deed was done by you in destroying the demon,
therefore you shall attain renown in the world under the name Caṇḍikā.

14.36.s: tava nāmnā tathā khyāta āśramo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati.. 167..
14.36.d: तव नाम्ना तथा ख्यात आश्रमोऽयं भविष्यति.. 167..
14.36.m: Likewise, this hermitage will be renowned by your name.

14.36.s:
ye'tra kṛṣṇa caturddaśyāmāśvine māsi śobhane ..
piṃḍadānaṃ kariṣyaṃti snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitāḥ .. 168 ..
14.36.d:
येऽत्र कृष्ण चतुर्द्दश्यामाश्विने मासि शोभने ..
पिंडदानं करिष्यंति स्नानं कृत्वा समाहिताः .. 168 ..
14.36.m:
Those who, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the auspicious month of Āśvina,
bathe with focused mind and offer the funeral rice ball here,

14.36.s:
gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ kṛtyaṃ teṣāṃ devi bhaviṣyati ..
tvaddarśanāttathā muktiḥ pātakasya bhaviṣyati .. 169 ..
14.36.d:
गयाश्राद्धफलं कृत्यं तेषां देवि भविष्यति ..
त्वद्दर्शनात्तथा मुक्तिः पातकस्य भविष्यति .. 169 ..
14.36.m:
Shall obtain the fruit of performing the śrāddha at Gayā, O goddess;
and from the darśana of you there shall be liberation from sin."

14.36.s:
.. kṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ekarātriṃ bhaviṣyaṃti ye'tra śraddhāsamanvitāḥ ..
upavāsaparāsteṣāṃ pāpaṃ yāsyati saṃkṣayam .. 7.3.36.170 ..
14.36.d:
.. कृष्ण उवाच .. ..
एकरात्रिं भविष्यंति येऽत्र श्रद्धासमन्विताः ..
उपवासपरास्तेषां पापं यास्यति संक्षयम् .. 7.3.36.170 ..
14.36.m:
Kṛṣṇa said:
"Those endowed with faith who stay here for a single night
intent on fasting—their sin will go to destruction.

14.36.s:
putrahīnaśca yo martyo nārī vāpi samāhitā ..
tanmanāḥ piṃḍadānaṃ vai tathā snānaṃ kariṣyati ..
aputro labhate śīghraṃ suputraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 171 ..
14.36.d:
पुत्रहीनश्च यो मर्त्यो नारी वापि समाहिता ..
तन्मनाः पिंडदानं वै तथा स्नानं करिष्यति ..
अपुत्रो लभते शीघ्रं सुपुत्रं नात्र संशयः .. 171 ..
14.36.m:
And whatever sonless man or focused woman,
mindful of this, shall bathe and make an offering of the rice ball,
being sonless, will quickly obtain a good son; of this there is no doubt."

14.36.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
bhraṣṭarājyo nṛpo yo'tra snānaṃ dānaṃ kariṣyati ..
sarvaśatrukṣayastasya rājyāvāptirbhaviṣyati .. 172 .. ..
14.36.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
भ्रष्टराज्यो नृपो योऽत्र स्नानं दानं करिष्यति ..
सर्वशत्रुक्षयस्तस्य राज्यावाप्तिर्भविष्यति .. 172 .. ..
14.36.m:
Indra said:
"Whatever king who has lost his kingdom bathes and gives gifts here,
his enemies will all be destroyed and he will regain his kingdom."

14.36.s:
.. agniruvāca.. ..
atrāgatya śuciḥ śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ ..
ātmavittānusāreṇa tasya yajñaphalaṃ bhavet ..173..
14.36.d:
.. अग्निरुवाच.. ..
अत्रागत्य शुचिः श्राद्धं यः करिष्यति मानवः ..
आत्मवित्तानुसारेण तस्य यज्ञफलं भवेत् ..173..
14.36.m:
Agni said:
"Whatever pure person, having come here, performs a śrāddha
according to his wealth, shall have the fruit of a sacrifice."

14.36.s:
.. yama uvāca.. ..
atra snātvā tilānyastu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyati ..
alpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya na kadācidbhaviṣyati ..174..
14.36.d:
.. यम उवाच.. ..
अत्र स्नात्वा तिलान्यस्तु ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदास्यति ..
अल्पमृत्युभयं तस्य न कदाचिद्भविष्यति ..174..
14.36.m:
Yama said:
"He who, having bathed here, gives sesame seeds to brahmins
will never have any fear of premature death."

14.36.s:
.. rākṣasā ūcuḥ .. ..
piṃḍadānaṃ narā ye'tra kariṣyaṃti tavā''śrame ..
pretotthaṃ na bhayaṃ tasya devi kvāpi bhaviṣyati ..175..
14.36.d:
.. राक्षसा ऊचुः .. ..
पिंडदानं नरा येऽत्र करिष्यंति तवा'ऽश्रमे ..
प्रेतोत्थं न भयं तस्य देवि क्वापि भविष्यति ..175..
14.36.m:
The Rākṣasas said:
"Those men who offer the rice ball here in your hermitage,
O goddess, shall have no fear anywhere arising from ghosts."

14.36.s:
.. varuṇa uvāca .. ..
snānārthaṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ yo'tra toyaṃ pradāsyati ..
vimalastu sadā bhāvi iha loke paratra ca .. 176 ..
14.36.d:
.. वरुण उवाच .. ..
स्नानार्थं ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां योऽत्र तोयं प्रदास्यति ..
विमलस्तु सदा भावि इह लोके परत्र च .. 176 ..
14.36.m:
Varuṇa said:
"He who gives water here for the bathing of noble brahmins
shall always be spotless in this world and in the next."

14.36.s:
.. vāyuruvāca .. ..
vilepanāni śubhrāṇi sugaṃdhāni viśeṣataḥ ..
yotra dāsyati viprebhyo nīrogaḥ sa bhaviṣyati .. 177 ..
14.36.d:
.. वायुरुवाच .. ..
विलेपनानि शुभ्राणि सुगंधानि विशेषतः ..
योत्र दास्यति विप्रेभ्यो नीरोगः स भविष्यति .. 177 ..
14.36.m:
Vāyu said:
"He who gives pure and especially fragrant ointments
to brahmins here shall become free from disease."

14.36.s:
.. dhanada uvāca .. ..
yo'tra vittaṃ yathāśaktyā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyati ..
na bhaviṣyati loke sa vittahīnaḥ kathaṃcana .. .. 178 ..
14.36.d:
.. धनद उवाच .. ..
योऽत्र वित्तं यथाशक्त्या ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदास्यति ..
न भविष्यति लोके स वित्तहीनः कथंचन .. .. 178 ..
14.36.m:
Dhanada said:
"He who gives wealth according to his ability to brahmins here
will by no means be bereft of wealth in the world."

14.36.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yo'tra vrataparo bhūtvā cāturmāsyaṃ vasiṣyati ..
iha loke pare caiva tasya bhāvi sadā sukham .. 179 .. ..
14.36.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
योऽत्र व्रतपरो भूत्वा चातुर्मास्यं वसिष्यति ..
इह लोके परे चैव तस्य भावि सदा सुखम् .. 179 .. ..
14.36.m:
Īśvara said:
"He who, observing a vow, dwells here during Cāturmāsya
shall always have happiness in this world and in the next."

14.36.s:
.. vasava ūcuḥ .. ..
trirātraṃ yo naraḥ samyagupavāsaṃ kariṣyati ..
ājanmamaraṇātpāpānmuktaḥ sa ca bhaviṣyati ..7.3.36.180...
14.36.d:
.. वसव ऊचुः .. ..
त्रिरात्रं यो नरः सम्यगुपवासं करिष्यति ..
आजन्ममरणात्पापान्मुक्तः स च भविष्यति ..7.3.36.180...
14.36.m:
The Vasus said:
"The man who properly observes a fast for three nights
shall be freed from the sins accumulated from birth to death."

14.36.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
atrāśramapade puṇye ye narā bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ..
chatropānatpradātārasteṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ .. 181 ..
14.36.d:
.. आदित्य उवाच .. ..
अत्राश्रमपदे पुण्ये ये नरा भक्तिसंयुताः ..
छत्रोपानत्प्रदातारस्तेषां लोकाः सनातनाः .. 181 ..
14.36.m:
Āditya said:
"Those men who, filled with devotion, give parasols and shoes
in this holy hermitage abode shall attain eternal worlds."

14.36.s:
.. aśvināvūcatuḥ .. ..
miṣṭānnaṃ śraddhayopeto brāhmaṇāya pradāsyati ..
yo'tra tasya parā prītirbhaviṣyatyavināśinī 1. 182 ..
14.36.d:
.. अश्विनावूचतुः .. ..
मिष्टान्नं श्रद्धयोपेतो ब्राह्मणाय प्रदास्यति ..
योऽत्र तस्य परा प्रीतिर्भविष्यत्यविनाशिनी 1. 182 ..
14.36.m:
The Aśvins said:
"He who, filled with faith, offers sweet food to a brahmin here
shall have supreme, imperishable joy."

14.36.s:
.. tīrthānyūcuḥ .. ..
adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāmiha saṃsthitiḥ ..
bhaviṣyati viśeṣeṇa hyāśrame lokaviśrute ..183..
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyāmāśvine māsi bhaktitaḥ ..
upavāsaparo bhūtvā yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati ..
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ sa phalaṃ hi labhiṣyati .. 1-4 ..
14.36.d:
.. तीर्थान्यूचुः .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषां तीर्थानामिह संस्थितिः ..
भविष्यति विशेषेण ह्याश्रमे लोकविश्रुते ..183..
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्द्दश्यामाश्विने मासि भक्तितः ..
उपवासपरो भूत्वा योऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यति ..
सर्वेषामेव तीर्थानां स फलं हि लभिष्यति .. 1-4 ..
14.36.m:
The sacred fords said:
"From this day forward, the presence of all the sacred fords
will be established particularly here in this world-renowned hermitage.
He who, intent on fasting, bathes here with devotion
on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Āśvina
shall indeed obtain the fruit of all sacred fords."

14.36.s:
.. gaṃdharvā ūcuḥ .. ..
gītavādyāni yaścātra prakariṣyati mānavaḥ ..
saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva rūpavānsa bhaviṣyati .. 185 ..
14.36.d:
.. गंधर्वा ऊचुः .. ..
गीतवाद्यानि यश्चात्र प्रकरिष्यति मानवः ..
सप्तजन्मांतराण्येव रूपवान्स भविष्यति .. 185 ..
14.36.m:
The Gandharvas said:
"And whatever person performs songs and instrumental music here
shall be handsome across seven successive births."

14.36.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
āśrame'smiṃstrirātraṃ ya upavāsaṃ kariṣyati ..
cāṃdrāyaṇasahasrasya phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati .. 186 ..
14.36.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
आश्रमेऽस्मिंस्त्रिरात्रं य उपवासं करिष्यति ..
चांद्रायणसहस्रस्य फलं तस्य भविष्यति .. 186 ..
14.36.m:
The seers said:
"He who fasts for three nights in this hermitage
shall attain the fruit of a thousand Cāndrāyaṇa penances."

14.36.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sarve varāndattvā devyai devā nṛpottama ..
tadājñayā divaṃ jagmurdevī tatraiva saṃsthitā .. 187 ..
14.36.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवं सर्वे वरान्दत्त्वा देव्यै देवा नृपोत्तम ..
तदाज्ञया दिवं जग्मुर्देवी तत्रैव संस्थिता .. 187 ..
14.36.m:
Pulastya said:
Having thus granted boons to the goddess, O best of kings, all the gods
went to heaven with her permission, while the goddess remained right there.

14.36.s:
atha marttyā divaṃ jagmurdṛṣṭvā devīṃ tadāśrame ..
anāyāsena saṃpūrṇāstato martyaistriviṣṭapaḥ .. 188 ..
14.36.d:
अथ मर्त्त्या दिवं जग्मुर्दृष्ट्वा देवीं तदाश्रमे ..
अनायासेन संपूर्णास्ततो मर्त्यैस्त्रिविष्टपः .. 188 ..
14.36.m:
Then mortals went to heaven upon seeing the goddess in that hermitage;
heaven was filled effortlessly with mortals.

14.36.s:
agniṣṭomādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā naṣṭā dharātale ..
dharmakriyāstathā cānyā muktvā devyāḥ prapūjanam .. 189 ..
14.36.d:
अग्निष्टोमादिकाः सर्वाः क्रिया नष्टा धरातले ..
धर्मक्रियास्तथा चान्या मुक्त्वा देव्याः प्रपूजनम् .. 189 ..
14.36.m:
All rituals such as the Agniṣṭoma perished on the face of the earth,
as did other religious rites, except for the worship of the goddess.

14.36.s:
tato bhītaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ saṃmaṃtrya guruṇā saha ..
āhvayāmāsa vegena kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ madam .. 7.3.36.190 ..
14.36.d:
ततो भीतः सहस्राक्षः संमंत्र्य गुरुणा सह ..
आह्वयामास वेगेन कामं क्रोधं भयं मदम् .. 7.3.36.190 ..
14.36.m:
Then, terrified, the thousand-eyed [Indra], consulting with his preceptor,
speedily summoned Desire, Anger, Fear, Pride,

14.36.s:
vyāmohaṃ gṛhaputrotthaṃ tṛṣṇāmāyāsamanvitam ..
gatvā yūyaṃ drutaṃ martye sthātukāmānnarānstriyaḥ ..191..
14.36.d:
व्यामोहं गृहपुत्रोत्थं तृष्णामायासमन्वितम् ..
गत्वा यूयं द्रुतं मर्त्ये स्थातुकामान्नरान्स्त्रियः ..191..
14.36.m:
Delusion arising from house and sons, and Thirst accompanied by exertion:
"Go quickly to the mortal realm, to the men and women wishing to stay

14.36.s:
caṃḍikāyatane puṇye sevadhvaṃ hi mamājñayā ..
viśeṣeṇāśvine māsi kṛṣṇapakṣeṃ'tyavāsare .. 192 ..
14.36.d:
चंडिकायतने पुण्ये सेवध्वं हि ममाज्ञया ..
विशेषेणाश्विने मासि कृष्णपक्षेंऽत्यवासरे .. 192 ..
14.36.m: In the holy sanctuary of Caṇḍikā, and attend on them by my command, / especially in the month of Āśvina on the final day of the dark fortnight."

14.36.s:
evamuktāstataḥ sarve kāmādyāste drutaṃ yayuḥ ..
martyaloke mahārāja rakṣāṃ cakruśca sarvaśaḥ .. 193 ..
14.36.d:
एवमुक्तास्ततः सर्वे कामाद्यास्ते द्रुतं ययुः ..
मर्त्यलोके महाराज रक्षां चक्रुश्च सर्वशः .. 193 ..
14.36.m: Having been spoken to thus, all those headed by Desire went swiftly, / and in the mortal realm, O great king, they kept guard on every side.

14.36.s:
evaṃ jñātvā drutaṃ gaccha tatra pārthivasattama ..
yadīcchasi paraṃ śreya iha loke paratra ca .. 194 ..
14.36.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा द्रुतं गच्छ तत्र पार्थिवसत्तम ..
यदीच्छसि परं श्रेय इह लोके परत्र च .. 194 ..
14.36.m: Knowing this, go quickly there, O best of kings, / if you desire the highest welfare in this world and the next.

14.36.s:
yo yāti caṃḍikāṃ draṣṭumaburdaṃ prati pārthiva ..
nṛtyaṃti pitarastasya garjaṃti ca pitāmahāḥ .. 195 ..
14.36.d:
यो याति चंडिकां द्रष्टुमबुर्दं प्रति पार्थिव ..
नृत्यंति पितरस्तस्य गर्जंति च पितामहाः .. 195 ..
14.36.m: Whoever goes to Arbuda to see Caṇḍikā, O king, / his ancestors dance and his grandfathers roar [with joy]:

14.36.s:
tārayiṣyati naḥ sarvānsa putro ya ihāśrame ..
caṃḍikāyāḥ pragatvā'tha kuryācchrāddhaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 196 ..
14.36.d:
तारयिष्यति नः सर्वान्स पुत्रो य इहाश्रमे ..
चंडिकायाः प्रगत्वाऽथ कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं समाहितः .. 196 ..
14.36.m: “That son who, having gone to this hermitage of Caṇḍikā, / performs a śrāddha with concentrated mind, will deliver us all.”

14.36.s:
ekayā labhyate rājyaṃ svargaścaiva dvitīyayā ..
tṛtīyayā bhavenmokṣo yātrayā tatra pārthiva .. 197 ..
14.36.d:
एकया लभ्यते राज्यं स्वर्गश्चैव द्वितीयया ..
तृतीयया भवेन्मोक्षो यात्रया तत्र पार्थिव .. 197 ..
14.36.m: By one pilgrimage a kingdom is attained, and heaven indeed by a second; / by a third pilgrimage there, liberation is attained, O king.

14.36.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrāṃ tatra samācaret ..
arbude parvataśreṣṭhe sarvatīrthamaye śubhe .. 198 ..
tatra ślokaḥ purā gīto nāradena maharṣiṇā ..
snātvā tatrāśrame puṇye bahuvipra samāgame .. 119 ..
14.36.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यात्रां तत्र समाचरेत् ..
अर्बुदे पर्वतश्रेष्ठे सर्वतीर्थमये शुभे .. 198 ..
तत्र श्लोकः पुरा गीतो नारदेन महर्षिणा ..
स्नात्वा तत्राश्रमे पुण्ये बहुविप्र समागमे .. 119 ..
14.36.m:
Therefore, by every effort, one should make a pilgrimage there, / to Arbuda, the best of mountains, composed of all sacred fords and auspicious.
On this point a verse was sung in ancient times by the great seer Nārada: / “Having bathed in that sacred hermitage, where many brahmins assemble,

14.36.s:
punaṃtyevānyatīrthāni snānadānairasaṃśayam ..
arbudālokanādeva vipāpmā tatra jāyate .. 7.3.36.200 ..
14.36.d:
पुनंत्येवान्यतीर्थानि स्नानदानैरसंशयम् ..
अर्बुदालोकनादेव विपाप्मा तत्र जायते .. 7.3.36.200 ..
14.36.m: other sacred fords certainly purify through ablutions and gifts, / but merely from the sight of Arbuda, one becomes freed from sin there.”

14.36.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti sadākhyānameta cchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
sa prāpnoti naraśreṣṭha kāmānmanasi vāṃchitān .. 201 ..
14.36.d:
यः शृणोति सदाख्यानमेत च्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
स प्राप्नोति नरश्रेष्ठ कामान्मनसि वांछितान् .. 201 ..
14.36.m: Whoever hears this sacred narrative endowed with faith, / he obtains, O best of men, the desires wished for in his heart.

14.36.s:
yasyaitattiṣṭhate gehe likhitaṃ pustakaṃ nṛpa ..
tasyāpi vāṃchitāḥ kāmāḥ saṃpadyate dinedine .. 202 ..
14.36.d:
यस्यैतत्तिष्ठते गेहे लिखितं पुस्तकं नृप ..
तस्यापि वांछिताः कामाः संपद्यते दिनेदिने .. 202 ..
14.36.m: In whose house this written book remains, O king, / his wished-for desires are also fulfilled day by day.

14.36.s:
paṭhati śraddhayopeto yo vā bhūmipate naraḥ ..
so'pi yātrāphalaṃ rājam̐llabhate puruṣottamaḥ .. 203 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe .tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe caṃḍikāśramotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 36 ..
14.36.d:
पठति श्रद्धयोपेतो यो वा भूमिपते नरः ..
सोऽपि यात्राफलं राजम्̐ल्लभते पुरुषोत्तमः .. 203 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे .तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे चंडिकाश्रमोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 36 ..
14.36.m:
Or whatever man, endowed with faith, reads it, O lord of the earth, / that best of men also obtains the fruit of pilgrimage, O king.
Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named “Description of the Origin and Greatness of the Hermitage of Caṇḍikā,” in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.37.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
nāgahradaṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
yatra nāgaistapastaptaṃ ramye parvatarodhasi .. 1 ..
14.37.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
नागह्रदं ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
यत्र नागैस्तपस्तप्तं रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि .. 1 ..
14.37.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to the pool of the Nāgas, a sacred ford that destroys sins, / where the Nāgas performed austerity on the pleasant mountain slope.

14.37.s:
kadrūśāpaṃ purā śrutvā nāgāḥ sarve bhayāturāḥ ..
papracchurnāgarājānaṃ śeṣaṃ praṇatakandharāḥ .. 2 ..
14.37.d:
कद्रूशापं पुरा श्रुत्वा नागाः सर्वे भयातुराः ..
पप्रच्छुर्नागराजानं शेषं प्रणतकन्धराः .. 2 ..
14.37.m: Formerly, having heard Kadrū’s curse, all the Nāgas, afflicted with fear, / asked Śeṣa, the king of the Nāgas, with their necks bowed:

14.37.s:
mātṛśāpena saṃtaptā vayaṃ pannagasattama ..
kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ śāpamokṣo bhavetkatham.. 3 ..
14.37.d:
मातृशापेन संतप्ता वयं पन्नगसत्तम ..
किं कुर्मः क्व च गच्छामः शापमोक्षो भवेत्कथम्.. 3 ..
14.37.m: “Tormented by our mother’s curse, O best of serpents, / what shall we do and where shall we go? How might release from the curse come about?”

14.37.s:
.. śeṣa uvāca .. ..
prasāditā mayā mātā śāpamuktikṛte purā ..
tayoktaṃ ye tapoyuktā dharmātmānaḥ susaṃyatāḥ .. 4 ..
14.37.d:
.. शेष उवाच .. ..
प्रसादिता मया माता शापमुक्तिकृते पुरा ..
तयोक्तं ये तपोयुक्ता धर्मात्मानः सुसंयताः .. 4 ..
14.37.m: Śeṣa said: / “Formerly our mother was propitiated by me for the sake of release from the curse. / By her it was said: ‘Those who are endowed with austerity, righteous, and well-restrained,

14.37.s:
na dahiṣyati tānvahniryajñe pārikṣitasya hi ..
tasmādgatvārbudaṃnāma parvataṃ dharaṇītale .. 5 ..
14.37.d:
न दहिष्यति तान्वह्निर्यज्ञे पारिक्षितस्य हि ..
तस्माद्गत्वार्बुदंनाम पर्वतं धरणीतले .. 5 ..
14.37.m: fire will not burn them at the sacrifice of the son of Parīkṣit.’ / Therefore, having gone to the mountain named Arbuda on the earth's surface,

14.37.s:
tatra yūyaṃ tapoyuktā bhavadhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ ..
yatrāste sā svayaṃ devī caṃḍikā kāmarūpiṇī .. 6 ..
14.37.d:
तत्र यूयं तपोयुक्ता भवध्वं सुसमाहिताः ..
यत्रास्ते सा स्वयं देवी चंडिका कामरूपिणी .. 6 ..
14.37.m: there become endowed with austerity and well-concentrated, / where that goddess Caṇḍikā, who assumes forms at will, herself resides.

14.37.s:
yasyāḥ saṃkīrttanenāpi naśyaṃti vipado dhruvam ..
ārādhayadhvamaniśaṃ tāṃ devīṃ mama vākyataḥ .. 7 ..
14.37.d:
यस्याः संकीर्त्तनेनापि नश्यंति विपदो ध्रुवम् ..
आराधयध्वमनिशं तां देवीं मम वाक्यतः .. 7 ..
14.37.m: Even by the praising of her, misfortunes certainly perish. / Worship that goddess constantly according to my word.

14.37.s:
tasyāḥ prasādataḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha gatajvarāḥ ..
etamevātra paśyāmi upāyaṃ nāgasattamāḥ ..
daivo vā mānuṣo vā'pi nānyo vo muktikārakaḥ .. 8 ..
14.37.d:
तस्याः प्रसादतः सर्वे भविष्यथ गतज्वराः ..
एतमेवात्र पश्यामि उपायं नागसत्तमाः ..
दैवो वा मानुषो वाऽपि नान्यो वो मुक्तिकारकः .. 8 ..
14.37.m: By her grace you will all be free from feverish anguish. / This alone is the means that I see here, O best of Nāgas; / divine or human, there is no other cause of liberation for you.”

14.37.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktāstato nāgā nāgarājena pārthiva ..
praṇamya taṃ tato jagmurarbudaṃ parvataṃ prati .. 9 ..
14.37.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तास्ततो नागा नागराजेन पार्थिव ..
प्रणम्य तं ततो जग्मुरर्बुदं पर्वतं प्रति .. 9 ..
14.37.m: Pulastya said: / Having been addressed thus by the king of the Nāgas, O king, / they bowed to him and then departed toward Mount Arbuda.

14.37.s:
te bhittvā dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ parvate tadanantaram ..
nijagmurbilamārgeṇa kṛtvā śvabhre suvistaram .. 7.3.37.10 ..
14.37.d:
ते भित्त्वा धरणीपृष्ठं पर्वते तदनन्तरम् ..
निजग्मुर्बिलमार्गेण कृत्वा श्वभ्रे सुविस्तरम् .. 7.3.37.10 ..
14.37.m: Cleaving the surface of the earth on the mountain immediately thereafter, / they went through a cavernous route, having made a wide opening in the chasm.

14.37.s:
tato dhṛtavratāḥ sarve devī bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ..
vasaṃti bhaktisaṃyuktāścaṇḍikārādhanāya te .. 11 ..
14.37.d:
ततो धृतव्रताः सर्वे देवी भक्तिपरायणाः ..
वसंति भक्तिसंयुक्ताश्चण्डिकाराधनाय ते .. 11 ..
14.37.m: Then, having undertaken vows, all devoted to the worship of the goddess, / they dwelt endowed with devotion for the propitiation of Caṇḍikā.

14.37.s:
tasthustatra sadā homaṃ kurvanto jāpyamuttamam ..
ekāhārā nirāhārā vāyubhakṣāstathā pare .. 12 ..
14.37.d:
तस्थुस्तत्र सदा होमं कुर्वन्तो जाप्यमुत्तमम् ..
एकाहारा निराहारा वायुभक्षास्तथा परे .. 12 ..
14.37.m: They remained there always offering oblations and performing supreme silent recitation: / some taking one meal, some taking no food, and others subsisting on wind;

14.37.s:
dantolūkhalinaḥ kecidaśmakuṭṭāstathā pare ..
pañcāgnisādhakāścānye sadyaḥ prakṣālakāstathā .. 13 ..
14.37.d:
दन्तोलूखलिनः केचिदश्मकुट्टास्तथा परे ..
पञ्चाग्निसाधकाश्चान्ये सद्यः प्रक्षालकास्तथा .. 13 ..
14.37.m: some using their teeth as mortars, others crushing food with stones, / others practicing the five fires, and likewise those who wash their vessels immediately.

14.37.s:
gītaṃ vādyaṃ tathā cakruranye devāḥ purastadā ..
ananyaśradayopetāṃstāndṛṣṭvā pannagottamān .. 14 ..
14.37.d:
गीतं वाद्यं तथा चक्रुरन्ये देवाः पुरस्तदा ..
अनन्यश्रदयोपेतांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा पन्नगोत्तमान् .. 14 ..
14.37.m: Other gods then performed songs and instrumental music before them, / seeing those best of serpents endowed with undivided faith.

14.37.s: tato devī susantuṣṭā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 15 .. ..
14.37.d: ततो देवी सुसन्तुष्टा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 15 .. ..
14.37.m: Then the goddess, thoroughly pleased, spoke these words:

14.37.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
parituṣṭāsmi vo vatsāḥ kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ ..
varayadhvaṃ varaṃ matto yaḥ sthito bhavatāṃ hṛdi .. 16 ..
14.37.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
परितुष्टास्मि वो वत्साः किमर्थं तप्यते तपः ..
वरयध्वं वरं मत्तो यः स्थितो भवतां हृदि .. 16 ..
14.37.m: The goddess said: / “I am well pleased with you, my children! For what purpose is this austerity practiced? / Choose a boon from me that rests in your heart.”

14.37.s:
.. nāgā ūcuḥ .. ..
mātṛśāpena saṃtaptā vayaṃ devi nirāśrayāḥ ..
nāgarājasamādeśāccharaṇaṃ tvāṃ samāgatāḥ .. 17 ..
14.37.d:
.. नागा ऊचुः .. ..
मातृशापेन संतप्ता वयं देवि निराश्रयाः ..
नागराजसमादेशाच्छरणं त्वां समागताः .. 17 ..
14.37.m: The Nāgas said: / “Tormented by our mother’s curse, O goddess, we are without refuge. / By the command of the king of Nāgas, we have come to you for refuge.

14.37.s:
sā tvaṃ rakṣa bhayāttasmācchāpavahnisamudbhavāt ..
vayaṃ mātrā purā śaptāḥ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare ..
pārikṣitasya yajñe vaḥ pāvako bhakṣayiṣyati .. 18 ..
14.37.d:
सा त्वं रक्ष भयात्तस्माच्छापवह्निसमुद्भवात् ..
वयं मात्रा पुरा शप्ताः कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे ..
पारिक्षितस्य यज्ञे वः पावको भक्षयिष्यति .. 18 ..
14.37.m: Protect us from that fear arising from the fire of the curse! / Formerly, for a certain reason, we were cursed by our mother: / ‘At the sacrifice of the son of Parīkṣit, the fire will consume you!’”

14.37.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yāvattasya bhavedyajña stāvadyūyaṃ mamāntike ..
saṃtiṣṭhata vinā bhītyā bhogānbhuṅdhvaṃ supuṣkalān .. 19 ..
14.37.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यावत्तस्य भवेद्यज्ञ स्तावद्यूयं ममान्तिके ..
संतिष्ठत विना भीत्या भोगान्भुङ्ध्वं सुपुष्कलान् .. 19 ..
14.37.m: The goddess said: / “As long as his sacrifice lasts, so long remain near me / without fear, and enjoy abundant pleasures.

14.37.s:
samāpte ca kratau bhūyo gaṃtāraḥ svaṃ niketanam ..
yuṣmābhirbheditaṃ yasmādetatparvatakandaram .. 7.3.37.20 ..
14.37.d:
समाप्ते च क्रतौ भूयो गंतारः स्वं निकेतनम् ..
युष्माभिर्भेदितं यस्मादेतत्पर्वतकन्दरम् .. 7.3.37.20 ..
14.37.m: And when the rite is finished, you will go again to your own abode. / Since this mountain cave was pierced by you,

14.37.s:
nāgahradaṃ tu tattīrthametadbhāvi dharātale ..
atra yaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ bhaktitatparaḥ .. 21 ..
14.37.d:
नागह्रदं तु तत्तीर्थमेतद्भावि धरातले ..
अत्र यः श्रावणे मासि पञ्चम्यां भक्तितत्परः .. 21 ..
14.37.m: this shall become a sacred ford on the earth’s surface known as Nāgahrada. / Here, whatever man, intent on devotion on the fifth day of the month of Śrāvaṇa,

14.37.s:
kariṣyati naraḥ snānaṃ tasya nāhikṛtaṃ bhayam ..
bhaviṣyati punaḥ śrāddhātpitṝnsaṃtārayiṣyati .. 22 ..
14.37.d:
करिष्यति नरः स्नानं तस्य नाहिकृतं भयम् ..
भविष्यति पुनः श्राद्धात्पितॄन्संतारयिष्यति .. 22 ..
14.37.m: shall perform a ritual ablution, for him there will be no fear caused by snakes; / moreover, through a śrāddha, he will deliver his ancestors.

14.37.s:
ye bhogā bhūtale khyātā ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ..
naro nityaṃ labhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 23 ..
14.37.d:
ये भोगा भूतले ख्याता ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः ..
नरो नित्यं लभिष्यति न संशयः .. 23 ..
14.37.m: Whatever pleasures are known on earth, whatever are divine and whatever are human, / a man will always obtain them, without doubt.”

14.37.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato hṛṣṭā babhūvuste muktvā taddāruṇaṃ bhayam ..
devyāḥ śaraṇamāpannāstasthustatra nagottame .. 24 ..
14.37.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो हृष्टा बभूवुस्ते मुक्त्वा तद्दारुणं भयम् ..
देव्याः शरणमापन्नास्तस्थुस्तत्र नगोत्तमे .. 24 ..
14.37.m: Pulastya said: / Then they became rejoiced, having been released from that dreadful fear; / having taken refuge with the goddess, they stayed there on the best of mountains.

14.37.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā satre pārikṣitasya ca ..
nirvṛtte te tadā jagmuḥ sunirvṛttā rasātalam .. 25 ..
14.37.d:
ततः कालेन महता सत्रे पारिक्षितस्य च ..
निर्वृत्ते ते तदा जग्मुः सुनिर्वृत्ता रसातलम् .. 25 ..
14.37.m: Then after a long time, when the sacrificial session of the son of Parīkṣit / was completed, they went, fully at peace, to Rasātala.

14.37.s:
devyā caivābhyanujñātāḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ..
kṛcchrātpārthivaśārdūla tadbhaktyā niścalīkṛtāḥ .. 26 ..
14.37.d:
देव्या चैवाभ्यनुज्ञाताः प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..
कृच्छ्रात्पार्थिवशार्दूल तद्भक्त्या निश्चलीकृताः .. 26 ..
14.37.m: Permitted by the goddess, having prostrated again and again / with difficulty, O tiger among kings, made immobile by their devotion to her,

14.37.s:
adyāpi kṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi pārthiva ..
sānnidhyaṃ tatra kurvaṃti devīdarśanalālasāḥ .. 27 ..
14.37.d:
अद्यापि कृष्णपंचम्यां श्रावणे मासि पार्थिव ..
सान्निध्यं तत्र कुर्वंति देवीदर्शनलालसाः .. 27 ..
14.37.m: even today on the dark fifth lunar day in the month of Śrāvaṇa, O king, / they manifest their presence there, eager for the darśana of the goddess.

14.37.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret ..
snānaṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 28 ..
14.37.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन श्राद्धं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
स्नानं च पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः .. 28 ..
14.37.m: Therefore, with every effort one should perform a śrāddha there, / and a ritual ablution, O best of kings, if one desires welfare for oneself.

14.37.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe nāgodbhavatīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 37 ..
14.37.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे नागोद्भवतीर्थमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 37 ..
14.37.m: Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, named “Description of the Greatness of the Sacred Ford Arising from the Nāgas,” in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.38.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
kuṃḍaṃ tu śivaliṃgākhyaṃ tato gacchenmahīpate ..
yatra sā jāhnavī guptā tiṣṭhate bhūpasattama .. 1 ..
14.38.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
कुंडं तु शिवलिंगाख्यं ततो गच्छेन्महीपते ..
यत्र सा जाह्नवी गुप्ता तिष्ठते भूपसत्तम .. 1 ..
14.38.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O king, to the pool named Śivaliṅga, / where the hidden Jāhnavī resides, O best of kings.

14.38.s:
tasyāṃ snāto naraḥ samyaksarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet ..
mucyate pātakātkṛtsnādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt .. 2 ..
14.38.d:
तस्यां स्नातो नरः सम्यक्सर्वतीर्थफलं लभेत् ..
मुच्यते पातकात्कृत्स्नादाजन्ममरणांतिकात् .. 2 ..
14.38.m: A man who performs ritual ablution in it properly obtains the fruit of all sacred fords; / he is freed from all sin from birth until the end of life. (2)

14.38.s:
.. yayāti ruvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ tatra sā guptā jāhnavī tiṣṭhate vibho ..
kasminkāle samāyātā paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 3 ..
14.38.d:
.. ययाति रुवाच .. ..
किमर्थं तत्र सा गुप्ता जाह्नवी तिष्ठते विभो ..
कस्मिन्काले समायाता परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 3 ..
14.38.m: Yayāti said: / For what reason does that Jāhnavī remain hidden there, O lord? / At what time did she arrive? Great indeed is my curiosity. (3)

14.38.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
yadā prasādito devairbhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
arbude'sminsadā stheyamacalena tvayā vibho .. 4..
14.38.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
यदा प्रसादितो देवैर्भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
अर्बुदेऽस्मिन्सदा स्थेयमचलेन त्वया विभो .. 4..
14.38.m: Pulastya said: / When the blessed Lord whose banner bears the bull was propitiated by the gods, [they said:] / "You must always dwell immovable on this Arbuda, O lord!" (4)

14.38.s:
tatra saṃsthāpite liṃge svayaṃ devena śaṃbhunā ..
yatpātitaṃ purā liṃgaṃ vālakhilyairmaharṣibhiḥ .. 5 ..
14.38.d:
तत्र संस्थापिते लिंगे स्वयं देवेन शंभुना ..
यत्पातितं पुरा लिंगं वालखिल्यैर्महर्षिभिः .. 5 ..
14.38.m: When that liṅga was installed there by the god Śambhu himself— / the liṅga which had formerly been cast down by the great seers, the Vālakhilyas, (5)

14.38.s:
atikopasamāyuktaiḥ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare ..
tadā devena pratijñātaṃ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām .. 6 ..
14.38.d:
अतिकोपसमायुक्तैः कस्मिंश्चित्कारणांतरे ..
तदा देवेन प्रतिज्ञातं सर्वेषां त्रिदिवौकसाम् .. 6 ..
14.38.m: filled with intense wrath for some other reason— / then the god made a promise to all the dwellers of heaven: (6)

14.38.s:
acale tu mayātraiva sthātavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
tataḥ kālena mahatā vasatastasya tatra ca .. 7 ..
14.38.d:
अचले तु मयात्रैव स्थातव्यं नात्र संशयः ..
ततः कालेन महता वसतस्तस्य तत्र च .. 7 ..
14.38.m: "Indeed, I shall remain right here upon the mountain; there is no doubt about this." / Then, after a long time had passed while he dwelt there, (7)

14.38.s:
acaleśvararūpasya gaṃgā citte vyajāyata ..
kathaṃ nityaṃ tayā sārddhaṃ bhaviṣyati samāgamaḥ .. 8 ..
14.38.d:
अचलेश्वररूपस्य गंगा चित्ते व्यजायत ..
कथं नित्यं तया सार्द्धं भविष्यति समागमः .. 8 ..
14.38.m: the thought of Gaṅgā arose in the mind of the Lord of the Mountain [Śiva]: / "How can there be a constant union with her, (8)

14.38.s:
atha jānāti no gaurī māninī parameśvarī ..
tasyaivaṃ cintayānasya bahuśo nṛpasattama .. 9 ..
14.38.d:
अथ जानाति नो गौरी मानिनी परमेश्वरी ..
तस्यैवं चिन्तयानस्य बहुशो नृपसत्तम .. 9 ..
14.38.m: so that Gaurī, the haughty supreme goddess, does not find out?" / As he was contemplating thus repeatedly, O best of kings, (9)

14.38.s:
upāyaṃ sumahaddhyātvā jāhnavīsaṃgasaṃbhavam ..
tenādiṣṭā gaṇāḥ sarve naṃdibhṛṅgipuraḥsarāḥ .. 7.3.38.10 ..
14.38.d:
उपायं सुमहद्ध्यात्वा जाह्नवीसंगसंभवम् ..
तेनादिष्टा गणाः सर्वे नंदिभृङ्गिपुरःसराः .. 7.3.38.10 ..
14.38.m: and had devised a great plan to bring about union with Jāhnavī, / he ordered all the gaṇas, headed by Nandi and Bhṛṅgin: (10)

14.38.s:
abhiprāyo'sti me kaścijjalāśrayavratodbhavaḥ ..
kriyatāmuttamaṃ kuṇḍamasminparvatarodhasi .. 11 ..
14.38.d:
अभिप्रायोऽस्ति मे कश्चिज्जलाश्रयव्रतोद्भवः ..
क्रियतामुत्तमं कुण्डमस्मिन्पर्वतरोधसि .. 11 ..
14.38.m: "I have a certain intention to observe an observance seated in water. / Let an excellent pool be made on the slope of this mountain; (11)

14.38.s:
tatrāhaṃ jalamadhyasthaḥ sthāsyāmi jalatatparaḥ ..
tacchrutvā tvaritaṃ cakrurgaṇāḥ kuṇḍamanekaśaḥ .. 12 ..
14.38.d:
तत्राहं जलमध्यस्थः स्थास्यामि जलतत्परः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा त्वरितं चक्रुर्गणाः कुण्डमनेकशः .. 12 ..
14.38.m: staying in the midst of the water there, I shall remain absorbed in the water." / Hearing that, the gaṇas quickly made a pool in various ways, (12)

14.38.s:
svacchodakasamākīrṇaṃ sutīrthaṃ susukhāvaham ..
tato gaurīmanujñāpya jāhnavīsaṃgalālasaḥ .. 13 ..
14.38.d:
स्वच्छोदकसमाकीर्णं सुतीर्थं सुसुखावहम् ..
ततो गौरीमनुज्ञाप्य जाह्नवीसंगलालसः .. 13 ..
14.38.m: filled with clear water, an auspicious sacred ford bestowing great happiness. / Then, taking leave of Gaurī, longing for union with Jāhnavī, (13)

14.38.s:
vratavyājena deveśo viveśa tadanantaram ..
cintayāmāsa tatrastho gaṃgāṃ trailokyapāvinīm .. 14 ..
14.38.d:
व्रतव्याजेन देवेशो विवेश तदनन्तरम् ..
चिन्तयामास तत्रस्थो गंगां त्रैलोक्यपाविनीम् .. 14 ..
14.38.m: the lord of the gods immediately entered [it] under the pretext of the observance. / Standing there, he meditated on Gaṅgā, the purifier of the three worlds. (14)

14.38.s:
sā dhyātā tatkṣaṇāttatra śivena saha saṃgatā ..
evaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra jāhnavīṃ bhajate sadā .. 15 ..
14.38.d:
सा ध्याता तत्क्षणात्तत्र शिवेन सह संगता ..
एवं स भगवांस्तत्र जाह्नवीं भजते सदा .. 15 ..
14.38.m: Meditated upon, she united with Śiva there that very instant. / Thus that blessed Lord always enjoyed Jāhnavī there (15)

14.38.s:
vratavyājena rājendra na tu gaurī vyajānata ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya nārado bhagavānmuniḥ ..
kaivalyajñānasaṃpannastatrāyātaḥ paribhraman .. 16 ..
14.38.d:
व्रतव्याजेन राजेन्द्र न तु गौरी व्यजानत ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य नारदो भगवान्मुनिः ..
कैवल्यज्ञानसंपन्नस्तत्रायातः परिभ्रमन् .. 16 ..
14.38.m: under the pretext of the observance, O king of kings, and Gaurī did not know. / Then, after some time, the blessed sage Nārada, / endowed with knowledge leading to isolation, arrived there wandering about. (16)

14.38.s:
sa tu dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ jalasthaṃ vratadhāriṇam ..
kāmajairiṃgitairyuktaṃ tatrā'sau vismayānvitaḥ .. 17 ..
14.38.d:
स तु दृष्ट्वा महादेवं जलस्थं व्रतधारिणम् ..
कामजैरिंगितैर्युक्तं तत्राऽसौ विस्मयान्वितः .. 17 ..
14.38.m: Seeing Mahādeva standing in the water keeping the observance, / yet displaying gestures born of desire, he was filled with wonder: (17)

14.38.s:
vaktranetravikāro'yaṃ kimasya vratadhāriṇaḥ ..
īdṛkkāmasamāyuktastato dhyānasthito muniḥ .. 18 ..
14.38.d:
वक्त्रनेत्रविकारोऽयं किमस्य व्रतधारिणः ..
ईदृक्कामसमायुक्तस्ततो ध्यानस्थितो मुनिः .. 18 ..
14.38.m: "Why is this alteration of the face and eyes in him who is keeping an observance, / accompanied by such passion?" Then the sage entered meditation. (18)

14.38.s:
athā'paśyaddhyānadṛṣṭyā gaṃgāsaktaṃ maheśvaram ..
gauryā bhayena savyājaṃ tato vismayamāgataḥ .. 19 ..
14.38.d:
अथाऽपश्यद्ध्यानदृष्ट्या गंगासक्तं महेश्वरम् ..
गौर्या भयेन सव्याजं ततो विस्मयमागतः .. 19 ..
14.38.m: Then, through his meditative vision, he saw Maheśvara attached to Gaṅgā, / behaving deceitfully out of fear of Gaurī; then he was astonished. (19)

14.38.s: tadā sa kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ haraviceṣṭitam .. 7.3.38.20 ..
14.38.d: तदा स कथयामास सर्वं हरविचेष्टितम् .. 7.3.38.20 ..
14.38.m: Then he told [her] all of Hara's actions. (20)

14.38.s:
tato devī tvarāyuktā yayau yatra maheśvaraḥ ..
ātāmranayanā roṣādvepamānā muhurmuhuḥ .. 21 ..
14.38.d:
ततो देवी त्वरायुक्ता ययौ यत्र महेश्वरः ..
आताम्रनयना रोषाद्वेपमाना मुहुर्मुहुः .. 21 ..
14.38.m: Then the goddess, full of haste, went to where Maheśvara was, / her eyes reddish with anger, trembling again and again. (21)

14.38.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kopasaṃyuktāṃ samāyātāṃ maheśvarīm ..
uvāca jāhnavī bhītā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā .. 22 ..
14.38.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा कोपसंयुक्तां समायातां महेश्वरीम् ..
उवाच जाह्नवी भीता ज्ञात्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा .. 22 ..
14.38.m: Seeing that supreme goddess arrive full of wrath, / Jāhnavī, frightened, having perceived [the truth] by divine sight, said: (22)

14.38.s:
āvayoḥ saṃgame devī nāradena niveditā ..
seyaṃ ruṣṭā samāyāti kuruṣva yadanantaram .. 23 ..
14.38.d:
आवयोः संगमे देवी नारदेन निवेदिता ..
सेयं रुष्टा समायाति कुरुष्व यदनन्तरम् .. 23 ..
14.38.m: "Our meeting has been reported to the goddess by Nārada. / Here she comes, infuriated! Do whatever needs to be done next." (23)

14.38.s:
.. śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
karttavyaṃ jāhnavi śreyaḥ puro gatvā nagātmajām ..
atyarthaṃ māninī hyeṣā sāmnā ca vaśavartinī .. 24 ..
14.38.d:
.. श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
कर्त्तव्यं जाह्नवि श्रेयः पुरो गत्वा नगात्मजाम् ..
अत्यर्थं मानिनी ह्येषा साम्ना च वशवर्तिनी .. 24 ..
14.38.m: The blessed Mahādeva said: / "O Jāhnavī, what is proper must be done: go before the daughter of the mountain! / For she is extremely haughty, yet amenable to gentle conciliation. (24)

14.38.s:
tatkṣaṇājjāyate sādhvī tasmātsāmaparā bhava ..
no cecchāpaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tava dāsyatyasaṃśayam .. 25 ..
14.38.d:
तत्क्षणाज्जायते साध्वी तस्मात्सामपरा भव ..
नो चेच्छापं मया सार्धं तव दास्यत्यसंशयम् .. 25 ..
14.38.m: Instantly she will become well-disposed; therefore, be devoted to gentle words. / Otherwise, she will curse you together with me, without a doubt." (25)

14.38.s:
evamuktā ca rudreṇa jāhnavī nṛpasattama ..
kuṇḍānnirgatya sā gaṃgā sammukhaṃ prayayau tadā .. 26 ..
14.38.d:
एवमुक्ता च रुद्रेण जाह्नवी नृपसत्तम ..
कुण्डान्निर्गत्य सा गंगा सम्मुखं प्रययौ तदा .. 26 ..
14.38.m: Having been spoken to thus by Rudra, O best of kings, / that Gaṅgā, Jāhnavī, coming out of the pool, then went forward to meet her. (26)

14.38.s:
pratyudyayau salajjā ca kṛtāṃjalipuraḥsarā ..
praṇamya śirasā ceyaṃ tataḥ prāha svalaṃkṛtā .. 27 ..
14.38.d:
प्रत्युद्ययौ सलज्जा च कृतांजलिपुरःसरा ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा चेयं ततः प्राह स्वलंकृता .. 27 ..
14.38.m: She went out toward her bashfully, with folded hands; / having bowed with her head, well-adorned, she said: (27)

14.38.s:
purā'haṃ tava kāṃtena nipatantī nabhastalāt ..
dhṛtā devi tavā pyetadviditaṃ nṛpateḥ kṛte .. 28 ..
14.38.d:
पुराऽहं तव कांतेन निपतन्ती नभस्तलात् ..
धृता देवि तवा प्येतद्विदितं नृपतेः कृते .. 28 ..
14.38.m: "Formerly, as I was falling from the firmament, I was caught / by your beloved [husband], O goddess; this is known even to you, for the sake of the king (28)

14.38.s:
bhagīrathābhidhānasya tataḥ sneho vyavardhata ..
āvayostava bhītyā ca nābhūtkvāpi samāgamaḥ .. 29 ..
14.38.d:
भगीरथाभिधानस्य ततः स्नेहो व्यवर्धत ..
आवयोस्तव भीत्या च नाभूत्क्वापि समागमः .. 29 ..
14.38.m: named Bhagīratha. Then affection increased / between the two of us, yet out of fear of you no union occurred anywhere. (29)

14.38.s:
adhunā tava vākyena jāne'haṃ na sureśvari ..
samāhūtā'smi rudreṇa kiṃ vā svacchandataḥ śubhe .. 7.3.38.30 ..
14.38.d:
अधुना तव वाक्येन जानेऽहं न सुरेश्वरि ..
समाहूताऽस्मि रुद्रेण किं वा स्वच्छन्दतः शुभे .. 7.3.38.30 ..
14.38.m: Now, by your command—I do not know, O sovereign of the gods!— / was I summoned by Rudra or out of [his own] desire, O auspicious one? (30)

14.38.s:
trailokyasya prabhurayaṃ tanniṣkramya kathañcana ..
tasmādatraiva saṃprāptā satyametanmayoditam .. 31 ..
14.38.d:
त्रैलोक्यस्य प्रभुरयं तन्निष्क्रम्य कथञ्चन ..
तस्मादत्रैव संप्राप्ता सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 31 ..
14.38.m: He is the master of the three worlds; having slipped away somehow, / I have therefore arrived right here. This that I have spoken is the truth." (31)

14.38.s:
.. pulastya upāca .. ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato devī praharṣitā ..
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ satyametattva yoditam.. 32 ..
14.38.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उपाच .. ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ततो देवी प्रहर्षिता ..
प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं सत्यमेतत्त्व योदितम्.. 32 ..
14.38.m: Pulastya said: / Hearing those words of hers, the goddess then was delighted; / she spoke gentle words: "This that you have spoken is the truth. (32)

14.38.s:
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ matto yathepsitam ..
muktvaikaṃ patidharmmatve mama kāṃtaṃ maheśvaram.. 33 ..
14.38.d:
तस्माद्वरय भद्रं ते वरं मत्तो यथेप्सितम् ..
मुक्त्वैकं पतिधर्म्मत्वे मम कांतं महेश्वरम्.. 33 ..
14.38.m: Therefore, choose a boon as you wish from me, may it be well with you, / except for one thing: regarding marital duty with my beloved Maheśvara." (33)

14.38.s:
.. gaṃgovāca .. ..
api daurbhāgyayuktā'haṃ bhāryā jātā'smi śūlinaḥ ..
tasmādekaṃ dinaṃ dehi krīḍanārthamanena tu .. 34 ..
14.38.d:
.. गंगोवाच .. ..
अपि दौर्भाग्ययुक्ताऽहं भार्या जाताऽस्मि शूलिनः ..
तस्मादेकं दिनं देहि क्रीडनार्थमनेन तु .. 34 ..
14.38.m: Gaṅgā said: / "Even though unfortunate, I have become a wife of the Trident-bearer; / therefore, grant me one day to play with him, (34)

14.38.s:
caitraśuklatrayodaśyāmahorātraṃ sureśvari ..
śivakuṃḍaṃ tathāstvetanmayā yasmātsamāvṛtam .. 35 ..
14.38.d:
चैत्रशुक्लत्रयोदश्यामहोरात्रं सुरेश्वरि ..
शिवकुंडं तथास्त्वेतन्मया यस्मात्समावृतम् .. 35 ..
14.38.m: a day and night on the thirteenth of the bright half of Caitra, O sovereign of the gods! / And let this pool of Śiva, because it was entered by me, (35)

14.38.s:
śivagaṃgābhidhānaṃ ca tasmātkuṇḍaṃ dharātale ..
khyātiṃ yātu prasādena tava parvatanaṃdini .. 36 ..
14.38.d:
शिवगंगाभिधानं च तस्मात्कुण्डं धरातले ..
ख्यातिं यातु प्रसादेन तव पर्वतनंदिनि .. 36 ..
14.38.m: attain renown on the earth by the name of Śivagaṅgā pool, / by your grace, O daughter of the mountain!" (36)

14.38.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamastviti sā devī procya gaṃgāṃ mahānadīm ..
tato visarjayāmāsa tāmāliṃgya muhurmuhuḥ .. 37 ..
14.38.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमस्त्विति सा देवी प्रोच्य गंगां महानदीम् ..
ततो विसर्जयामास तामालिंग्य मुहुर्मुहुः .. 37 ..
14.38.m: Pulastya said: / Saying to the great river Gaṅgā, "Let it be so," / that goddess then dismissed her, embracing her again and again. (37)

14.38.s:
gatāyāmatha gaṃgāyāmadhovaktraṃ sulajjitam ..
pāṇau gṛhya yayau rudraṃ bhramamāṇā gṛhaṃ prati ..38..
14.38.d:
गतायामथ गंगायामधोवक्त्रं सुलज्जितम् ..
पाणौ गृह्य ययौ रुद्रं भ्रममाणा गृहं प्रति ..38..
14.38.m: When Gaṅgā had departed, taking Rudra by the hand, who hung his face down with great shame, / she went toward her home, rambling about. (38)

14.38.s:
evametatpurāvṛttaṃ tasminkuṇḍe narādhipa ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena caturddaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ .. 39 ..
14.38.d:
एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तं तस्मिन्कुण्डे नराधिप ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन चतुर्द्दश्यां समाहितः .. 39 ..
14.38.m: Such was the event that took place formerly at that pool, O ruler of men. / Therefore, with all effort, concentrated in mind, on the fourteenth (39)

14.38.s:
śuklāyāṃ caitramāse tu snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
sāṃnidhyāddevadevasya gaṃgāyāśca nṛpottama .. 7.3.38.40 ..
14.38.d:
शुक्लायां चैत्रमासे तु स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
सांनिध्याद्देवदेवस्य गंगायाश्च नृपोत्तम .. 7.3.38.40 ..
14.38.m: of the bright half in the month of Caitra, one should perform ritual ablution there, / on account of the presence of the god of gods and Gaṅgā, O best of kings. (40)

14.38.s:
yatra saṃkṣayamāyāti sarvaṃ tatrāśubhaṃ kṛtam ..
tatra yo vṛṣabhaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya nṛpottama ..
tadromasaṃkhyayāsvarge sa pumānvasati dhruvam ..41..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śivagaṃgākuṇḍotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 38 .. ..
14.38.d:
यत्र संक्षयमायाति सर्वं तत्राशुभं कृतम् ..
तत्र यो वृषभं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय नृपोत्तम ..
तद्रोमसंख्ययास्वर्गे स पुमान्वसति ध्रुवम् ..41..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे शिवगंगाकुण्डोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टात्रिंशोऽध्यायः .. 38 .. ..
14.38.m:
Where all the inauspicious deeds committed are completely destroyed, / he who gives a bull to a brahmin there, O best of kings, / that person dwells in heaven for as many years as the hairs on that [bull], assuredly. (41)
Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Origin and Greatness of the Śivagaṅgā Pool,' in the Arbuda section, the third [section] of the Prabhāsa section, in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (38)
